description:
Job Title: Social Media & Creative Strategist
  
Brand: Nuvo Aeon Diamond & Jewellery
  
Experience: 6–7+ years (Brand-side only; agency-only backgrounds will not be considered)
  
  
\*\*About the Role\*\*
  
We're looking for a Social Media & Creative Strategist to own the brand's digital presence and creative direction. This is a brand-side role — you'll need to have sat inside a brand (not an agency) driving strategy, content, and performance end-to-end, with real ownership of outcomes rather than client deliverables.
  
  
\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*
  
  
\*Social Media Strategy\*
  
- Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
  
- Define content pillars and maintain a consistent, premium brand voice.
  
- Drive brand awareness, engagement, community growth, enquiries, and conversions.
  
- Plan campaigns around jewellery launches, festivals, weddings, gifting occasions, and key brand moments.
  
  
\*Creative Strategy & Content\*
  
- Develop fresh, premium, visually engaging content concepts.
  
- Create direction for Reels, carousels, static posts, Stories, product shoots, campaigns, and digital launches.
  
- Craft strong hooks, storytelling concepts, campaign themes, captions, and CTAs.

\*Analytics & Performance\*

- Report on content and campaign performance, translating data into actionable insights.
  
  
\*\*Requirements\*\*
  
- 6–7+ years of experience in social media & creative strategy, \*\*on the brand side\*\* (in-house at a brand, not an agency).
  
- Prior experience with premium/luxury, jewellery, fashion, or lifestyle brands strongly preferred.
  
- Strong understanding of platform-specific content formats (Reels, carousels, Stories).
  
- Excellent storytelling, copywriting, and campaign conceptualization skills.
  
- Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate analytics into strategy

title: Performance Marketing Lead I Flo Mattress
description:
We're Hiring: Performance Marketing Lead | Flo Mattress

**Location:**
Mumbai (Work from Office)

**Experience:**
5–10+ years

**Industry:**
D2C / E-commerce / Consumer Brands

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Flo

Flo is one of India's fastest-growing and profitable D2C sleep brands, having served over 1.5 million customers and earned more than 150,000 customer reviews.

As we continue to scale towards becoming one of India's leading consumer brands, we're looking for exceptional talent to help drive our next phase of growth.

About the Role

We're looking for an exceptional
**Performance Marketing Lead**
to own and scale Flo's digital customer acquisition engine.

This is a high-impact role with direct responsibility for driving revenue growth, improving marketing efficiency and optimizing the customer acquisition funnel.

We're looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise in digital advertising with strong analytical capabilities, creative instincts and commercial acumen.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing growth strategies, managing large advertising budgets, analyzing complex data and getting hands-on with campaign execution.

**We're not looking for someone who simply manages agencies or advertising budgets. We're looking for someone who understands what drives profitable growth and knows how to make it happen.**

Key Responsibilities1. Performance Marketing & Growth

* Own and scale paid acquisition across Meta, Google, YouTube and emerging digital channels.
* Manage large advertising budgets with accountability for revenue growth, customer acquisition costs and marketing efficiency.
* Develop and execute data-driven acquisition strategies across customer segments, geographies and product categories.
* Optimize campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience targeting and budget allocation.
* Identify opportunities to scale revenue while maintaining strong unit economics and profitability.

2. Conversion Rate Optimization

* Analyze and optimize the entire acquisition funnel, from impressions and clicks to add-to-cart, checkout and purchase.
* Work closely with website, product and technology teams to improve landing pages, product detail pages and checkout conversion.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks and develop structured experiments to address them.
* Lead A/B testing across creatives, landing pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Improve acquisition economics through better conversion rates, not just cheaper traffic.

3. Creative Strategy & Experimentation

* Collaborate with creative and content teams to develop high-performing advertising campaigns.
* Build a rigorous creative testing framework across hooks, messaging, formats and propositions.
* Use consumer insights and performance data to inform creative strategy.
* Identify winning creatives and scale them systematically.
* Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate creative production, experimentation and optimization.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Measurement

* Build robust reporting frameworks to monitor performance across channels and the acquisition funnel.
* Track and optimize CAC, ROAS, MER, conversion rates, contribution margins and other business-critical metrics.
* Develop a strong understanding of attribution, incrementality and cross-channel performance.
* Ensure accurate tracking and measurement across Shopify, GA4, Meta Pixel, Conversions API and Google Ads.
* Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable business recommendations.

5. Strategy, Innovation & Leadership

* Stay ahead of developments in digital advertising, AI-driven campaign optimization and changing consumer behaviour.
* Continuously experiment with new platforms, campaign structures, bidding strategies and acquisition opportunities.
* Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing performance marketing team.
* Collaborate closely with brand, creative, analytics, technology and business teams.
* Establish a culture of accountability, structured experimentation and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

* 5–10+ years of relevant experience in performance marketing, preferably within a high-growth D2C, e-commerce or consumer business.
* **Demonstrated experience directly managing and optimizing digital advertising budgets exceeding ₹5 crore per month.**
* Deep, hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads, including campaign architecture, bidding, targeting and optimization.
* Proven ability to scale customer acquisition while improving marketing efficiency and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to diagnose complex campaign and funnel performance issues.
* Solid understanding of Shopify, GA4, attribution, tracking and conversion rate optimization.
* Experience developing and executing structured creative testing and experimentation programs.
* Strong commercial understanding of CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margins and customer acquisition economics.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* High ownership, attention to detail and a bias for action.

**Good to Have**

* Experience scaling performance marketing for a large Indian D2C or e-commerce brand.
* Experience marketing high-consideration consumer products.
* Familiarity with marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing and advanced attribution.
* Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve marketing performance.
* Experience building and leading performance marketing teams.

What Success Looks Like

* Sustainable growth in revenue and new customer acquisition.
* Improved marketing efficiency and contribution margins.
* Higher website conversion rates across key acquisition funnels.
* A scalable, data-driven creative testing and experimentation engine.
* Stronger measurement, attribution and cross-channel budget allocation.
* A high-performing, accountable performance marketing function.

Why Join Flo?

**Scale:**
Work with one of India's fastest-growing D2C sleep brands, operating at significant scale.

**Ownership:**
Take responsibility for one of the most important growth drivers of the business.

**Impact:**
Your decisions will directly influence revenue, profitability and the experience of millions of consumers.

**Entrepreneurial Culture:**
Work in an environment that values independent thinking, speed, experimentation and accountability.

**Opportunity:**
Play a defining role in building one of India's leading consumer brands.

If you're someone who loves performance marketing, thinks beyond ROAS, enjoys digging into data and wants to build a truly scalable growth engine, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply through LinkedIn.**

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing
  
  
**Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually**
Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.
  
  
You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.
  
  
This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.
  
  
Your Work
  
  
Property Positioning and Listings
  
  
You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
  
  
You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.
  
  
Photography and AI Editing
  
  
You will select the strongest property photographs and complete light editing such as cropping, resizing, lighting improvements, and appropriate cleanup.
  
  
When needed, you will use AI tools to remove temporary clutter or virtually furnish empty rooms.
  
  
AI may improve the presentation, but it must never change permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities.
  
  
Short-Form Video Content
  
  
You will create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
  
  
You may also create AI-assisted content using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers.
  
  
**Tools May Include**

* Canva
* CapCut
* HeyGen
* AI virtual-staging platforms
* AI object-removal tools
* Comparable image and video applications

You will be responsible for reviewing AI-generated content and correcting visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors before publication.
  
  
Organization and Quality Control
  
  
You may manage content for several properties at the same time.
  
  
**You Will Need To**

* Track every active listing and its current status
* Complete urgent price and availability corrections
* Remove or update properties that are no longer available
* Manage competing deadlines
* Identify missing information or materials
* Coordinate with Royal York’s leasing and property-management teams
* Respond professionally to feedback and complete revisions promptly

What You Should Bring
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone With**

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable field
* Experience producing online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s strongest selling points
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, or comparable editing tools
* Experience using AI for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging
* Experience with HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool
* Strong creative and visual judgment
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
* The ability to receive feedback and revise work without becoming defensive
* Strong written and spoken English
* The ability to work independently
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment
* Full-time availability with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours

Candidates with less experience may be considered when their portfolio demonstrates strong ability.
  
  
Experience in residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not required.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is not required. Your demonstrated ability, relevant experience, and portfolio quality are more important.
  
  
**You’ll Do Well Here If You Are**

* Creative without sacrificing accuracy
* Organized enough to manage repetitive, high-volume work
* Comfortable improving imperfect source material
* Curious about new AI and editing tools
* Careful not to create misleading property content
* Responsive to deadlines and feedback
* Able to work without constant supervision

How to Apply
  
  
Submit your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio must include examples from at least two of these areas:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

The link must work without a password or access request.
  
  
Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with the position will receive an email invitation to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

The role includes collaborating with cross-functional teams on product launch plans, pricing, and promotion, while aligning marketing activities with scientific and regulatory requirements. The General Manager Marketing will manage and mentor the marketing team, coordinate closely with sales to achieve revenue and growth targets, and build strong relationships with global partners, key customers, and industry stakeholders. title: Director Performance Marketing
description:
**Job Description: Director – Performance Marketing (Biddable Media), Regional Delivery Lead**

**Experience:**
10–14 Years

**Department:**
Performance Marketing – Biddable Media (Centralized COE)

**Location:**
Mumbai (Regional oversight across Delhi & Bangalore)

**About the Role:**

Interactive Avenues, part of Omnicom Group is looking for a hands-on, delivery-focused Director – Biddable Media to lead the day-to-day operations of our centralized Biddable Media team and ensure consistent, high-quality execution across our Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore offices. This is a senior operational leadership role for an individual with deep, hands-on expertise across Paid Search, Paid Social, and other biddable platforms, combined with a proven track record of running large, multi-city teams and delivery engines.

As the Regional Delivery Lead for Biddable Media, you will be directly accountable for campaign quality, execution standards, and operational governance across offices — acting as the senior-most point of escalation for day-to-day delivery issues and ensuring every team, in every city, meets the same bar of execution.

This role offers the opportunity to run a centralized, multi-city delivery practice for leading national and global brands, working closely with account management teams to ensure flawless execution at scale.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end execution quality for the centralized Biddable Media practice across Search, Social, and other biddable platforms including Google Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Meta, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X (Twitter), and other platforms.
* Directly oversee campaign setup, trafficking, QA, optimization, pacing, and reporting across accounts to ensure consistent execution standards across Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore offices.
* Track and drive KPI performance (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, CPL, and overall media efficiency) across the regional portfolio, flagging and resolving issues proactively.
* Review campaign builds, audits, and deliverables across teams to catch errors early and maintain execution quality benchmarks.
* Drive adoption of platform tools, automated rules, scripts, and workflow efficiencies to improve speed and accuracy of delivery across the region.
* Coordinate closely with account management teams on day-to-day client requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Act as the primary escalation point for campaign, platform, or operational issues across all three offices, driving fast resolution.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, QA checklists, and platform best practices across every team and account.

**Regional & Team Leadership:**

* Directly manage and supervise a multi-city team of Managers, Assistant Managers, Executives, and Analysts across Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore, overseeing their day-to-day work and output.
* Allocate accounts and workload across offices, manage team bandwidth, and ensure optimal utilization of resources on a week-to-week basis.
* Conduct regular quality checks and deliverable reviews to maintain consistent execution standards across locations.
* Run performance reviews, give hands-on feedback, and coach team members on platform execution and campaign management.
* Standardize day-to-day processes, checklists, and reporting formats across offices to reduce errors and rework.
* Onboard and train new team members across cities on platform tools, processes, and quality standards.
* Travel across Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore as required to review team output, resolve issues, and support account needs.

**Desired Skills & Experience:**

* 10–14 years of hands-on experience in performance/biddable media execution, with at least 4–5 years directly managing multi-location or multi-team delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of campaign setup, QA, and optimization across Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn, and other biddable platforms.
* Proven ability to run day-to-day operations across multiple teams and offices with minimal errors and consistent quality.
* Experience with GA4, Looker Studio, and other reporting/analytics tools for performance tracking.
* Strong attention to detail with a track record of catching and preventing execution errors before they reach clients.
* Excellent people management skills with the ability to coach, review, and upskill execution teams across locations.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and offices simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Business, Advertising, Digital Media, or a related discipline.
* Google Ads & Meta Ads Certifications are preferred.
* Prior experience managing multi-city or multi-office delivery teams within an agency environment is highly preferred.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A hands-on, execution-first mindset with high attention to detail.
* Comfort managing day-to-day delivery pressure across multiple teams and offices.
* Curiosity to experiment with emerging ad products, automation, and AI-powered marketing tools.
* A strong commitment to quality, consistency, and client satisfaction at scale.

**About Interactive Avenues:**

Interactive Avenues, part of Omnicom Media, is India’s largest full-service digital agency, with 800+ experts focused on driving outstanding results for more than 200 brands. Interactive Avenues is the most awarded digital agency, with 165+ awards in the last three years, and its comprehensive suite of crafts includes media, programmatic, data & analytics, eCommerce, paid search, social media, SEO, CRO, ORM, creative, website transformation, and more.

**Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion**

At Omnicom Media, we are committed to fostering a workplace where differences are valued and everyone can thrive in a culture of equality, inclusion and belonging. We believe in creating an environment that reflects the diversity of the world around us - where individuals feel empowered to bring their authentic selves to work, and where varied perspectives are respected, heard and represented. **About The Role**
**Key responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Commercial Strategy & Business Leadership
* Develop and lead the Gene Therapy commercial strategy aligned to global, regional, and local priorities.
* Drive achievement of sales, patient access, and business objectives.
* Identify growth opportunities and proactively address market barriers.

description:

title: Sr Strategy & Execution Leader BioTech (Lifesciences)
description:
**About Paramverse Bio**

Paramverse Bio Pvt. Ltd. is building India’s next great bio company, with a focus on biological agriculture. Founded in 2024 and part of Paramverse Group, it develops and sells indigenous microbial formulations under the DHARITRI SUTRA™ brand. The portfolio spans 21 registered products across three lines: RAKSHAK (bio-protection), POSHAK (bio-nutrition), and AMRITAM (export-grade compliance).

Every product is delivered through the “Doctor of Soil” model: a certified agronomist, a personalised prescription, and data to show whether it worked. Paramverse Bio is live across nine Indian states in Phase 1 (FY27), with 48 territories, institutional-grade manufacturing, and field-to-export traceability.

**What You Will Own**

Platform Strategy & Cross-Industry Planning

* Drive end-to-end execution of key strategic programs across Paramverse Bio’s seven target industries — not just agriculture.
* Support the CEO’s Office in scoping new B2B verticals (pharma CDMO, food-grade enzymes, bio-surfactants, cosmetic actives) — market sizing, competitor mapping, PE-framework evaluation, and go/no-go recommendations.
* Build and maintain the cross-industry opportunity pipeline: track where capital is flowing, which sectors are maturing, and where Paramverse’s shared platform creates a structural cost or speed advantage.
* Coordinate the translation of platform-level capabilities (fermentation, AI, manufacturing) into industry-specific revenue plans across B2B2C (Agri), B2B (Pharma + Industrial), and B2C (Consumer Brands) channels.

Go-to-Market & Commercial Execution

* Partner with sales leadership, state heads, and commercial teams to track performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions across the agricultural biologicals business (Dharitri Sutra).
* Support market expansion and distribution growth across existing and new geographies — building structured GTM playbooks, retailer onboarding frameworks, and territory-level P&L dashboards.
* Coordinate with regulatory, agronomy, and external partners to support product registrations, compliance, field trials, and market-readiness activities across both agri and non-agri portfolios.
* Track competitive intelligence across all target sectors — funded startups, policy shifts, regulatory changes, and M&A activity that affects Paramverse’s positioning.

Manufacturing, Technology & Data

* Work with the manufacturing and R&D teams to track greenfield plant milestones, capacity utilisation, and the seasonal production-swing strategy (agri in Kharif, industrial in off-season).
* Support the AI and computational biology initiatives — tracking research partnerships, model development milestones, and the data flywheel that connects fermentation batches to field outcomes.
* Help build the business case for each manufacturing phase expansion — marginal capex analysis, capacity-revenue mapping, and utilisation economics.

Operations, Reporting & Governance

* Build structured project plans, milestones, dashboards, and review mechanisms to track progress and drive accountability across all active programs.
* Prepare CEO-facing reviews, MIS dashboards, investor updates, and board-level business recommendations.
* Manage cross-functional collaboration with Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and external advisors to ensure smooth operations.
* Analyse business and program performance data to generate insights and support decision-making — from per-acre unit economics in agri to EBITDA modelling for B2B pilot batches.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, solve ambiguous business problems, and implement scalable processes as the organisation grows from a single-market operation to a multi-industry platform.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Engineering degree with strong academic credentials; MBA from a leading business school preferred.
* 4–10 years of experience in Program Management, Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting, or General Management roles — ideally in environments that span multiple industries or business lines.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with a structured, first-principles approach to execution.
* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and driving outcomes without formal authority — across technical, commercial, and operational teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet.
* Ability to shift fluently between strategic thinking (market sizing, competitive positioning, capital planning) and hands-on execution (dashboards, vendor coordination, field visits).
* Strong written and verbal communication — you will prepare materials that go directly to the Founder, Governing Council, and investors.
* Intellectual curiosity about biology, fermentation, AI, and the broader bio-economy transition — you don’t need a science background, but you need to understand the platform at a technical level.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Biotechnology, AgriTech, Pharmaceuticals, CDMO, Specialty Chemicals, Food Ingredients, or FMCG — any sector where biology meets manufacturing at scale.
* Exposure sales operations, commercial excellence, GTM strategy, or multi-geography market expansion.
* Experience working directly with founders, C-suite leadership, or in a CEO’s Office / Founder’s Office capacity at a high-growth company.
* Familiarity with regulatory processes (CIB, FCO, FSSAI, CDSCO), product validation programs, or field trial management.
* Comfort with financial modelling — unit economics, capacity utilisation, PE-framework evaluation, and investor-grade business plans.
* Exposure AI/ML workflows, data platforms, or computational biology — even at a non-technical level.

title: General Manager - Celviq Daily Skincare
description:
**About Celviq and the role**

Celviq Daily Skincare is an Indian D2C skincare startup selling primarily through its own website and online marketplaces. The company is scaling from a pilot team to a full organisation across 14 departments.

The GM / Business Head is the single point of accountability for the business. The role converts the founders' vision into an annual operating plan, then delivers revenue, margin and brand growth through the functional heads, agencies and supply partners.

**Role purpose**

•        Own the full business lifecycle: product concept, formulation, sourcing, manufacturing, launch, sale, delivery and repeat purchase.

•        Deliver the annual P&L: revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA and cash.

•        Build Celviq into a trusted, compliant and digitally native skincare brand.

•        Build the leadership team, culture and governance needed to scale.

1. Key responsibilities

**1. Strategy, P&L and business planning**

•        Build the 3-year business plan and annual operating plan (AOP) with the founders and Board.

•        Own the P&L: revenue, COGS, gross margin, marketing spend, contribution margin, EBITDA and working capital.

•        Set quarterly targets for each function and run monthly business reviews against them.

•        Prepare Board decks and investor updates, and support fundraising with the Finance Head.

•        Decide channel mix, pricing, discounting and SKU portfolio based on unit economics.

**2. E-commerce and D2C growth**

•        Grow sales across the brand website, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Purplle and quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart).

•        Own marketplace performance: listings, content, ratings, Buy Box, ads (sponsored products, DSP) and account health.

•        Drive website conversion, average order value, repeat rate and customer lifetime value.

•        Manage performance marketing ROAS, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and payback period.

•        Oversee fulfilment, returns, COD/RTO control and customer service standards.

**3. Product, quality and R&D**

•        Approve the new product development roadmap with the QA/R&D Head.

•        Ensure formulations, testing (stability, safety, dermatological) and claims meet brand and regulatory standards.

•        Ensure compliance with the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, Cosmetics Rules 2020, BIS standards and Legal Metrology labelling.

•        Drive product quality metrics: complaint rate, batch rejection and recalls.

**4. Supply chain, procurement and manufacturing partners**

•        Oversee contract manufacturers, packaging and raw-material suppliers through the Procurement Head.

•        Negotiate key commercial terms, MOQs and payment terms for strategic vendors.

•        Own demand planning, inventory days, stock-outs and dead-stock levels.

•        Manage warehousing and 3PL logistics partners against cost and delivery SLAs.

**5. Brand and marketing**

•        Approve brand positioning, identity and communication with the Branding and Marketing Head.

•        Approve the annual marketing budget and its split across performance, influencer, content and offline.

•        Track brand health: share of search, social engagement, reviews and NPS.

**6. Functional leadership: Finance, Legal, IT, HR and Admin**

•        Finance and Accounts: monthly closing, MIS, budgets, cash flow, GST and statutory compliance, audits.

•        Legal: contracts, trademarks, IP, regulatory licences and dispute management.

•        IT: e-commerce stack (website, OMS, WMS, ERP, CRM), data and analytics, cybersecurity.

•        HR and Admin: manpower plan, hiring of key roles, performance management, culture, Labour Code compliance and facilities.

**7. Agencies, vendors and partners**

•        Appoint, brief and review creative, digital, PR, influencer and marketplace agencies.

•        Set agency KPIs and retainers, and run quarterly performance reviews.

•        Maintain a vendor governance process: onboarding, contracts, SLAs and periodic audits.

**8. Governance, risk and culture**

•        Set and enforce the delegation of authority, approval matrix and internal controls.

•        Identify and mitigate business, regulatory, financial and reputational risks.

•        Build a performance-driven, ethical and customer-first culture.

•        Act as the company's senior representative with investors, partners and regulators.

**Team and span of control**

The role leads 8 functional heads directly and manages external agencies, vendors and suppliers through them.

Direct report -What the GM holds them accountable for

QA / R&D Head -NPD pipeline, formulation quality, testing, regulatory approvals

Procurement Head -Vendor base, cost of materials, contract manufacturing, inventory

Branding and Marketing Head -Brand equity, performance marketing ROAS, CAC, agency output

E-commerce / Marketplace lead -Channel revenue, conversion, marketplace health, quick-commerce

IT Head E-commerce tech stack, systems uptime, data and analytics

HR and Admin Head -Manpower plan, hiring, performance, culture, compliance, facilities

Legal Head -Contracts, IP, licences, regulatory and dispute risk

Finance and Accounts Head -MIS, budgets, cash, taxation, audits, statutory compliance

**External partners managed:**
contract manufacturers, packaging and raw-material suppliers, 3PL and warehousing partners, marketplaces, creative and digital agencies, PR and influencer agencies, and technology vendors.

Open question: confirm whether E-commerce is a separate head or sits under Marketing.

**Qualifications, experience and competencies**

**Education**

•        Graduate in any discipline; MBA or PGDM from a reputed institute preferred.

•        A science, pharmacy or cosmetic technology background is an added advantage.

**Experience**

•        15+ years in consumer businesses, with 5+ years as GM, Business Head, BU Head or CEO with full P&L ownership.

•        Proven record scaling a D2C or e-commerce-led brand in beauty, personal care, skincare, FMCG or wellness.

•        Hands-on experience with marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa) and quick-commerce.

•        Experience managing contract manufacturers and a multi-vendor supply chain.

•        Startup or high-growth experience; exposure to investor reporting or fundraising preferred.

**Knowledge**

•        E-commerce unit economics: CAC, LTV, ROAS, contribution margin, payback.

•        Indian cosmetics regulation, labelling and claims compliance.

•        Financial statements, budgeting and working-capital management.

•        E-commerce technology: Shopify or similar, OMS, WMS, ERP, analytics tools.

**Competencies**

•        Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.

•        Data-driven decision making.

•        Leading and developing senior leaders across diverse functions.

•        Commercial negotiation with vendors, agencies and partners.

•        Consumer and brand sense in beauty and personal care.

•        Integrity, ownership and comfort with ambiguity.

•        Clear communication with the Board, investors and teams.

**Authority and first-year success**

**Decision rights**
(limits as per the Board-approved delegation of authority)

•        Approves functional budgets and spends within the AOP.

•        Hires, appraises and exits roles below the functional-head level; recommends functional-head appointments to the Board.

•        Appoints and terminates agencies and vendors within approved limits.

•        Approves pricing, promotions and SKU launches within margin guardrails.

•        Escalates to the Board: AOP changes, capex, fundraising, new entities and high-value contracts.

**What success looks like**

1.      
**First 90 days:**
assess every function, channel and vendor; fix the MIS and review cadence; present a 12-month business plan to the Board.

2.      
**By 6 months:**
leadership team complete; channel unit economics positive at contribution level; product launch calendar running on schedule.

3.      
**By 12 months:**
AOP revenue and margin delivered; scalable systems, processes and governance in place; a strong brand and team ready for the next growth stage.

KRA / KPI will be discussed accordingly post joining

title: Head of Business & Operation - D2C Fashion
description:
Head of Business & Operations

**Organisation:**
SheRox

**Industry:**
Women's Athleisure, Activewear & D2C Fashion

**Location:**
Mumbai preferred

**Experience:**
10–15 years

**Business Stage:**
Pre-launch

**Compensation:**
Commensurate with experience

**Career Growth:**
Potential progression into broader executive leadership, based on performance

About SheRox

SheRox is an emerging women's athleisure brand focused on creating comfortable, stylish and functional activewear for Indian women.

Our mission is to build a brand that combines global activewear aesthetics with Indian consumer preferences, offering quality products at accessible prices.

The brand is being developed for a growing market of women seeking fitness and lifestyle apparel that balances performance, comfort and everyday wearability.

As we prepare for launch, we are looking for an entrepreneurial business leader who can build the commercial and operational foundations of SheRox and lead its growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Head of Business & Operations**
to take ownership of the commercial development, operational execution and business performance of SheRox.

The selected candidate will be responsible for building and scaling the business across product development coordination, sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising, distribution, e-commerce, financial management and team leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to someone who has previously built or scaled an apparel, activewear or D2C consumer business.

The ideal candidate should understand the complete product-to-market process, from fabric selection and manufacturing economics to customer acquisition, pricing, inventory management and profitability.

The role involves working closely with the founder, creative leadership and executive management to translate the business vision into an operationally efficient and commercially sustainable brand.

The position offers potential progression toward a CEO role over approximately 2–3 years, subject to demonstrated performance, business growth and leadership requirements. Such progression is not guaranteed.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Strategy and Leadership

* Develop and execute the overall business strategy for SheRox.
* Establish operational priorities, commercial targets and business growth plans.
* Translate the brand vision into measurable business objectives and execution plans.
* Lead business planning, budgeting and performance reviews.
* Identify market opportunities and build strategies for sustainable expansion.
* Work closely with the founder and executive leadership on key business decisions.

2. P&L and Financial Management

* Take ownership of business profitability and commercial performance.
* Prepare and manage operating budgets, revenue forecasts and financial plans.
* Monitor gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses and working capital.
* Develop product pricing strategies based on costs, competition, target consumers and profitability.
* Track commercial performance across products, categories and sales channels.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and overall business economics.

3. Product Strategy and Merchandising

* Develop product assortment and SKU strategies aligned with the brand's target customers.
* Work with the Creative & Product Design Head to build commercially viable activewear collections.
* Support decisions relating to product categories, pricing, fit, functionality and consumer demand.
* Oversee merchandising, product launches and seasonal collection planning.
* Analyse product performance, customer feedback and category profitability.
* Balance consumer demand, product availability, margins and inventory investment.

4. Sourcing, Manufacturing and Supply Chain

* Identify and manage manufacturing partners, sourcing vendors and suppliers.
* Oversee product development coordination, sampling, production planning and quality requirements.
* Understand and evaluate technical fabrics, garment construction, fitting challenges and product performance.
* Negotiate commercial terms, manufacturing costs, lead times and minimum order quantities (MOQs).
* Establish processes for quality assurance, production tracking and vendor performance.
* Manage supply chain risks and ensure timely product availability.

5. D2C, E-commerce and Sales Growth

* Develop and execute the brand's direct-to-consumer and e-commerce strategy.
* Oversee online sales performance, customer conversion and revenue growth.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on customer acquisition, retention and brand growth.
* Monitor customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, repeat purchases, return rates and channel profitability.
* Improve customer experience across ordering, delivery, returns and after-sales support.
* Evaluate opportunities across digital marketplaces, retail channels and other distribution models.

6. Inventory, Fulfilment and Operations

* Establish systems for demand planning, inventory management and replenishment.
* Monitor inventory turnover, stock availability, slow-moving products and working capital utilisation.
* Coordinate logistics, warehousing, fulfilment and returns management.
* Implement operational processes that support scalable business growth.
* Develop standard operating procedures and performance reporting systems.
* Ensure efficient coordination between sourcing, product development, sales and fulfilment.

7. Team Building and Cross-functional Leadership

* Build and lead a lean, high-performing business operations team.
* Identify staffing requirements and manage external specialists and service providers.
* Establish accountability, operating processes and performance measures.
* Coordinate closely with creative, product, manufacturing, finance and marketing teams.
* Manage vendors, commercial partners and service providers.
* Lead execution across functions while maintaining strong communication with the founder and executive leadership.

8. Brand Growth and Market Expansion

* Evaluate market opportunities across Indian consumer segments and geographic regions.
* Develop strategies for reaching customers in metropolitan and Tier 2/3 markets.
* Identify suitable partnerships and distribution opportunities.
* Use customer insights, market data and business performance to guide expansion.
* Support the development of a long-term commercial roadmap for the brand.

Mandatory Requirements

* **10–15 years of relevant professional experience**
  in apparel, activewear, sportswear, fashion retail or D2C consumer businesses.
* Demonstrated experience building, launching or scaling an apparel or athleisure business.
* Proven responsibility for business or category P&L, budgets, pricing, margins and commercial performance.
* Strong understanding of apparel sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising and supply chain operations.
* Practical knowledge of technical fabrics, garment fit, sampling and product development.
* Experience managing D2C or e-commerce operations and understanding customer acquisition economics.
* Ability to manage inventory, working capital, operating expenses and business profitability.
* Experience leading teams and coordinating multiple business functions.
* Strong commercial judgment and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently and take ownership in an early-stage, founder-led environment.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

* MBA, postgraduate qualification in Fashion Management, Retail Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Experience working with women's activewear, athleisure or sportswear brands.
* Previous experience launching a D2C brand or scaling a consumer business.
* Exposure to both online and offline retail distribution.
* Strong understanding of the Indian apparel market and consumer preferences.
* Experience managing manufacturing partners and product development teams.
* Strong financial modelling, analytical and reporting skills.

title: Concept Research & Insights Manager
description:
**Company Description**

title: Assistant Manager – Performance Marketing
description:
We are looking for a results-driven Assistant Manager – Performance Marketing to own and lead our paid media, social media and brand building across multiple business verticals. You should be equally comfortable building a campaign strategy, optimising live ads, and presenting performance numbers to leadership. You will be accountable for lead generation — not just campaign delivery — and for how our brands look and feel, from visual identity to campaign creative direction.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Paid Media & Lead Generation***

* Plan, execute and optimise paid campaigns across Meta, Google and LinkedIn to generate qualified leads across all business verticals
* Own the full campaign lifecycle — strategy, audience targeting, creative briefing, budget management and performance optimisation
* Drive lead generation for B2C verticals (retail, education, bookings) and B2B verticals (corporate services, broking, real estate concepts)
* Monitor and improve key metrics: cost per lead (CPL), return on ad spend (ROAS), click-through rates and conversion rates
* Coordinate with the creative and content teams so campaign assets are delivered on time and aligned to brief

***Social Media Management***

* Develop and implement social media strategy across all brand handles — content cadence, platform priorities and audience growth targets
* Oversee content scheduling and publishing across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube
* Drive consistent follower growth and engagement across all active brand handles
* Set up and manage automated DM and lead qualification flows on social platforms
* Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm changes and content formats

***Brand Building & Visual Direction***

* Define and maintain brand guidelines, visual identity, tone of voice and design language across all verticals
* Build distinct brand positioning for each vertical while keeping it cohesive under the group identity
* Set the visual direction for every major campaign and brief the design and video team before launch
* Review creative output from the design team to keep quality high and every asset on-brand
* Create or direct premium brand collateral: social creatives, pitch decks, brochures and one-pagers
* Test multiple creative variants on key campaigns and iterate visuals based on performance data
* Run regular brand audits to catch inconsistencies and drive alignment across teams

***AI & Automation***

* Use AI-powered ad tools for automated targeting, bidding and campaign optimisation
* Implement automation workflows for lead capture, CRM entry and follow-up sequences
* Use AI tools for ad copy, creative briefs and audience research to multiply output
* Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools that improve campaign performance or team productivity

**Requirements:**

***Experience & Skills***

* 3–5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, independently managing Meta Ads and Google Ads
* Proven track record managing multi-brand or multi-vertical paid campaigns simultaneously
* Strong social media management experience — strategy, content calendars, platform growth, scheduling
* Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Experience with CRM platforms for lead tracking and pipeline management
* Ability to build and present weekly performance reports clearly and confidently
* Familiarity with campaign automation tools and performance dashboards

***Brand & Design Skills***

* Strong visual sense with a portfolio showing brand identity, campaign creatives and social media work
* Experience briefing, directing and reviewing a design or creative team
* Familiarity with AI design tools such as Adobe Firefly, Canva AI or Midjourney



***What Makes You the Right Fit***

* You think in leads, CPL and ROAS — not just impressions and reach
* You are proactive: campaigns are always-on, not waiting for someone to brief you
* You are uncomfortable leaving manual work that can be automated
* You own your numbers — if a target is missed, you know why and have a fix ready
* You actively use AI tools to do more with less
* You communicate clearly to senior leadership — reporting is a strength, not a chore

***What We Offer***

* Ownership of a multi-vertical lead generation function with direct visibility to senior leadership
* A full tools and technology budget — every resource you need to perform at your best
* A dynamic, growing group company across music, capital markets and lifestyle sectors
* Performance-linked career growth — strong results translate into expanded scope and compensation
* An AI-first team culture where automation is encouraged and manual work is actively reduced

description:
**Title**
: Whitespace Marketing Manager
  
  
**Location**

**About Opella**
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Lead End-to-End Assessment of Whitespace Opportunities
* Lead deep dives into prioritised whitespace opportunities identified through the strategic planning process.
* Develop a deep understanding of consumer and HCP needs, category dynamics, market potential, competitive landscape and unmet needs.
* Assess the attractiveness and viability of opportunities from a consumer, marketing, commercial, regulatory and financial perspective.
* Identify the key consumer problem or unmet need and determine the potential role Opella can play in addressing it.
* Benchmark relevant categories, brands, markets and business models to identify winning approaches and learnings.
* Build a clear recommendation on whether to pursue, refine, test or stop an opportunity based on evidence and potential.
* Develop Consumer & Brand Value Propositions
* Translate consumer and HCP insights into compelling consumer propositions and brand concepts.
* Define the target consumer, consumer need, positioning, proposition and key points of differentiation.
* Explore potential product formats, claims, benefits, pack architecture and other elements of the consumer offer in partnership with relevant functions.
* Work closely with Medical/Science and Regulatory to ensure propositions are grounded in credible science and viable within the regulatory environment.
* Develop compelling strategic narratives to communicate the opportunity and the potential for Opella to win.
* Challenge existing category conventions and identify opportunities to develop disruptive or differentiated propositions.
* Validate Opportunities Through Consumer & Market Testing
* Lead consumer and HCP research, concept testing and market validation for prioritised opportunities.
* Develop hypotheses and test them rapidly to establish consumer relevance and commercial potential.
* Design and lead pilot initiatives where appropriate to de-risk opportunities before significant investment.
* Use learnings from research and pilots to refine the proposition, positioning, GTM model and launch approach.
* Establish clear go / no-go criteria and make evidence-based recommendations to leadership.
* Build Business Cases & Go-to-Market Strategies
* Translate validated opportunities into robust business cases covering market size, consumer potential, revenue opportunity, investment requirements, margins, risks and returns.
* Develop appropriate go-to-market strategies, including target consumers, channels, distribution, pricing, communication and commercial requirements.
* Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to build financial models, scenarios and sensitivities.
* Clearly articulate the strategic rationale, consumer opportunity, commercial attractiveness and key risks.
* Define the capabilities, resources and investment required to successfully launch and scale the opportunity.
* Drive Activation & Commercialisation
* Develop detailed launch and activation plans for approved whitespace opportunities.
* Translate strategic recommendations into clear execution roadmaps with milestones, owners, KPIs and resource requirements.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across Marketing, Commercial, Medical/Science, Regulatory, Finance and Supply to operationalise opportunities.
* Maintain momentum from approval through launch and early scale-up, ensuring key milestones are delivered.
* Track performance against agreed KPIs and use early market learnings to refine the proposition, activation and GTM approach.
* Support the transition of successful opportunities into the appropriate brand/category organisation for sustained growth.
* Build a Strong Pipeline of Future Growth Opportunities
* Maintain a structured pipeline of prioritised whitespace opportunities and track their progress through the assessment and validation funnel.
* Continuously monitor consumer, HCP, category, competitive, technology and healthcare trends to identify emerging opportunities relevant to Opella.
* Bring an external perspective by identifying relevant trends and best practices from FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Pharma, Wellness and adjacent categories.
* Partner with the Strategy and Marketing teams to ensure the whitespace pipeline is aligned with Opella India's broader growth priorities.
* Identify opportunities for external innovation, partnerships or new capabilities where these can accelerate the development or commercialisation of a prioritised whitespace.

**About You**
**Knowledge, Skills & Competencies**

* Strong consumer brand marketing capabilities with a demonstrated ability to identify and develop new growth opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to combine consumer insight, market data and commercial thinking.
* Ability to move from insight → opportunity → proposition → business case → execution.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, category dynamics, brand positioning and go-to-market strategy.
* Demonstrated experience in innovation and concept development, including consumer/HCP research and concept validation.
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to assess market attractiveness, financial potential and investment requirements.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and unstructured environments.
* Strong project management skills and a track record of delivering complex cross-functional initiatives with execution excellence.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills.
* Strong storytelling capability, with the ability to turn complex analysis and insights into simple, compelling recommendations.
* Curious, externally oriented and comfortable challenging conventional thinking.
* Strong bias for action, experimentation and learning.

**Why us?**
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. We Are Challengers. We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands. www.opella.com/en/careers

title: Customer Retention Marketing
description:
Retention Marketing Manager
  
  
RAS Luxury Oils & Moody | RAS Beauty Private Limited Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai (Full-time, Work from Office)
  
  
Reports to: Head of Performance Marketing
  
  
Brief
  
  
RAS Beauty is looking for a data-driven Retention Marketing Manager to own the repeat customers across two distinct D2C brands: RAS Luxury Oils, our luxury skincare and wellness brand and Moody, our younger, trend-led skincare brand. You'll build and run the retention engine that turns first-time buyers into loyal, regimen-driven customers: segmentation, lifecycle journeys, replenishment, loyalty, and winback across WhatsApp, Email, SMS, RCS and Push. You'll also own the on-site levers that drive repeat and AOV, from post-purchase flows to bundling and cross-sell. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is as comfortable reading a cohort retention curve as writing a WhatsApp campaign that makes a customer reorder, and who can run two brands with two very different customer mindsets without flattening them into one playbook.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Retention & CRM Strategy
  
  

* Own the retention and CRM roadmap for both RAS and Moody, with brand-specific strategies that reflect each brand's customer, price point and purchase cycle.
* Build RFM and cohort based segmentation, and use it to drive lifecycle journeys: welcome, post-purchase education, replenishment, cross-sell/up-sell, winback and dormant-user reactivation.
* Design regimen-led journeys that move customers from a single hero product to a full routine, and from trial/minis to full-size.
* Plan and execute the retention marketing calendar across WhatsApp, SMS, RCS and on-site messaging, aligned with festive moments and sale events.
* Build and scale loyalty, referral, subscription or membership programmes where they make sense for the unit economics.

On-site Retention & AOV
  
  

* Own the repeat-customer experience on-site: post-purchase upsells, bundles and offer sequencing to lift repeat rate and AOV.
* Partner with the website teams to run A/B tests on repeat-customer touchpoints: PDP, cart, checkout, thank-you page and account pages.
* Drive review, rating and UGC collection that feeds both social proof and retention content.

Analytics & Reporting
  
  

* Own retention metrics end-to-end: repeat purchase rate, cohort retention, time to second order, LTV, churn, and CRM-attributed revenue
* Track campaign performance (delivery, CTR, CR, revenue per send) and channel cost, and optimize for profitable revenue, not just volume.
* Use GA4, CRM platform analytics and Excel - to surface insights and turn them into actionable levers; present a regular retention review to leadership.

Cross-functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work with Performance Marketing to hand over acquired cohorts cleanly and feed first party audiences back into paid campaigns.
* Partner with Content/Creative on CRM creatives and copy, with Product/NPD on launch sequencing, and with CX/Ops on post-purchase experience, delivery and feedback loops.
* Manage CRM, WhatsApp and loyalty vendors and agencies, including cost and performance reviews.

What We Are Looking For
  
  
Mandatory Requirements
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in retention/ CRM marketing for a D2C, beauty/personal care or FMCG brand.
* Hands-on experience with CRM/marketing automation platforms such as Bitespeed, KwikEngage or equivalent
* Proven record of improving repeat purchase rate, cohort retention, LTV or CRM-attributed revenue, with numbers to show for it.
* Experience running multi-channel campaigns end-to-end, from segmentation to creative brief to execution to reporting.
* Working knowledge of GA4 and strong Excel skills for cohort, RFM and funnel analysis (PowerBI/SQL a plus).

**Additional Requirements**

* Beauty, skincare or personal care experience, especially with regimen based or replenishment driven categories.
* Exposure to loyalty programmes, subscriptions, discount/pricing strategy
* Experience with Shopify-based D2C stacks and on-site tools such as Hotjar/Clarity, post-purchase upsell or review apps.
* Experience managing more than one brand or customer segment at the same time.

Who You Are
  
  

* Proactive – you don't wait to be told the repeat rate has slipped; you watch the cohorts, catch the dip and fix it.
* Ownership driven – you own the retention number end-to-end, across both brands.
* Data conscious – you validate every journey offer and test with data across segments and channels before calling it done.
* Customer obsessed – you understand why a luxury skincare buyer and a Gen Z skincare buyer come back for different reasons, and you write for each.
* Organised – you run a busy, always on campaign and experimentation calendar across two brands without anything slipping through the cracks.

Why Join Us
  
  

* Own retention from the ground up for two growing D2C beauty brands with very different audiences.
* Direct exposure to leadership and a real seat in growth decisions.
* A fast moving & high ownership team where your work reflects directly in revenue.

title: Sr Marketing Manager
description:
**Sr Marketing Manager – Hospital Care**

**Anesthesia | Intensivist & Critical Care | Antibiotics & Anti-Infectives | Parenteral Nutrition**

**Organization**

**Experience**

8–12 years in pharmaceutical marketing; relevant hospital therapy experience is essential

**Education**

B. Pharm / M. Pharm / Life Sciences or relevant scientific qualification; MBA in Marketing preferred

Role Purpose

To drive strategy, brand development and commercial growth across the Hospital Care portfolio, with a strong focus on Anesthesia, Intensivist/Critical Care, Antibiotics/Anti-Infectives and Parenteral Nutrition. The role will translate clinical and market insights into differentiated brand strategies, scientific engagement programmes, effective product launches and actionable field plans to improve hospital access, product adoption, revenue and market share.

Key Accountabilities

1. Portfolio Strategy & Business Growth

* Develop annual brand plans and portfolio growth strategies for anesthesia, critical-care, anti-infective and parenteral nutrition products, aligned with business priorities.
* Identify growth opportunities by therapy, molecule, hospital segment, customer type, geography and account potential.
* Assess market size, growth, competitive intensity, pricing, treatment trends and unmet hospital needs; convert findings into business plans.
* Recommend portfolio expansion, lifecycle management, line extensions and new product opportunities in collaboration with Business Development and cross-functional teams.
* Track revenue, market share, profitability and brand performance; recommend corrective actions against plan.

2. Anesthesia & Critical-Care Marketing

* Build strong therapy-area understanding and brand strategies for products used in anesthesia, operation theatres, ICUs and critical-care settings.
* Develop customer-specific value propositions and communication for anesthesiologists, intensivists, critical-care physicians, surgeons and relevant hospital stakeholders.
* Create scientific and promotional tools addressing approved product benefits, clinical evidence, appropriate use and relevant care-setting needs.
* Map priority hospitals, OT/ICU opportunities, key prescribers and institutional decision-makers with Sales to focus field execution.
* Track competitor activity, product availability, usage trends and customer feedback to refine positioning and engagement plans.

3. Antibiotics & Anti-Infectives Strategy

* Develop brand and portfolio strategies for hospital antibiotics and anti-infectives, including differentiated positioning based on approved indications and evidence.
* Build a clear understanding of infectious-disease and hospital anti-infective pathways, resistance-related challenges, microbiology inputs and institutional treatment protocols.
* Design appropriate scientific engagement plans for intensivists, infectious-disease specialists, microbiologists, pharmacists and antimicrobial stewardship stakeholders.
* Work with Medical Affairs and relevant experts to ensure scientific accuracy, balanced communication and responsible antibiotic promotion.
* Support appropriate antimicrobial stewardship initiatives and ensure all brand activities are aligned with company policy, applicable codes and approved product information.

3A. Parenteral Nutrition & Clinical Nutrition Marketing

* Develop brand and portfolio strategies for parenteral nutrition products, including relevant amino-acid, lipid, glucose, electrolyte and other nutrition formulations where applicable to the approved portfolio.
* Build understanding of nutrition needs and care pathways in ICU, peri-operative, critical-care and other relevant hospital settings.
* Develop appropriate scientific communication for intensivists, anesthesiologists, surgeons, clinical nutrition specialists, dietitians, pharmacists and hospital nutrition teams.
* Work with Medical Affairs to translate approved product information and relevant evidence into accurate, balanced educational and promotional materials.
* Partner with Sales to identify high-potential hospitals, nutrition-support teams, institutional protocols and product access opportunities.
* Track competitor activity, market trends, product availability and customer feedback to refine positioning and identify portfolio opportunities.

4. Brand Planning, Campaigns & Scientific Engagement

* Own end-to-end brand planning: segmentation, positioning, messaging, annual plans, campaign calendars and execution priorities.
* Develop scientific meetings, focused educational initiatives, expert interactions and other compliant engagement programmes for relevant hospital audiences.
* Translate brand strategy into clear field-force messages, detailing aids, objection-handling tools and customer engagement materials.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment; use feedback and performance data to optimize future activities.

5. New Product Launches & Lifecycle Management

* Lead launch strategy and go-to-market planning, including opportunity assessment, target-account selection, positioning, forecasting and launch milestones.
* Coordinate launch readiness with Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and Business Development.
* Develop launch training, communication plans and post-launch tracking to support uptake and sustainable performance.
* Monitor lifecycle opportunities, market feedback and competitive response; recommend timely brand-plan adjustments.

6. Sales Force Enablement & Hospital Development

* Partner with Sales leadership to translate brand plans into territory- and account-level action plans.
* Conduct regular field visits and joint work to understand customer needs, assess execution quality and identify opportunities.
* Support product and therapy-area training for KAMs and managers, ensuring strong scientific understanding and consistent communication.
* Work with Sales to identify high-potential hospitals, corporate chains, government institutions, tenders and formulary opportunities.
* Review performance regularly and recommend actions to close gaps in reach, frequency, adoption and sales delivery.

7. Market Intelligence, Forecasting & Business Reviews

* Track relevant market data, competitor brands, pricing, product launches, hospital trends and portfolio performance.
* Prepare sales forecasts, brand dashboards, monthly reviews and strategic presentations for management.
* Establish KPIs for revenue growth, market development, launch performance, campaign effectiveness and resource utilization.
* Use primary and secondary research, customer feedback and field insights to support evidence-based decisions.

8. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Compliance

* Work closely with Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and Business Development to deliver portfolio objectives.
* Manage marketing budgets and prioritize investment based on business potential and measurable impact.
* Ensure promotional materials and activities meet applicable regulatory requirements, company policies and pharmaceutical marketing codes.
* Maintain scientific integrity, fair-balance communication, approved-indication compliance and responsible antibiotic-use principles.

Candidate Profile

* 8–12 years of pharmaceutical marketing experience, with demonstrated exposure to hospital products in one or more of the following: anesthesia, critical care/intensivist, antibiotics/anti-infectives or parenteral nutrition/clinical nutrition.
* Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience across at least two of the four therapy areas, including meaningful hospital-care exposure.
* Demonstrated success in brand planning, product launches, market development and delivery of measurable business outcomes.
* Good understanding of Indian hospital business, institutional sales, clinical stakeholders, formulary processes and competitive dynamics.
* Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to convert scientific and market information into clear brand strategy and practical field execution.
* Willingness to travel for market visits, customer interactions and business reviews.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of portfolio sales, growth and profitability targets.
* Brand performance and market-share improvement across anesthesia, critical-care, anti-infective and parenteral nutrition portfolios.
* Successful launch execution and achievement of launch milestones and forecasts.
* Growth in priority hospital access, formulary inclusion and institutional business opportunities.
* Effectiveness of brand plans, scientific engagement initiatives and marketing investment.
* Improvement in field-force capability, campaign adoption and quality of execution.
* Accuracy of forecasts, quality of market insights and timely delivery of business reviews.
* Compliance with company policies, applicable marketing codes and responsible antibiotic communication standards.

What Success Looks Like

Who You Are
  
  
**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the buyer-side and DSP ecosystem and how advertisers and agencies buy programmatically.
* Proven success in new business development, pipeline building, and strategic account growth.

**Additional Information**

: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.

As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:

In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Define and execute the Premium desirability strategy for India, using artist-led and culturally relevant initiatives to drive consideration and conversion.
* Own the artist and partner flywheel for Premium growth, evolving artist advocacy, fan experiences, and partnership programs toward measurable Premium outcomes.
* Shape and execute the Premium opportunity within existing in-person activations, including film partnerships, bespoke music events, festivals, and other relevant cultural moments.
