title: Director – Sales & Marketing
description:
**Job Description**
**POSITION OVERVIEW**
Director – Sales & Marketing is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining and executing the commercial growth strategy of
**Sayantrik Engineers**
(India) and its wholly-owned U.S. subsidiary
**C&C Engineering Inc. (CCE USA)**
. The role carries end-to-end ownership of global business development, revenue growth and brand positioning for the company's engineering consultancy services — with emphasis on multi-discipline engineering, EPC/EPCM support and PMC services delivered to owner-operators and EPC contractors across the oil & gas, petrochemical and chemical sectors.
  
  
The Director will drive market expansion across
**India, Malaysia and the USA**
, building a high-performing sales organisation, deepening key accounts, and aligning marketing initiatives with the company's technical capabilities, ISO-certified quality systems and 24×7 global delivery model. This is a pivotal role in the company's transition from a strong India foundation to a scaled multinational consultancy
  
  
**Requirements**
Sayantrik Engineers has built a strong India base of 150+ engineering professionals and is now investing in international expansion through CCE USA. The Director is expected to convert this platform into accelerated, profitable revenue growth while preserving margin discipline.
  
  
**Growth Pillar**
**Mandate for this Role**
India (Sayantrik Engineers)
  
  
Deliver revenue consistency and expand the order book across refining, petrochemical, fertiliser and specialty-chemical clients.
  
  
USA (CCE USA)
  
  
Operationalise the U.S. entity, land the first anchor clients, and build a durable USD revenue stream toward the Year-1 target.
  
  
Consolidated Growth
  
  
Own the Group's growth strategy by driving new client acquisition, strengthening key account relationships, and maximizing cross-selling opportunities across business entities.
  
  
Currency & Delivery
  
  
Leverage the USD revenue stream as a currency hedge and exploit the India–USA time-zone advantage for 24×7 delivery.
  
  
Premium Positioning
  
  
Position AI-integrated, digital-engineering-led premium services (laser scanning, brownfield modifications) as differentiators.
  
  
Primary Objectives
  
  

* Revenue & growth: Define and implement a comprehensive sales and marketing strategy to drive sustainable business growth, achieving annual revenue, profitability, and order intake objectives across engineering consultancy, EPCM, and PMC service lines.
* Market positioning: Establish Sayantrik Engineers / CCE USA as a preferred engineering partner for EPC contractors and owner-operators in oil & gas, petrochemicals and chemicals across the targeted geographies.
* International expansion: Successfully commercialise CCE USA and build a diversified, multi-geography revenue base that reduces dependence on any single market.
* Sustainable profitability: Balance top-line growth with margin protection, supporting the Group's 30%+ EBITDA ambition and healthy working-capital discipline.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Commercial Strategy & Market Development
* Develop and own the go-to-market strategy for engineering, EPCM and PMC services, including segment, geography and key-account prioritisation (refineries, petrochemical complexes, fertiliser/ammonia & sulphuric acid plants, pipelines, terminals and specialty chemicals).
* Conduct market and competitor analysis across upstream, midstream and downstream oil & gas, bulk and specialty petrochemicals, and chemicals to identify growth pockets, white-space opportunities and strategic partnerships.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities through direct client engagement, tender tracking, bid lists, OEM / technology-licensor relationships and alliances with EPC contractors.
* Key Account Management & Client Relationships
* Act as executive sponsor for strategic accounts (major EPCs and owner-operators), ensuring deep understanding of client business drivers, investment plans and decision-making processes.
* Establish long-term framework agreements, multi-year master service agreements and preferred-vendor arrangements, supported by robust technical and commercial value propositions.
* Lead high-value negotiations for engineering and PMC contracts, coordinating closely with proposals, legal and finance teams to balance competitiveness with profitability and risk management.
* Sales Leadership & Team Management
* Build, mentor and lead a high-performing sales and business development team with strong technical-selling capability in oil & gas and petrochemicals across India, Malaysia and the USA.
* Set clear sales targets, KPIs and incentive schemes aligned to company objectives — order intake, revenue mix, geographic diversification, win rate, hit rate and key-account penetration.
* Implement disciplined sales processes: opportunity qualification, CRM usage, pipeline reviews, bid/no-bid decisions and post-bid analysis to continuously improve win rates.
* Marketing, Branding & Demand Generation
* Develop and oversee integrated marketing plans combining thought leadership, digital marketing, participation in industry conferences and targeted campaigns.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create sector-specific collateral — capability profiles, case studies, white papers, technical articles and webinar content showcasing EPCM/PMC experience (e.g., sulphuric acid, ammonia VDR, brownfield modifications and laser scanning ).
* Strengthen brand presence in India, Malaysia and the USA via digital channels (website, LinkedIn, email campaigns), trade associations and strategic event participation.
* Bid Management & Proposal Support
* Provide strategic oversight to the proposals / pre-sales team for RFQs, RFPs and tenders from EPCs and owner-operators, ensuring differentiated technical and commercial positioning.
* Work with engineering, project-management and cost-estimating teams to define competitive scopes, execution strategies (EPC, EPCM, PMC) and pricing models tailored to client risk preferences.
* Ensure timely bid/no-bid decisions, resource allocation and stakeholder approvals for major bids across India, Malaysia, USA and other target regions.
* International Business & Regional Coordination
* Drive international sales expansion, aligning regional business-development efforts across India, Malaysia and the USA while respecting local market dynamics, regulatory environments and cultural norms.
* Coordinate closely with regional office heads to set territory-level targets, joint account plans and resource deployment for key projects and framework contracts.
* Champion cross-sell and inter-company synergies between Sayantrik Engineers (India) and CCE USA, leveraging shared delivery capacity and transfer-pricing efficiency.
* Performance Management & Governance
* Monitor sales performance, marketing ROI and pipeline health through data-driven dashboards and regular reviews, adjusting strategy based on market signals and execution feedback.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, legal requirements, export controls, anti-corruption guidelines and contract-governance standards in all commercial dealings across both entities.

Target Customers & Segments
  
  
**Segment**
**Description**
EPC Contractors
  
  
Global and regional EPCs executing refinery, petrochemical, chemical, gas-processing, LNG and pipeline projects (greenfield and brownfield).
  
  
Owner-Operators
  
  
Public-sector and private integrated oil & gas companies, national oil companies, chemical & fertiliser manufacturers, and midstream/downstream operators requiring PMC and engineering support.
  
  
Technology Providers & OEMs
  
  
Licensors, equipment suppliers and technology firms seeking engineering partners for joint bids and lifecycle support services.

**Measure**
**Indicative Target**
Group Revenue
  
  
Consolidated revenue (India + CCE USA)
  
  
Achieve annual revenue growth in line with business objectives
  
  
Order Intake
  
  
New order book / signed contract value
  
  
Full pipeline coverage of revenue plan
  
  
USA Ramp-up (CCE USA)
  
  
USD revenue & anchor-client acquisition
  
  
First clients + Year-1 USD stream
  
  
Win / Hit Rate
  
  
Bids won vs. submitted
  
  
Continuous improvement quarter-on-quarter
  
  
Key-Account Penetration
  
  
Framework / MSA agreements signed
  
  
Multi-year agreements with anchor accounts
  
  
Pipeline Health
  
  
Qualified pipeline vs. target multiple
  
  
≥ 3× coverage of annual target
  
  
Collection Efficiency
  
  
DSO on new business
  
  
Support DSO < 30 days

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. title: Consumer Product Development & Brand Launch Manager
description:
**About Lion & Child**

Lion & Child is an independent creative and venture studio building original consumer brands, media and entertainment projects.

We're developing a portfolio of consumer products across lifestyle and other categories, taking ideas from initial concept through product development, manufacturing, branding and commercial launch.

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial professional to work directly with the founder and help bring these products to market.

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role for someone who understands how physical consumer products are developed, manufactured and launched.

You'll help turn early-stage product concepts into commercially viable, market-ready products, coordinating everything from manufacturer sourcing and sampling to packaging, costing and launch execution.

We're a small, founder-led company, so you'll need to be resourceful, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership without a large team or established infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, evaluate and negotiate with manufacturers, suppliers and production partners.
* Manage product development from initial concept through prototyping, sampling, refinement and final production.
* Coordinate product specifications, materials, packaging, quality standards and production timelines.
* Develop product costing, pricing structures, margins and minimum order quantity (MOQ) strategies.
* Work with external designers, branding agencies and creative partners to bring products to life.
* Coordinate the setup and launch of D2C sales channels, including Shopify and relevant marketplaces.
* Manage external vendors across packaging, logistics, fulfilment and launch activities.
* Research consumer trends, competitor products and opportunities for new product categories.
* Build practical execution plans, manage budgets and ensure projects move from idea to launch.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in consumer product development, sourcing, merchandising, category management or brand launches. More experienced candidates are welcome.
* Demonstrated experience working with manufacturers and suppliers to develop or commercialize physical products.
* Strong understanding of product costing, margins, MOQs, packaging and production processes.
* Experience in consumer categories such as lifestyle, stationery, accessories, gifting, homeware, beauty or related products.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of how consumer brands are positioned, priced and brought to market.
* Ability to manage multiple external partners and execute independently.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and genuine interest in building new brands from scratch.

**Direct experience taking physical products from concept through sampling, manufacturing and commercial launch matters more to us than total years of experience.**

**What Makes This Opportunity Different**

You'll work directly with the founder, helping shape and launch original consumer brands rather than simply managing an established product portfolio.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building things, solving practical problems and seeing their work go from an idea to a real product in customers' hands.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have personally been involved in developing and launching new physical products, not solely managing existing e-commerce operations or marketplace accounts.

title: Senior Lead - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**

* Lead/Senior Lead, Business Strategy and Operations position will be responsible for partnering closely with functional leaders across Marketing and GTM to develop a shared set of priorities, growth strategy and operational plan. You will ensure our strategy is coordinated and cohesive, and supports our company objectives. As a key partner to Marketing leaders, you will act as a liaison between Marketing and the wider GTM teams, including Sales, GTM Strategy & Planning, and Financial Planning teams.
* In this role you will be required to meet our goals of supporting & optimizing all operations & technology to enable effective marketing at BrowserStack. This role will be a critical partner to the Marketing organisation for leading strategic planning and generating insights that drive Marketing performance.
* You will also conduct and support primary and secondary research projects and create relevant insights on market trends, market sizing, market forecasting, company bench- marking, customer needs, and competition that inform product, customer, and go-to-market strategies.

**What Will You Do?**

* Analyse unstructured, ambiguous and complex challenges facing the organisation making judicious use of qualitative and quantitative data; gather insights, define problems and identify underlying opportunities.
* Make compelling recommendations; develop a tactical plan to execute and translate them into results.
* Design and execute best-in-class quantitative and qualitative research to support decision-making, and strategic planning and shape marketing/brand strategies, campaign development, and product/solutions development
* Develop, implement, and maintain account intelligence strategies to identify profiitable, high-potential accounts, and garnish and retain customer base.
* Strategic Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of market trends, industry developments, and competitive landscapes to provide valuable insights that inform our corporate Strategy and executive decision-making.
* Data-driven Insights: Utilise data analytics and business intelligence tools to extract meaningful insights from various data sources, enabling informed strategic choices at the executive level.
* Market Opportunities: Identify new market opportunities and emerging trends that align with the organization's goals, enabling proactive decision-making to capitaliize on these opportunities.
* Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and analyse competitor activities, market positioning, and product offerings to help the organisation maintain a competitive edge.
* Marketing Database Hygiene: Should be able to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured marketing database/information for maintaining data accuracy by conducting regular data checks/cleansing and should also work on collecting and populating the accurate info for all the missing fields using secondary research, data mining and profile techniques
* Integrate data from multiple sources into a unified intelligence platform, and adjust database management to reflect changes, including adding new contacts and correcting inaccuracies

Conducting quality checks for the data/information collected by the team members before up- loading into salesforce. Preparing reports to ensure all the data is correctly mapped and accurate.
* Own the account, contact and lead enrichment activities along with its reporting and insights

**Desired Experience**

* 6 - 8 years of experience, with a minimum of 5 years in Strategy or Management Consulting, preferably with a leading global consulting firm or in a high-impact Corporate Strategy role within a leading B2B SaaS or technology company.
* At least 5 years experience in Marketing/Sales Strategy, Research roles for Marketing/Sales teams, using secondary and tertiary research methods.
* Must have exposure in SQL to create reports, analyses & insights Knowledge of working with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo,Rocket Reach, Lusha, Traxcn, etc.
* Proven experience in working with ICP identification across different segments and product portfolios.

title: Vice President - Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply and Ad Products, Digital
description:
**Job Summary**
As the Vice President – Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply & Ad Products, you will lead the end-to-end monetization strategy and product innovation for JioHotstar’s Digital Entertainment Ads business. The role will drive revenue growth through strategic pricing, supply planning, yield optimization, programmatic partnerships and the development of scalable advertising solutions.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of product, technology, sales and monetization, translating market opportunities and advertiser needs into innovative ad products and commercially impactful solutions.
  
  
**About The Team**
JioHotstar, under the JioStar umbrella, is India’s leading streaming platform, bringing together premium video content, live sports and entertainment at scale.
  
  
The Entertainment Product & Revenue Strategy (PRS) function plays a critical role in shaping the monetization of entertainment content. The team is responsible for pricing and packaging ad inventory, optimizing yield, strengthening supply architecture and introducing innovative advertising solutions that drive sustainable revenue growth for JioHotstar and deliver on customers changing objectives.
  
  
The function works closely with Product, Engineering, Ad Operations, Business Intelligence and Sales teams to build scalable solutions and strengthen JioHotstar’s position in the digital advertising ecosystem.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monetization, Pricing & Supply Strategy
* Lead the pricing, planning and monetization strategy for the Digital Entertainment Ads business.
* Drive supply planning, inventory optimization and yield management to maximize revenue potential.
* Develop pricing frameworks, packaging strategies and commercial propositions aligned with advertiser needs and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve monetization across devices, formats, audiences and content environments.
* Ad Product Innovation & Roadmap
* Own the roadmap for advertising offerings across devices and platforms, ensuring JioHotstar’s ad solutions remain competitive and future-ready.
* Drive the development and launch of innovative ad products, formats, targeting capabilities and advertising experiences.
* Translate market trends, advertiser requirements and business opportunities into scalable product initiatives.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to define priorities, manage dependencies and ensure timely execution.
* Programmatic Monetization & AdTech Partnerships
* Drive programmatic monetization strategy, including partnerships across DSPs, SSPs, exchanges and other ecosystem participants.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen programmatic yield, supply access and private marketplace offerings.
* Evaluate and enable new advertising technologies, monetization models and ecosystem partnerships.
* Ensure alignment between programmatic initiatives, commercial objectives and operational capabilities.
* Cross-Functional Execution
* Lead a high-performing team of individual contributors driving ad technology and product initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI teams to deliver business-critical initiatives.
* Coordinate pilots, A/B testing, feedback loops and phased rollouts to validate solutions before scaling.
* Proactively identify risks, resolve execution roadblocks and ensure effective stakeholder alignment.
* Sales Enablement & Commercial Solutions
* Partner with Sales teams to develop and commercialize packaged propositions, custom solutions and strategic advertising offerings.
* Support strategic deals by translating product capabilities into compelling advertiser solutions.
* Work with relevant teams to resolve initial technology or implementation challenges and ensure smooth adoption.
* Enable Sales teams with clear positioning, product understanding and commercial use cases.
* Leadership & Governance
* Provide concise and structured updates to senior leadership on program progress, key decisions, dependencies and risks.
* Establish effective governance mechanisms to track priorities, milestones and business outcomes.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration and execution excellence within the team.
* Influence senior stakeholders across business, product and technology functions to drive outcomes in a complex and evolving environment.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with 12–15 years of experience in digital media, AdTech, programmatic advertising, product strategy, monetization, pricing or revenue strategy roles or management consulting experience.
* Strong people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

○ Ad product development and innovation
  
  
○ Pricing and packaging
  
  
○ Programmatic monetization
  
  
○ Yield and inventory management
  
  
○ New advertising formats and experiences
  
  

* Deep understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, header bidding, private marketplaces and targeting will be preferred.
* Experience in digital video advertising, connected TV, streaming platforms or entertainment monetization will be an advantage.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate product and monetization levers into measurable revenue impact.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Structured problem-solving approach, strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational rigour.

title: Sr. Manager - SEO & Content
description:
**About Pixelo Digital**

Pixelo Digital is a B2B growth and GTM company helping technology businesses generate pipeline, conversations and revenue. We work across outbound, ABM, intent-led campaigns, performance marketing, SEO, content and data-driven GTM. We’ve worked with 250+ brands across technology, SaaS and enterprise, and we’re building a brand around one simple idea:

**Great marketing should create business impact.**

Alongside our services, we’re building Prospectoo, our B2B GTM intelligence platform, to help businesses identify, engage and convert their ideal customers more effectively.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-focused Senior Manager – SEO & Growth to lead organic growth, search visibility and website performance for Pixelo Digital and Prospectoo.

This role goes beyond improving keyword rankings or driving website traffic. You’ll be responsible for building a scalable organic growth engine that attracts the right audiences, strengthens brand authority, generates qualified leads and contributes to pipeline and revenue.

You’ll own the SEO strategy across technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO and programmatic SEO, while expanding our visibility across AI-powered search through Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).

Working closely with content, marketing, product, sales and leadership teams, you’ll combine data-driven decision-making with hands-on execution to identify growth opportunities, improve website conversions and turn organic visibility into measurable business outcomes.

You’ll work across the entire organic growth journey:

Research → Strategy → Optimisation → Visibility → Acquisition → Conversion → Pipeline

**What You'll Do:**

**SEO Strategy & Organic Growth**

• Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with business objectives, target audiences, ICPs and GTM priorities.

• Own organic growth across technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, content SEO and programmatic SEO.

• Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor benchmarking and content gap analysis to identify high-impact growth opportunities.

• Build keyword clusters, topic clusters, pillar pages and search-led content strategies to strengthen topical authority.

• Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic quality, keyword rankings, search visibility and qualified lead generation.

• Develop scalable SEO processes that support growth across Pixelo Digital, Prospectoo and relevant service or product categories.

**Technical SEO & Website Optimisation**

• Conduct technical SEO audits to identify and resolve issues related to crawlability, indexability, site architecture, redirects, canonicalisation, duplicate content and XML sitemaps.

• Optimise website structure, internal linking, URL architecture, metadata, schema markup and page performance.

• Collaborate with developers and website teams to improve Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed and technical search performance.

• Monitor website health, identify indexing issues and implement corrective actions to maintain search engine accessibility.

• Build and optimise landing pages, service pages, solution pages and product pages to improve search visibility and user experience.

• Identify opportunities for conversion rate optimisation (CRO) through landing page experiments, user journey analysis and on-page improvements.

**AEO, GEO & AI-Powered Search**

• Develop strategies to improve brand visibility across AI-powered search experiences, answer engines and generative search platforms.

• Optimise content for Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), featured snippets, rich results and relevant search features.

• Structure content to improve clarity, topical relevance, entity understanding and discoverability across traditional and AI-powered search.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen brand mentions, authoritative citations and visibility in relevant AI-generated answers.

• Monitor changes in search behaviour, zero-click searches and AI-driven discovery to adapt organic growth strategies.

• Experiment with emerging optimisation techniques and measure their impact on brand discovery, qualified traffic and conversions.

**Content SEO & Organic Demand Generation**

• Collaborate with content and subject matter experts to develop search-led blogs, landing pages, comparison pages, use cases, case studies and thought leadership content.

• Translate keyword research and search intent into actionable content briefs, page structures, content recommendations and editorial priorities.

• Identify opportunities to capture high-intent searches through solution-led, industry-specific, competitor comparison and bottom-of-funnel content.

• Optimise existing content to improve rankings, relevance, engagement, freshness and conversion potential.

• Build content strategies around buyer pain points, ICPs, industry trends and high-value search opportunities.

• Align SEO initiatives with broader content marketing and demand generation efforts to drive qualified organic leads.

**Off-Page SEO & Authority Building**

• Develop ethical link-building and digital PR strategies to strengthen domain authority and search visibility.

• Identify relevant websites, industry publications, partner platforms and authoritative sources for backlink opportunities.

• Build strategies for earning high-quality backlinks through original research, industry insights, thought leadership and link-worthy content.

• Monitor backlink profiles, identify potentially harmful links and address off-page SEO risks where necessary.

• Work with content, partnerships and marketing teams to strengthen brand credibility and authority across relevant industry ecosystems.

**Programmatic SEO & Scalable Growth**

• Identify opportunities to build scalable, search-led landing pages around relevant industries, use cases, solutions, integrations and customer segments.

• Develop programmatic SEO strategies that balance scale, search intent, content quality and genuine user value.

• Collaborate with product, engineering and content teams to implement scalable page templates, structured data and internal linking systems.

• Establish quality controls to avoid thin, duplicative or low-value pages that could negatively affect search performance.

• Evaluate opportunities to use automation and AI to streamline keyword clustering, content briefs, SEO analysis and optimisation workflows.

**Website Analytics & Conversion Optimisation**

• Own organic search reporting and track performance across traffic, impressions, clicks, rankings, engagement, conversions and qualified leads.

• Use analytics and search performance data to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance drops and prioritise optimisation initiatives.

• Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure organic acquisition, landing page performance, lead generation and pipeline contribution.

• Work with marketing and sales teams to understand lead quality and connect organic acquisition efforts with business outcomes.

• Conduct experiments on page layouts, calls to action, messaging, internal linking and conversion paths to improve website performance.

**Growth Strategy, AI & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

• Identify growth opportunities through competitor analysis, market research, customer insights and emerging search trends.

• Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve SEO research, reporting, content workflows and operational efficiency.

• Work closely with content, product, development, marketing and sales teams to align organic growth initiatives with broader GTM objectives.

• Collaborate with leadership to define growth priorities, allocate resources and establish measurable performance targets.

**Key Tools You’ll Work With**

• SEO & Keyword Research: Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console and relevant keyword research platforms.

• Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Looker Studio, Google Tag Manager and performance dashboards.

• Technical SEO: Screaming Frog SEO Spider, site auditing tools, PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals reporting.

• AEO, GEO & AI Search: AI-powered research and content tools, AI search visibility monitoring platforms and relevant structured data tools.

• Content & Optimisation: Content optimisation platforms, CMS tools, keyword clustering and content auditing tools.

• Website & Conversion Optimisation: WordPress or relevant CMS platforms, landing page testing tools, heatmaps and CRO analytics.

• AI & Automation: Generative AI tools and workflow automation platforms for research, analysis, reporting and optimisation.

**What We’re Looking For**

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Communications or a related field.

• 6–9 years of experience in SEO, organic growth, search marketing or digital growth roles, preferably within B2B SaaS, technology or IT services.

• Proven experience developing and executing SEO strategies that improve organic visibility, qualified traffic, lead generation and business performance.

• Strong hands-on expertise in technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, keyword research, site architecture and website audits.

• Practical understanding of AEO, GEO, AI-powered search experiences, structured data and evolving search discovery patterns.

• Experience with programmatic SEO, scalable landing page strategies and large-scale website optimisation is a plus.

• Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush and technical SEO auditing platforms.

• Ability to analyse SEO and website performance data, identify actionable insights and build measurable growth plans.

• Understanding of conversion rate optimisation, lead generation funnels, ICPs, buyer journeys and B2B demand generation.

• Experience using AI-powered tools and automation to improve SEO research, content workflows and reporting.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company:**

RMH & Group

**Location:**

Mumbai

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Work Mode:**

On-site

**Experience:**

2–4 years

**About RMH Advisors & Group**

RMH & Group is a growing professional services organisation. We are looking for a proactive, creative, and outcome-focused Digital Marketing Executive who can independently manage our digital presence, generate business leads, and strengthen our brand visibility.

**Role Overview:**

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role suited for someone who enjoys taking ownership from planning to execution. You will be responsible for managing digital marketing activities end-to-end, including social media, content creation, website updates, campaigns, lead generation, and performance tracking.

We are looking for a smart, resourceful, and self-driven professional who can work independently, experiment with new ideas, and deliver measurable results without requiring extensive supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Marketing & Strategy**

* Plan and execute digital marketing activities aligned with business objectives.
* Develop monthly content calendars and campaign plans.
* Identify relevant digital channels and opportunities to improve brand awareness and lead generation.
* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, competitor activities, and industry developments.

**2. Social Media Management**

* Manage the company's social media presence across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook.
* Create engaging posts, carousels, short-form videos, and other digital content.
* Write compelling captions, copy, and calls to action.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and posting schedule.
* Monitor engagement, respond to relevant interactions, and improve content performance.

**3. Content Creation & Brand Communication**

* Create marketing content for the company's services, offerings, achievements, and industry insights.
* Work with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into engaging content.
* Design creatives using tools such as Canva and coordinate external support when necessary.
* Ensure all content is accurate, professional, and aligned with the company's brand identity.

**4. Lead Generation & Campaign Management**

* Plan and execute digital campaigns to generate relevant business enquiries and leads.
* Support lead generation through organic social media, email marketing, landing pages, and paid campaigns, as applicable.
* Set up and monitor Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns where relevant.
* Track incoming leads, campaign performance, and conversion opportunities.
* Explore cost-effective marketing initiatives suited to an SME environment.

**5. Website & SEO Management**

* Maintain website content, service pages, blogs, and other relevant updates.
* Implement basic SEO practices, including keyword research, on-page optimisation, and content optimisation.
* Monitor website traffic, search performance, and visitor behaviour using tools such as Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Identify opportunities to improve website visibility, traffic quality, and enquiry generation.

**6. Email Marketing & Marketing Collateral**

* Create and execute email campaigns, newsletters, and business communication materials.
* Develop brochures, presentations, service profiles, and other marketing collateral.
* Support campaigns for client acquisition, business updates, and brand-building initiatives.

**7. Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Track and report key marketing metrics, including reach, engagement, website traffic, leads, and campaign conversions.
* Prepare simple monthly performance reports with actionable insights.
* Identify what is working, what is not, and what needs to change.
* Recommend improvements based on data, audience behaviour, and business priorities.

**8. Ownership & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work directly with management to understand business priorities and marketing requirements.
* Manage the complete execution cycle, from ideation and planning to publishing and reporting.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, or external agencies when required.
* Take ownership of timelines, deliverables, and the quality of work.
* Be comfortable working in a lean team, managing multiple priorities, and finding practical solutions with available resources.

**What we are looking for:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, preferably in an SME, startup, consulting, or professional services environment.
* Strong working knowledge of social media marketing, content creation, SEO, and digital campaign execution.
* Ability to independently create content, manage campaigns, and track results.
* Familiarity with Canva and tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite, and email marketing platforms.
* Basic understanding of paid advertising, audience targeting, and lead generation.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and attention to detail.
* A proactive, resourceful, and outcome-oriented approach.
* Ability to manage multiple activities without constant follow-up or supervision.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A consistent and professional digital presence for RMH & Group.
* Improved brand visibility and audience engagement across relevant platforms.
* Regular execution of planned marketing activities and campaigns.
* A measurable contribution to qualified business enquiries and lead generation.
* Improved website visibility, content quality, and campaign performance.
* Clear reporting, timely execution, and continuous improvement in marketing outcomes.

﻿

**Important to Know about this role:**

This is an
**individual contributor position**

, not a team management role. The selected candidate is expected to personally execute the work, take initiative, and manage day-to-day digital marketing activities independently.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically but is equally comfortable writing a post, designing a creative, updating a website, running a campaign, and analysing its results.

**If you are someone who enjoys taking ownership, learning quickly, and making a visible business impact, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Social Media Lead (Podcasts)
description:
**The Attention Co. | Marol, Mumbai | Full-time, In-office**

About Us

The Attention Co. is a content and personal branding studio working across podcasts, digital content, and audience growth. We work with founders, leaders, creators, and experts to bring meaningful conversations to a wider audience.

We’re looking for a Social Media Lead who enjoys podcasts as a medium and wants to help build shows people choose to spend time with.

About the Role

You should already listen to English-language podcasts out of curiosity. You have favourite shows, remember conversations that changed your thinking, and enjoy discovering people with something worthwhile to say.

Our work centres on thoughtful conversations about business, science, health, psychology, culture, and how people live and work. You should enjoy finding the story, question, or practical insight that makes a conversation worth someone’s attention.

You’ll bring that judgment to content planning, clip selection, creative briefs, writing, publishing, and audience growth. You’ll work closely with the founder, producers, researchers, editors, and designers to help each show find its audience.

What You’ll Do

* **Understand the conversation:**
  Watch full episodes, follow the ideas, and identify what makes each guest and discussion interesting.
* **Find strong moments:**
  Select clips with a compelling opening, enough context to stand alone, and a clear insight or payoff. Preserve what the speaker means.
* **Plan episode releases:**
  Build campaigns across trailers, Reels, Shorts, carousels, Stories, and full-episode promotion.
* **Guide the creative team:**
  Brief editors and designers clearly, review their work, and give specific feedback on storytelling, pacing, captions, and visuals.
* **Write and package content:**
  Develop hooks, captions, titles, descriptions, and thumbnail ideas that make people curious and accurately represent the conversation.
* **Own publishing:**
  Maintain calendars, coordinate approvals, and keep content moving consistently across Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
* **Understand the audience:**
  Read comments, study viewing behaviour, and identify the questions and ideas people respond to.
* **Improve through experimentation:**
  Test formats and packaging, review results, and use what you learn to shape future content.

Who We’re Looking For

**A real interest in thoughtful English-language podcasts is essential.**
You should be able to talk about what you listen to, why you return to certain shows, and what makes a conversation work.

Beyond that, we’re looking for someone who:

* Is curious about people and ideas, asks good questions, and enjoys learning.
* Can recognise a useful insight, an unexpected perspective, or a story worth exploring.
* Writes clear, engaging English and can simplify an idea without losing its meaning.
* Has experience taking responsibility for content or social media projects.
* Is organised, dependable, and comfortable coordinating with a creative team.
* Takes feedback well and is willing to build their skills in analytics, packaging, and distribution.

Experience with podcasts, YouTube channels, editorial content, or creator-led brands would be useful. Your judgment, curiosity, and willingness to take ownership matter more than knowing every tool.

What Success Looks Like

Each show has a recognisable voice and a clear reason for people to watch. Strong ideas become well-chosen clips and thoughtful campaigns. Publishing is dependable, creative feedback is useful, and audience insights improve what we make next.

People discover a short clip, become interested in the conversation, and return for more.

title: Product Marketing Lead - iPhone, Wearables & Home
description:
**Summary**
As a member of our Product Marketing group, you’ll represent the customer throughout a product’s journey from concept through development and launch. You’ll develop and apply insights to help infuse innovative features into our product-development process. Together with our team, you’ll work to craft groundbreaking ideas into tangible products that excite the world.
  
  
At Apple, we combine product management/development and product marketing responsibilities into a single, cross functional Product Management role that collaborates with design, engineering, finance, legal, marketing communications, public relations, market research, sales and support for maximum impact across the organization.
  
  
**Description**
Apple is looking for a dynamic and highly motivated Product Marketing Manager who will be responsible to lead Product Marketing for iPhone, Wearables and Home products in India. In this role, you will lead a team of product managers and have product line responsibilities for iPhone. The lead will own and drive Apple's product-centric marketing strategy for the iPhone, Wearables and Home portfolio of products, articulating the market ambition to deliver growth and category leadership. You will also lead the Technical Product Marketing Manager to provide technical support to the launch and momentum activities of all the Apple products. This role is an active member of the Product Marketing and Geo Leadership teams.
  
  
Key attributes of this role include the continuous improvement of product launches, comprehensive business and market analytics across categories, instinctive insights and the discipline to focus and deliver excellent results. In this role you will partner closely with the local PR, Marcom, Sales, Finance, Developer Relations, Services, Engineering and WW stakeholders in Cupertino to shape the opportunity ahead and to define and communicate country unique requirements for current and future products.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a proven leader with a strong passion for Apple products, desire to win, curiosity to be better, ability to navigate ambiguity, finesse and craft for product storytelling, creative and innovative problem solving, motivation to inspire others, and to build strong and lasting relationships throughout the organisation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Articulate the product opportunities in the market and provide product insight and leadership to both the Marketing and Sales organisations
* Own and drive the annual Marketing plan for products in the remit, outlining opportunity and actions that lead growth and category leadership, instilling quarterly and half-yearly reviews to evaluate deliverables, performance and learnings
* Lead the team to deliver product launches and momentum activities with excellence every time; be the guardian of product messaging and positioning at every customer touchpoint
* Act as the primary liaison between the market, Worldwide teams and Engineering for all local business needs and feature requirements, shaping strategies and contributing to global initiatives and programs
* Influence product feature roadmaps, and make clear recommendations that improve the customer experience
* Devise and craft a singular market narrative that enables clear understanding of market dynamics, customer voice, and opportunity, setting actions that all key stakeholders understand
* Create competitive and breakthrough strategies that show a clear connection between vision and action
* Introduce new ways of looking at problems and encourage diverse thinking to promote and nurture innovation
* Plan and prioritise work to align with broader organisational goals; use knowledge of business drivers and how strategies/tactics play out in the market to guide actions
* Build high-performing teams through coaching and developing talent. Actively foster an inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and cultures, and develop a strong bench of product marketing managers

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 15+ years experience in product management and marketing
* Experience working for/or with a global organisation in technology or related fields

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Business analytics and strategic product management experience with deep knowledge of the the India mobile and wearable space as a plus
* Strategic planning expertise
* Technical fluency, with the ability to translate features into customer benefits and vice versa
* Curiosity, a passion for excellence, ability to ask the right questions, and the love of working as part of a team
* Experience leading and developing a team of product marketeers
* Ability to continually prioritise and multi-task in a dynamic, creative, fast paced environment
* Strong storytelling, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a track record of aligning partners and internal teams around a shared plan
* Highly collaborative with exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills
* Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail
* Superior storytelling capabilities
* Instinctive ability to be the voice of the customer
* Depth of technical awareness
* Travel is required (20-25% estimated)
* BS/BA or equivalent experience; MS/MA/MBA a plus

description:

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
Within Danaher the work our Diagnostic businesses do saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

We’re accelerating the development of cutting-edge diagnostics to solve some of the world’s most pressing health challenges. Across our diagnostics operating companies we are driving innovation through partnerships with top academic institutions and leading players in biopharma and translational research. We’re bringing the best minds together to accelerate innovation and unlock the full potential of the latest scientific advances. Together, we’re expanding access to precision diagnostics for millions of people worldwide - and we’re using our unmatched global scale and proven playbook to make it happen, from hospital labs to mobile clinics. By helping providers, patients, and families get faster, more precise diagnostic results, we’re improving treatment options and saving lives.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
**Strategic Marketing Leader – Diagnostics Platform India**
is responsible for developing and driving the
**India Diagnostics platform strategy**
across Operating Companies (OpCos). This role leads upstream strategic marketing, providing market, portfolio, and growth direction to accelerate sustainable performance across the Diagnostics platform in India.
  
  
This position reports to the
**Vice President, Diagnostics Platform, India**
and is part of the
**Diagnostics group at the Danaher Corporation**
, located in
**Mumbai or Bengaluru**
, and will be an on‑site role.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Lead strategic marketing for the India Diagnostics platform, defining market, portfolio, and growth priorities aligned with regional and global Diagnostics strategies.
* Own upstream marketing and market strategy, including market assessment, segmentation, competitive landscape analysis, policy and regulatory impact, and emerging technology trends.
* Partner with OpCo marketing, sales, and commercial leaders to translate platform strategy into aligned operating company priorities and execution plans.
* Lead Diagnostics platform strategic planning processes in India, including annual strategy development and multi‑OpCo alignment.
* Identify and accelerate cross‑OpCo growth opportunities through platform collaboration forums, strategic initiatives, and selected external partnerships.

* Proven experience influencing senior stakeholders across matrixed, cross‑company environments.

title: Performance Marketing at Dhan
description:
**Role Summary:**

Raise is built on this core philosophy — we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user experience and best-in-class customer service to our users.

We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021. Today, Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026, Dhan was also recognised as
**Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

We are looking for a
**Performance Marketing professional**
who can own and scale Dhan’s paid acquisition engine. The role will focus on acquiring high-quality users at scale, improving campaign efficiency and building a strong understanding of the relationship between acquisition, activation, customer quality and business outcomes.

This is a
**hands-on, high-ownership role**
for someone who is comfortable working with numbers, experimenting continuously and making decisions based on data. You will work closely with Growth, Product, Data, Creative, Content and Business teams to identify opportunities, test new ideas and scale what works. The role will focus on the complete paid acquisition journey — from campaign planning and user acquisition to activation, conversion and customer value.

**Expected Responsibilities:**

* Own and execute Dhan’s performance marketing strategy across Google Ads, Meta, YouTube and other relevant digital acquisition channels.
* Plan, launch, monitor and optimise campaigns and other paid channels.
* Drive scalable mobile app acquisition, with a strong focus on acquiring high-quality users rather than simply maximising installs.
* Build and optimise full-funnel acquisition campaigns aligned to business objectives across app installs, registrations, KYC, activation, first transaction and subsequent user engagement.
* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, allocation and pacing to maximise growth, efficiency and ROI.
* Track and optimise campaigns against key metrics, analyse the complete acquisition funnel and identify opportunities to improve conversion, user quality and marketing economics.
* Develop audience segmentation and targeting strategies across prospecting, retargeting, lookalikes and high-value user cohorts.
* Drive structured A/B testing and experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, campaign structures and landing experiences.
* Work closely with Creative, Content and Design teams to develop, test and scale high-performing performance creatives and communication.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify new opportunities and improve Dhan’s acquisition strategy.
* Build regular performance dashboards and reports, translating campaign data into clear insights, actions and recommendations for the Growth and leadership teams.
* Work closely with Product, Data/BI, Growth, Content and Business teams to improve the overall acquisition and conversion funnel.

**Expected Skills:**

* 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing, preferably with strong exposure to mobile app acquisition and consumer internet businesses.
* Proven experience in managing and scaling performance campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads, with hands-on ownership of campaign execution and optimisation.
* Strong understanding of mobile app acquisition, user funnels and performance marketing metrics, and conversion rates.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget allocation, retargeting and funnel optimisation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify the reason behind performance changes and take corrective action.
* Good proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and reporting/dash-boarding tools.
* Prior experience in Fintech, BFSI, will be an advantage.
* Strong ownership mindset with a bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

**We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and demonstrate following personality traits:**

**• Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

**• We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product, uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

**• Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

**• Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

**• Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

**• Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

**• Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

**• Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

**• Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

**• Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

**• Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**• Raise is an equal opportunity employer.**

(We celebrate diversity and inclusion.

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a
**Great Place to Work**
for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers.

Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform. Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Stratzy, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible

**Our philosophy is simple:**

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

**Location:**
Goregaon West, Mumbai

**Explore More:**

* Connect with us: www.raiseholding.co
* Learn more about our Investing & Trading Platform – www.dhan.co
* Follow our Instagram page
  **#LifeatRaise**
  for a glimpse into our people and latest culture happenings.

**Apply for the Role:**

If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech ecosystems, we would love to hear from you.

Send your resume to: careers@dhan.co

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

We are a self-funded jewelry group selling direct to consumers in the US, with a strong B2B business

behind it. Our customers are entirely US-based.

Manufacturing is in-house, so we control product, margin and speed. With no VC money, there is no

pressure to buy growth at any cost. We grow sensibly and keep what works.

We run several distinct consumer brands at different price points. We are now building a central growth

team in Mumbai that will run marketing across most of them.

The role

You will own paid acquisition for one or more of our US brands, mainly on paid channels: Meta, Google,

TikTok, Pinterest etc. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, but we are not hiring someone to

just push buttons.

Platforms automate most of the old legwork: bidding, placements, even audience targeting. What they

cannot do is understand the customer, decide what to say to them, or tell real growth from noise in the

reporting. That is the job.

We want someone who asks why a number moved before acting on it. They should know what a

creative is actually doing for a campaign, and how audiences shape results.

What you'll do

• Plan, run and scale paid campaigns on Meta and Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max),

with clear hypotheses behind each change.

• Understand and identify other channels with opportunities to acquire customers efficiently

• Judge creative on what it does for the campaign: the hook, the message and the offer. Platform

specs are the easy part. Brief the creative team on what to make next and why.

• Think about audiences: who you are reaching, who you are paying to reach again, and what that

does to reported results.

• Separate cause from correlation. Question platform-reported ROAS, and use blended metrics,

holdouts and simple tests to find out what is really driving revenue.

• Use Shopify and analytics data alongside ad platform data to understand customers, not just

campaigns.

• Share learnings across brands, so one brand's win becomes another's starting point.

- Full-time, individual contributor
- Based in Mumbai
- Reports to Head of the growth team
- Some overlap with US hours, typically not later than 12 AM IST
Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Performance Marketing Manager Profile with D2C/E-commerce background and hands-on paid acquisition experience
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have Minimum 5 yyears of experience in performance marketing
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have experience managing significant budgets on Meta and Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and planning, running, and scaling paid campaigns
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must have hands-on experience with Shopify, analytics tools, and spreadsheets
* Mandatory (Skill 1): Must be able to judge creative performance (hook, message, offer), brief creative teams, and separate cause from correlation using blended metrics, holdouts, and tests
* Mandatory (Skill 2): Must have a working understanding of attribution and incrementality to test platform-reported ROAS
* Mandatory (Communication): Must be proficient in clear written English for working with US-based colleagues and customers
* Mandatory (Domain): Must have experience in D2C or e-commerce brands (in-house or agency side)
* Mandatory (Note): Must be willing to work with some overlap with US hours, typically until 12 AM IST
* Preferred (Domain): Experience with US markets or the jewelry industry
* Preferred (Experience 1): Experience with Shopify stores or considered purchases

Experience: 5–8 years · Work from office · 5 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

Roles & Responsibilities

* Conceptualise and manage social media content and brand assets, including reels, AVs, brand films, campaign videos, customer testimonials and other marketing collaterals.
* Ensure consistency in messaging, visual identity and brand guidelines across all consumer touchpoints.
* Coordinate and plan photoshoots and video shoots to create engaging brand assets.
* Stay on top of emerging social media formats, internet culture and consumer trends to keep the brand relevant and distinctive.

2. Sports, Culture & Real-Time Marketing

* Develop a strong understanding of Indian sports culture, particularly cricket, and international football, including major tournaments, teams, players, rivalries and fan conversations.
* Identify opportunities to connect the brand with sporting moments, match-day rituals, fan behaviour and conversations around major sporting events.
* Conceptualise and execute real-time marketing ideas, social media content and integrated campaigns around relevant sporting and cultural moments.
* Translate sports insights, match-day behaviour and fan conversations into distinctive brand ideas that drive engagement, relevance and consideration.
* Work with creators, sports commentators, fan communities and other relevant partners to build campaigns that connect with sports audiences.

3. Content Strategy & Influencer Collaborations

* Build and manage brands content ecosystem to amplify reach and shape consumer perception.
* Identify, onboard and manage influencers and creators aligned with the brand’s strategy, including food, entertainment, lifestyle and sports creators.
* Develop integrated content campaigns that drive engagement, brand affinity and consideration across digital platforms.

* Monitor brand conversations and consumer sentiment across social media and digital channels.
* Work with in-house ORM teams to manage customer conversations, ensure timely issue resolution and mitigate reputation risks.
* Identify insights from digital chatter, consumer feedback and emerging trends to strengthen brand perception and improve customer experience.

* Create consistent and engaging brand experiences across digital and offline consumer touchpoints.
* Conceptualise and execute activations across college campuses, offices, sporting occasions and other relevant consumer spaces.

title: Brand Manager: Castrol Activ
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
As the Brand & Product Lead for Castrol Activ, you will shape the growth of the brand, with end-to-end responsibility across brand, product portfolio and commercial performance.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Insights and regional/global Marketing teams to translate consumer and market opportunities into winning brand and product plans.
  
  
On the product side, you will lead the Activ portfolio across its lifecycle, identifying opportunities for innovation and portfolio optimization. You will balance consumer needs, competitive positioning, pricing, cost and gross margin considerations to build a stronger and more future-ready portfolio.
  
  
On the brand side, you will shape and innovate the brand in line with evolving trends and consumer needs, translating the brand proposition into compelling campaigns and activation across ATL, digital, BTL and other consumer touchpoints.
  
  
Overall, the role combines brand building, portfolio strategy, commercial ownership and execution to drive the next phase of growth for Castrol Activ.
  
  
**Key tasks:**

* Own the business and financial performance of Castrol Activ, delivering targeted volume, revenue and gross margin objectives.
* Lead the Activ portfolio across both bikes and scooter engine oils, defining the role and growth agenda for the portfolio.
* Develop and execute the brand and portfolio strategy, balancing near-term business priorities with long-term growth opportunities.
* Lead the product lifecycle, innovation and portfolio optimization, responding to evolving consumer needs, market trends and OEM developments.
* Innovate and strengthen the Activ brand in line with emerging consumer and category trends, ensuring continued relevance and differentiation.
* Drive market share and brand equity performance, using consumer insights and other relevant market and brand health indicators to identify opportunities and actions.
* Lead the development and execution of integrated brand communication across ATL, digital, media, BTL and consumer activation.
* Partner closely with Sales and Channel Marketing to translate brand and portfolio strategy into strong regional, channel and in-market execution.
* Lead key product development and commercialization processes, working cross-functionally with R&D, Supply Chain, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Own ASP investment planning and effectiveness, including budget allocation, expenditure tracking and measurement of returns.
* Lead relationships with creative, media, research and other agency partners, ensuring high-quality execution against brand and business objectives.

**Experience required:**

* University degree in Engineering, Marketing, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification desirable.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant Sales and/or Marketing experience, ideally covering brand, product or portfolio management.
* Demonstrated experience in brand strategy, portfolio management, innovation and commercialization.
* Strong understanding of integrated marketing communications across traditional and digital channels.
* Strong commercial orientation, with the ability to connect consumer and brand strategy with volume, pricing, margin and business performance.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence multiple internal and external stakeholders.

We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.

title: Marketing Manager - Real Estate
