title: Manager - Marketing, Colors
description:
**About the Team**

Colors is a leading Hindi General Entertainment Channel (GEC) within JioStar’s entertainment portfolio. The marketing team plays a key role in building show awareness, strengthening audience engagement and driving viewership through insight-led campaigns and integrated brand communication.

Working at the intersection of content, creativity, consumer understanding and media, the team partners with internal stakeholders and external agencies to bring show narratives to life, build audience connect and sustain the visibility of the Colors portfolio across television and digital platforms.

**About the Role**

The Manager – Marketing will be responsible for planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns for assigned shows on Colors, spanning new show launches, ongoing sustenance and key programming milestones. The role requires a strong understanding of consumer behaviour, creative communication and media effectiveness to translate content propositions into compelling campaigns that build awareness, drive audience interest and support viewership objectives.

The individual will work closely with content, creative, digital, media and distribution teams to develop campaign strategies, deliver impactful communication and maintain consistent visibility for shows throughout their lifecycle. The role calls for a balance of strategic thinking, creative judgement, executional rigour and a performance-oriented approach to marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Show Launch Strategy & Integrated Campaign Execution**

* Develop and execute end-to-end marketing plans for new show launches, translating the show's premise, audience proposition and key differentiators into compelling consumer-facing communication.
* Build integrated campaign plans across television, OTT, digital, social media, print, outdoor advertising (OOH), public relations and on-ground activations, as relevant to the campaign objectives.
* Develop creative briefs, key visuals (KVs), messaging frameworks and campaign narratives in collaboration with creative and communication partners.
* Ensure the timely development and rollout of promos, campaign assets, internal branding and supporting communication across relevant platforms.
* Identify opportunities for innovative campaign formats, partnerships and audience touchpoints that can strengthen show awareness and distinctiveness.

**2. Consumer Insights & Marketing Strategy**

* Translate consumer research, audience behaviour, cultural trends and content insights into actionable marketing strategies and campaign ideas.
* Understand the target audience, viewing motivations and competitive landscape to sharpen show positioning, messaging and campaign relevance.
* Work with research and insights teams to identify audience opportunities, assess consumer perceptions and inform campaign planning.
* Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen audience interest, alongside potential risks to show visibility or engagement, and recommend appropriate marketing interventions.

**3. Show Sustenance & Portfolio Management**

* Develop proactive sustenance plans for assigned shows to maintain audience interest, reinforce show positioning and ensure continued visibility beyond the launch phase.
* Plan creative refreshes and communication interventions around key story developments, programming milestones, talent-led moments and other relevant opportunities.
* Monitor the marketing needs of assigned shows and recommend timely interventions based on audience response, content developments and campaign performance.
* Ensure consistent and coordinated communication across the Colors ecosystem, adapting campaign messaging and assets to suit the requirements of different platforms.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to support the ongoing health and visibility of shows through their lifecycle.

**4. Campaign Performance & Effectiveness**

* Track campaign delivery and performance against defined marketing objectives, identifying opportunities to improve reach, engagement and media effectiveness.
* Conduct post-campaign and post-launch evaluations to capture key learnings, assess the effectiveness of campaign interventions and inform future planning.
* Develop a working understanding of television viewership metrics, including GRPs, reach and time spent viewing (TSV), and use relevant performance indicators to inform marketing decisions.
* Prepare campaign reviews, performance updates and presentations highlighting outcomes, insights and recommendations for optimisation.

**5. Cross-Functional & Agency Management**

* Collaborate with internal teams across Content, Digital, OAP, Graphics, Traffic, Presentation, Sales and Distribution to ensure aligned planning and seamless campaign execution.
* Brief and coordinate with external creative, media, production and research agencies to translate campaign objectives into effective deliverables.
* Manage campaign timelines, creative development, asset delivery and execution dependencies, ensuring quality and consistency across touchpoints.
* Maintain alignment among stakeholders through clear communication, timely follow-ups and effective resolution of executional challenges.

**6. Innovation, AI & Marketing Effectiveness**

* Leverage AI-enabled tools to support creative ideation, copywriting, pitch development, go-to-market (GTM) decks and campaign presentations.
* Explore new formats, consumer touchpoints and marketing approaches that can improve campaign relevance, speed and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to streamline marketing workflows and improve the quality and efficiency of campaign planning and delivery.

**Skills & Attributes for Success**

* **Consumer-first mindset:**
  Ability to understand audience motivations, behaviour and cultural context, and translate these into relevant marketing strategies.
* **Integrated campaign expertise:**
  Experience planning and executing 360-degree campaigns across television, OTT, digital, social media, print, OOH and other relevant channels.
* **Creative judgement:**
  Ability to assess creative ideas, sharpen campaign messaging and ensure communication is distinctive, relevant and aligned with the show's proposition.
* **Executional excellence:**
  Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* **Analytical orientation:**
  Comfort interpreting campaign performance, consumer insights and basic television viewership metrics to inform decisions.
* **Stakeholder management:**
  Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external agencies, aligning multiple partners towards shared objectives.
* **Digital and social media understanding:**
  Awareness of digital platforms, content formats and audience engagement approaches.
* **Innovation and adaptability:**
  Openness to experimenting with new campaign ideas, formats and AI-enabled tools to improve marketing outcomes.
* **Passion for entertainment:**
  Strong interest in Hindi GEC content, television programming, popular culture and evolving audience preferences.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in marketing, brand management, integrated communications, advertising or media.
* Demonstrated experience in planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns, preferably across consumer-facing brands, media, entertainment or content-led businesses.
* Experience working with creative and media agencies, developing campaign briefs and managing end-to-end campaign execution.
* Exposure to campaign performance measurement, consumer research and digital marketing is preferred.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience in television, OTT, entertainment marketing or content-led campaigns.
* Understanding of the Hindi GEC landscape, audience preferences and competitive programming environment.
* Familiarity with television viewership metrics such as GRPs, reach and TSV.
* Experience using AI tools for creative development, research, presentations or marketing workflows.

**Key Collaborations**

* **Internal:**
  Content, Digital, OAP, Graphics, Traffic, Presentation, Sales, Distribution and Research teams.
* **External:**
  Creative agencies, media agencies, production partners and consumer research agencies.

title: Ecommerce Manager
company: Intellectual Capital HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. E-commerce Channel Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata CLiQ, Blinkit, Instamart, Zepto and MARKETPLACE's website, as applicable.
* Ensure catalogue accuracy, listing completeness, pricing accuracy and product availability.
* Monitor listing suppression, Buy Box or equivalent offer visibility, catalogue issues, account health and platform escalations.
* Coordinate new SKU launches, listing updates, content uploads and product information changes.
* Ensure that products are listed correctly and that the right SKUs are available on the right channels.

**B. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Work closely with the Operations team to plan inventory allocation and replenishment across marketplaces and warehouses.
* Monitor stock-outs, excess stock, inventory ageing and demand trends.
* Coordinate purchase-order requirements, inbound stock and marketplace fulfilment requirements.
* Improve inventory visibility and ensure that sales opportunities are not lost due to preventable stock shortages.
* Establish SKU-wise exception reporting and escalation mechanisms.

**C. E-commerce Performance & Commercial Analysis**

* Track sales, units sold, returns, cancellations, availability and other relevant marketplace KPIs.
* Monitor channel-wise and SKU-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve growth.
* Work with the Finance team to understand marketplace fees, discounts, returns, contribution margins and settlement differences.
* Coordinate with performance marketing agencies on advertising requirements, campaign calendars, stock availability and listing readiness.
* Monitor advertising outcomes with agencies and connect campaign activity with overall channel performance.

**D. Quick Commerce & Website**

* Manage operational requirements for quick-commerce platforms, including catalogue setup, assortment, availability, purchase orders, promotional coordination and issue resolution.
* Coordinate website product listings, pricing, product content and operational requirements with the relevant teams and service providers.
* Identify channel-specific opportunities and improve execution across existing and new e-commerce channels.

**E. Team Management & Process Improvement**

* Lead and organise the existing e-commerce/operations team, with clearly defined responsibilities and performance metrics.
* Establish standard operating procedures for listings, inventory allocation, order processing, catalogue updates and marketplace escalations.
* Improve workflows, data accuracy and execution discipline.
* Work with the warehouse and logistics teams to improve dispatch accuracy, fulfilment performance and returns processing.
* Drive process automation and better utilisation of the existing warehouse management and e-commerce systems.

**F. Reporting & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Prepare a regular e-commerce dashboard covering sales, inventory, listing health, stock-outs, returns, cancellations and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Finance on marketplace reconciliation and channel-level performance.
* Work with Marketing on promotions, campaigns, product launches and content requirements.
* Escalate material risks, opportunities and decisions requiring founder intervention.

**Candidate Profile**

* 68 years of experience in e-commerce operations, marketplace management or e-commerce business management.
* Prior experience with a D2C, consumer-products, retail or marketplace-led brand is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Amazon and Flipkart; quick-commerce experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Instamart or Zepto is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, listing health, inventory planning, marketplace operations and account escalations.
* Experience managing teams and coordinating with warehouses, logistics partners, advertising agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, with the ability to interpret SKU-wise and channel-wise performance.
* Familiarity with e-commerce management systems, ERP/WMS tools and marketplace seller portals.
* High ownership, problem-solving ability and willingness to work hands-on in a lean organisation.

**Key Success Measures**

* Improved sales-channel execution and availability.
* Reduction in avoidable stock-outs, listing errors and catalogue issues.
* Accurate SKU mapping, pricing and marketplace content.
* Improved inventory allocation and replenishment discipline.
* Timely resolution of marketplace escalations.
* Better team productivity and standardisation of operating processes.
* Reliable e-commerce dashboards and coordination with Finance and Marketing.

**Role Boundaries**

The E-commerce Manager will own marketplace operations, availability, catalogue hygiene, channel execution and e-commerce performance monitoring. Performance marketing agencies will continue to execute paid advertising, with the Brand & Content Manager owning brand communication and creative strategy.

The E-commerce Manager will work with Operations on warehouse and logistics execution and with Finance on reconciliations and profitability. The role must coordinate these functions without duplicating their core responsibilities.

title: Senior Manager, Account Management (Enterprise)
description:
**About Affinity**

Affinity is pioneering new frontiers in AdTech; developing solutions that push past today’s limits and open new opportunities. We are a global AdTech company helping publishers discover better ways to monetize and enabling advertisers to reach the right audiences through new touch-points. Operating across 10+ markets in Asia, the US, and Europe with a team of over 600 experts, we are building privacy-first ad infrastructure that opens opportunities beyond the walled gardens.

Senior Manager, Account Management, Enterprise

**Work Location:**
Mumbai (Malad)

We are seeking a commercially sharp, relationship-driven Account Manager to own and scale a portfolio of large global enterprise accounts. This is a high-ownership role with significant revenue accountability — you will be the primary custodian of client relationships, revenue growth, and campaign excellence for some of our most strategic partnerships.

The ideal candidate brings deep roots in digital advertising, a data-driven approach to account growth, and the gravitas to engage independently with senior stakeholders at leading brands and agencies globally particularly in the US market.

* Drive revenue retention and growth targets for a portfolio of large global enterprise accounts, identifying and executing scalable upsell and expansion opportunities.

* Monitor budget pacing, forecast revenue performance, and maintain a clear view of account health at all times.
* Develop compelling sales collateral — pitch decks, media plans, business proposals, case studies, and benchmark documents — to support growth conversations.
* Proactively introduce new products and solutions, maximising the breadth and value of Affinity's offering within each account.
* Negotiate commercial terms and campaign parameters with client-side and agency stakeholders.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Reporting teams to ensure seamless campaign execution and delivery.
* Contribute to product and service development by channelling client feedback and market insights into actionable recommendations.

**Required Skills:**

* 7+ years of account management or business development experience in the digital advertising industry, with a clear track record of growing revenue through enterprise accounts.
* Strong command of digital advertising metrics — CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and revenue margins — and the analytical ability to turn performance data into actionable client recommendations.
* Well-connected within the digital ecosystem, particularly with brands, advertisers, and media agencies.
* Proven ability to build and present to senior global stakeholders independently.
* Experience creating sales enablement assets including pitch decks, case studies, and vertical-specific sales narratives.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel (complex formulas, pivot tables, performance trackers) and PowerPoint for client-facing presentations.
* Structured thinker capable of building and streamlining internal processes across Sales and Operations functions.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to present creative and strategic work with clarity and confidence.

title: Digital Marketing Lead
description:
**Job Title – Digital Marketing Lead**
EC-Council is the world's largest cybersecurity technical certification body. Operating in over 170 countries, we are the owner and developer of globally recognized cybersecurity certification programs. We have trained and certified more than 400,000 information security professionals worldwide, helping shape the global cybersecurity workforce.
  
  
www.eccouncil.org
  
  
**Role Overview**
As Digital Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for executing day-to-day digital marketing activities across organic and owned channels. Working within the marketing strategy and direction set by leadership, you will translate plans into consistent, high-quality execution across social media, email, content, community, and events. This is an execution-focused role for a proactive and independent professional who can take a brief from concept through to delivery, ensuring work is completed to a high standard and on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Social Media**

* Manage social media channels end-to-end, including content creation, publishing, scheduling, and ORM.
* Monitor channel performance and identify opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and follower growth.

**Email Marketing & HubSpot**

* Execute email marketing through HubSpot, including nurture campaigns, newsletters, announcements, promotional campaigns, and event communications.
* Build emails, lists, segmentation, workflows, forms, and basic automation within HubSpot.
* Monitor campaign performance and maintain basic reporting on engagement and conversions.

**Content & Publishing**

* Manage and execute marketing content calendar end-to-end.
* Write and edit high-quality B2B content across social media, email, blogs, website pages, testimonials, interviews, and campaigns.
* Adapt content to defined brand voice and audience.
* Publish and schedule approved content across owned channels.
* Keep website content accurate and up to date.

**Creative & AI-Assisted Content Production**

* Use AI tools confidently across research, ideation, writing, editing, repurposing, and content production while maintaining quality, accuracy, and brand voice.
* Create and adapt digital marketing creatives for day-to-day requirements.
* Produce basic marketing videos and short-form video content for digital channels.
* Work with EC-Council's design or specialist teams for requirements that need additional creative support.

**Webinars & Lead-Generation Events**

* Plan webinars and lead-generation events.
* Set up registration pages/forms, HubSpot campaigns, attendee workflows, reminder communications, and post-event follow-ups.
* Coordinate with speakers, hosts, and internal teams to ensure events are marketing-ready.
* The role is responsible for event marketing execution and setup rather than hosting or fronting the events.

**Community, Testimonials & Voices**

* Conduct and coordinate interviews with learners, customers, subject-matter experts, and industry contributors.
* Develop an ongoing pipeline of testimonials, customer stories, interviews, and community-led content.
* Manage the day-to-day execution of the Voices contributor program, including contributor coordination, content collection, and publishing.

**SEO, GEO, and Paid Marketing Support**

* Support SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and paid marketing initiatives managed by specialist teams.
* Implement relevant content recommendations and provide campaign assets or support as required.

* 3–4 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with significant experience in producing, building, publishing, and executing marketing activities.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to work within a clearly defined brand voice.
* AI-native approach to marketing, confident using modern AI tools and platforms to improve speed and quality without producing generic or low-quality content.
* Strong working knowledge of social media as a business and marketing channel.
* Hands-on HubSpot experience, particularly with email campaigns, lists, workflows, forms, and basic reporting.
* Strong design capabilities and the ability to independently produce day-to-day digital marketing creatives.
* Ability to create and edit basic marketing videos and short-form video content.
* Experience managing content calendars and publishing across multiple digital channels.
* Basic familiarity with CMS platforms and website content updates.
* Working knowledge of SEO and paid media concepts and terminology.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* High-output, execution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables and deadlines.
* Ability to work independently while taking direction and collaborating effectively with leadership and cross-functional teams.

**Desirable**

* Experience in insurance, cybersecurity, EdTech, professional training, or certification businesses.
* Experience running contributor, advocacy, ambassador, or community-content programs.
* Experience conducting customer, learner, or subject-matter expert interviews.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Search Console, Canva, and other commonly used digital marketing tools.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Marketing Specialist — Lotus Care IN

**Company:**
Lotus Care IN

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Work Mode:**
Remote

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)

**Compensation:**
₹3–10 LPA CTC, including variable pay

Company Description

Lotus Care IN is a premium home care platform that connects families across India with carefully verified and trained care professionals for elderly care, personal care, post-surgery recovery, dementia support, home assistance, and companionship.

The organization is built on the belief that care should feel like family, emphasizing trust, dignity, and human connection rather than transactional interactions. Lotus Care IN serves both families seeking reliable support for aging loved ones and care professionals who want recognition and fair compensation for their expertise.

The platform offers flexible care options, including one-time, recurring, and long-term services, with transparent pricing and continuity of care from familiar caregivers. Lotus Care IN is designed specifically for Indian families, focusing on high-quality, human-centered care in the home environment.

Role Description

The Marketing Specialist is a full-time, remote role responsible for driving brand awareness, customer engagement, and lead generation for Lotus Care IN across digital and offline channels.

The specialist will develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns, create and manage content for social media and other platforms, and support initiatives that connect families and care professionals with the Lotus Care IN platform.

Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting market research, analyzing customer insights, collaborating with sales and operations teams to align messaging, and tracking campaign performance against key metrics. The Marketing Specialist will also strengthen the brand's positioning around trust and family-like care, manage communication with potential customers, and support customer service initiatives to ensure a consistent and positive experience.

The role requires a proactive, results-oriented professional who can work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to the company's growth.

Key Responsibilities

* **Marketing Strategy:**
  Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and engagement.
* **Digital Marketing:**
  Plan and manage campaigns across social media, digital platforms, and other relevant channels.
* **Content Creation:**
  Create compelling, audience-focused content, including social media posts, campaign creatives, blogs, and promotional materials.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Identify opportunities to generate qualified leads from families seeking home care services and potential care professionals.
* **Market Research:**
  Research customer needs, competitor activities, market trends, and opportunities in India's home care sector.
* **Brand Positioning:**
  Communicate Lotus Care IN's core values of trust, dignity, continuity, and compassionate care.
* **Sales and Customer Engagement:**
  Support lead nurturing, customer onboarding, and communication with prospective customers.
* **Campaign Analytics:**
  Monitor campaign performance, analyze key metrics, and recommend improvements to optimize results.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with sales and operations teams to align marketing activities with business objectives.
* **Customer Experience:**
  Support customer communication and service initiatives to ensure a positive and consistent brand experience.

Qualifications and Skills

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences.
* Market research skills, including customer insight gathering, competitor analysis, and trend identification.
* Sales and customer service skills, including lead nurturing, customer onboarding, and empathetic communication.
* Understanding of marketing strategy, audience segmentation, campaign planning, and multichannel marketing.
* Familiarity with digital marketing tools, social media management platforms, and basic analytics tools such as Google Analytics and CRM platforms.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
* A results-oriented mindset with an interest in customer acquisition, brand growth, and performance measurement.
* Experience in healthcare, home care, consumer services, or a related sector is an advantage.
* A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Compensation and Working Schedule

* **Annual CTC:**
  ₹3,00,000–₹10,00,000 per annum (₹3–10 LPA), including variable pay.
* **Working Days:**
  Monday to Saturday, six working days per week.
* **Work Mode:**
  Fully remote.
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time.

The compensation package will be structured based on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, and suitability for the role. The stated CTC includes variable compensation.

Who Should Apply?

* We are looking for a proactive and empathetic marketing professional who can combine strategic thinking, creative execution, customer understanding, and performance analysis to help Lotus Care IN grow. title: Manager Performance Marketing
description:
Job Description

**Manager - Performance Marketing**

**Reporting - Director Sales & Marketing**

**Organisation: NICMAR**

**Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience**

**Location: Mumbai, Work from Office**

**Role Overview**

NICMAR is looking for a data-driven and result-oriented
**Manager - Performance Marketing**
to manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns focused on lead generation, applications, admissions, and revenue growth.

The role will involve working closely with digital marketing agencies, internal admissions teams, creative teams, academic units, and other stakeholders to plan, execute, monitor, and improve performance marketing campaigns across NICMAR’s programmes and business units.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Performance Marketing and Lead Generation**

* Plan and execute performance marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Drive qualified lead generation, applications, and admissions for NICMAR’s academic and executive education programmes.
* Develop campaign strategies based on programme objectives, target audience, geography, admission timelines, and available budgets.
* Continuously optimise campaigns to improve lead quality, conversion rates, cost per lead, cost per application, and cost per admission.
* Manage paid search, paid social, display, remarketing, video, and lead-generation campaigns.
* Identify new digital platforms, audience segments, campaign formats, and growth opportunities.

**Digital Agency Management**

* Work closely with the appointed digital marketing and media agencies for campaign planning, execution, optimisation, and reporting.
* Prepare clear campaign briefs, media plans, audience strategies, performance targets, and deliverable timelines for agencies.
* Review agency recommendations, media plans, keyword strategies, audience targeting, campaign structures, and budget allocations.
* Conduct regular performance review meetings with agencies and ensure timely implementation of agreed action points.
* Monitor agency performance against defined KPIs, deliverables, campaign timelines, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with agencies for tracking implementation, landing-page improvements, campaign creatives, ad copies, and performance reports.
* Ensure that agencies provide transparent, accurate, and actionable campaign data.

**Campaign Analytics and Optimisation**

* Monitor campaign performance daily and identify trends, gaps, and optimisation opportunities.
* Analyse the complete marketing funnel—from impressions and clicks to leads, applications, admissions, and enrolments.
* Evaluate lead quality and conversion performance in collaboration with admissions and sales teams.
* Prepare dashboards and reports covering key metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS, lead-to-application ratio, and application-to-admission ratio.
* Conduct campaign, audience, keyword, creative, landing-page, and geography-level performance analysis.
* Develop attribution and reporting frameworks to assess the contribution of different digital channels.
* Use data and insights to recommend corrective actions and improve campaign outcomes.

**Budget Management**

* Plan and monitor digital advertising budgets across programmes, platforms, campaigns, and locations.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of budgets while maintaining the required campaign scale and lead quality.
* Track planned versus actual expenditure and highlight any deviations.
* Reallocate budgets based on campaign performance, admission priorities, and conversion potential.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and agencies for billing, reconciliation, purchase orders, and campaign expenditure reports.

**Lead Quality and Conversion Coordination**

* Work closely with admissions, sales, CRM, and programme teams to understand lead quality and conversion challenges.
* Establish a regular feedback mechanism between the admissions team and digital agency.
* Analyse lead disposition, calling feedback, source performance, and programme-wise conversion trends.
* Identify issues relating to duplicate leads, invalid leads, low-intent enquiries, incorrect targeting, or delayed lead follow-up.
* Recommend changes in campaign targeting and messaging based on feedback from the admissions funnel.

**Landing Pages, Creatives and Tracking**

* Coordinate the development and optimisation of campaign landing pages, forms, and digital conversion journeys.
* Work with creative and content teams to develop campaign-specific advertisements, videos, banners, and communication assets.
* Conduct A/B testing of campaign creatives, ad copies, calls to action, landing pages, and lead forms.
* Ensure proper implementation of tracking tools, pixels, conversion events, UTM parameters, and analytics platforms.
* Coordinate with website, CRM, technology, and agency teams to address tracking or lead-integration issues.
* Ensure brand consistency across all performance marketing campaigns and digital assets.

**Market and Competitor Analysis**

* Monitor digital marketing activities undertaken by competing institutions and education brands.
* Track emerging trends in higher-education marketing, consumer behaviour, digital platforms, and performance marketing.
* Identify new audience segments, programme positioning opportunities, and campaign innovations.
* Benchmark NICMAR’s digital performance against relevant industry standards and competitors.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Number of qualified leads generated
* Cost per lead and cost per qualified lead
* Lead-to-application conversion rate
* Application-to-admission conversion rate
* Cost per application and cost per admission
* Campaign return on advertising spend
* Lead quality and programme-wise conversion
* Budget utilisation and campaign efficiency
* Agency performance and adherence to timelines
* Accuracy and effectiveness of campaign tracking and reporting

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Digital Marketing, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Digital Marketing, Marketing Analytics, or Business Management will be an advantage.
* Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or similar platform certifications will be preferred.

**Experience and Skills**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, digital advertising, lead generation, or growth marketing.
* Experience in managing digital marketing agencies and evaluating agency performance.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, and Google Tag Manager.
* Experience in managing substantial campaign budgets across multiple platforms and campaigns.
* Strong understanding of campaign funnels, audience targeting, remarketing, attribution, and conversion optimisation.
* Ability to interpret data and translate campaign insights into actionable recommendations.
* Experience with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, and dashboarding tools will be preferred.
* Prior experience in higher education, edtech, executive education, BFSI, real estate, or another lead-driven business will be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, presentation, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple programmes and campaigns simultaneously.

**Key Competencies**

* Performance and outcome orientation
* Analytical and data-driven decision-making
* Agency and stakeholder management
* Budget and campaign governance
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving and ownership
* Commercial and consumer understanding
* Ability to work effectively across functions

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About Foodstories**

Foodstories is India's destination for gourmet food — a curated world of premium farm-fresh produce, artisanal bakery, handcrafted cheeses, single-origin chocolates, exotic spices, global pantry essentials, wellness products, and much more. With nearly half of its offerings freshly prepared in-store, Foodstories places freshness, quality, and authenticity at the heart of the experience.

Each store brings together gourmet retail, all-day dining, specialty coffee, fresh food, and wellness in a contemporary environment designed for discovery. With stores in Mumbai (Bandra, Lokhandwala), Delhi NCR (Vasant Kunj), Hyderabad (Banjara Hills), and Bengaluru (Prestige Sterling Square) — and new locations opening soon — Foodstories is expanding rapidly across India.

Foodstories also reaches customers through its online platform, app, WhatsApp ordering, and personalised phone-based concierge services, creating a seamless omnichannel experience between stores and digital.

Founded by Ashni Biyani and Avni Biyani, Foodstories is built around a shared passion for exceptional ingredients, global food cultures, and elevated experiences.

Visit us: foodstories.shop · LinkedIn

**Role Overview**

The Product Marketing Manager owns the conversion funnel across Foodstories’ app and website — from the moment a visitor lands to the moment they complete a purchase, and every touchpoint in between.

This is a numbers-first role. You will be measured on visitor-to-buyer conversion rate, average order value, revenue per session, and category-level contribution. While you will manage the full online merchandising stack — catalog, product pages, collections, platform listings — the lens is always commercial: every product placement, page layout, and promotional decision is evaluated by its measurable impact on purchase behaviour.

You will sit at the intersection of product, growth, and operations, using data from analytics, A/B tests, and funnel instrumentation to make merchandising decisions that move revenue. The ideal candidate thinks in funnels, speaks in conversion rates, and treats the product catalog as a growth lever, not a content management task.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Conversion Funnel Ownership

* Own the end-to-end visitor-to-buyer conversion rate across app and web; set targets, track daily, and run experiments to move the number.
* Map the full purchase funnel — landing, browse, search, product page, add-to-cart, checkout, payment — and identify the highest-leverage drop-off points.
* Design and run A/B tests on product pages, collection layouts, search ranking, and checkout flow to validate what lifts conversion.
* Build and maintain a weekly conversion dashboard segmented by channel, category, device, and cohort.
* Set up event tracking and funnel instrumentation with analytics and engineering to ensure every decision is backed by data.

2. Product Page & Catalog Optimization

* Manage all product listings across the Foodstories app, website, and third-party platforms (Swiggy, Zomato, and other marketplaces).
* Treat every product page as a conversion asset: optimize titles, descriptions, imagery, pricing display, reviews, and social proof to maximize add-to-cart rate.
* Run regular catalog audits — not just for accuracy, but for conversion impact: which pages underperform their traffic, which categories have high bounce, where does search intent go unmatched.
* Coordinate new product launches, seasonal updates, and discontinuations with a clear pre/post launch measurement plan.
* Ensure product information, pricing, and availability are accurate and consistent across every channel.

3. Merchandising for Revenue

* Own product placement, category structure, homepage real estate, and collection sequencing — decided by conversion and revenue data, not intuition.
* Position best-sellers, high-margin products, and seasonal lines where they will be seen and bought.
* Design and test bundles, cross-sells, add-ons, and recommendation strategies to increase average order value.
* Optimise search and navigation to shorten the path from intent to purchase.
* Recommend changes to product photography, descriptions, and page layout based on heatmaps, scroll depth, and click-through data.

4. Platform Performance Management

* Manage product listings and menu structures across Swiggy, Zomato, the Foodstories website, and any future marketplace channels.
* Track platform-level conversion rates, order volumes, and revenue contribution; identify underperforming platforms and fix them.
* Coordinate with platform account managers to resolve listing issues, negotiate visibility, and execute promotions.
* Monitor product availability, pricing accuracy, and operating hours; ensure promotions and offers are correctly reflected.
* Own the relationship between online availability and actual store/warehouse inventory so out-of-stock rates stay low.

5. Promotions & Campaign Execution

* Plan and execute online promotions, seasonal campaigns, and product launches with clear revenue and conversion targets attached to each.
* Ensure promotional pricing, banners, and product information are updated accurately and on time across all channels.
* Work with marketing and design to develop campaign merchandising — landing pages, curated collections, hero placements — that drive measurable lift.
* Run post-campaign analysis: what converted, what didn’t, what to repeat. Build a playbook over time.
* Support festive, gifting, and new-launch initiatives with a commercial lens.

6. Analytics, Reporting & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Track and report on conversion rate, AOV, revenue per session, category contribution, product-level sell-through, and cart abandonment.
* Identify best-sellers and underperformers; recommend actions (reprice, reposition, rebundle, delist) with data backing.
* Analyse trends in customer preferences, ordering patterns, and demand signals to inform buying and merchandising decisions.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership.
* Work closely with operations, supply chain, marketing, design, and store teams to keep online information accurate and aligned with ground reality.
* Coordinate product photography, content creation, and catalog updates; maintain trackers for all pending changes.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in product marketing, e-commerce, online merchandising, or growth/conversion roles — ideally with ownership of a conversion metric.
* Experience in food delivery, D2C, QSR, retail, FMCG, or food & beverage brands preferred.
* Strong command of analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, CleverTap, or similar); comfortable building dashboards and reading funnel data.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools and frameworks.
* Strong understanding of online consumer journeys, product page optimization, and marketplace dynamics.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and time-management skills; ability to manage multiple platforms and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Skills

* Conversion rate optimization & funnel analysis
* Product page optimization & A/B testing
* E-commerce catalog & online merchandising
* Revenue-driven product placement & bundling
* Analytics, dashboarding & performance reporting
* Marketplace & platform management (Swiggy, Zomato, own channels)
* Promotion planning & campaign measurement
* Cross-functional stakeholder coordination
* Problem-solving and fast execution

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who sees the product catalog as a revenue engine, not a listing to maintain. The ideal candidate starts every conversation with a number conversion rate, AOV, revenue per session and works backwards from that number to the merchandising decision.

You are proactive, analytically rigorous, and commercially minded. You can look at a product page and see a funnel; look at a category layout and see unrealised revenue; look at a promotion and ask what it actually converted.

You are comfortable working across teams ops, design, marketing, supply chain and can translate data into action. You take ownership of the online storefront as if it were your own shop floor, and you know that in digital, every pixel is a merchandising decision.

Flange Forged Engineers operates in the engineering and industrial manufacturing sector, with a focus on delivering reliable, quality-driven solutions to its clients. The company emphasizes strong customer relationships, technical accuracy, and timely delivery of products and services. Team members collaborate closely with customers to understand requirements and provide tailored solutions. Flange Forged Engineers values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement in both technical and commercial operations.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales and Marketing Representative role based in Mumbai. The role involves identifying and engaging potential clients, presenting product and service offerings, and managing the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing deals. The representative will maintain regular communication with existing customers, provide post-sale support, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Daily responsibilities include preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating with internal technical and operations teams, and tracking sales activities using appropriate tools or CRM systems. The role also includes supporting marketing initiatives such as attending industry events, assisting with promotional campaigns, and providing feedback on market trends and competitor activities.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidate should have a little experience about piping industry.
* Candidate should be ready travel globally if the need arises to finalize a deal.
* Candidate having a sales and marketing experience will be a plus point.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
* Must be based in Mumbai/Thane
* Must have café, bistro or restaurant experience.
* Must have 3-5 years' experience in the hospitality industry.

**Habibi’s Cafe & Bistro**
is a modern Middle Eastern café and bistro in Hiranandani Estate, Thane, known for bold flavours, thoughtfully crafted beverages, and warm, welcoming hospitality.

The venue offers Middle Eastern cuisine and all-day dining, along with speciality coffee, craft matcha, and a curated selection of craft beers. Guests can visit throughout the day, from breakfast and coffee to lunch, evening brews, and dinner, making it a versatile space for different occasions.

**Role Description**
The Social Media Manager is a full-time, On-site role based at Habibi’s Cafe & Bistro in Thane. This role is responsible for planning, creating, and publishing engaging content across social media platforms to showcase the café’s food, beverages, events, and brand story. Day-to-day tasks include managing social media calendars, capturing and coordinating photo and video content, writing captions, monitoring comments and messages, and maintaining a consistent brand voice.

The Social Media Manager will track performance metrics, optimize campaigns, and collaborate with the café team to promote specials, seasonal menus, collaborations, and in-store experiences. The role also involves staying updated on relevant trends, engaging with local communities and influencers, and supporting basic marketing activities that drive footfall and brand awareness.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Social Media Marketing and Social Media Optimisation (SMO), with experience in the hospitality field of managing brand accounts on platforms such as Instagram & Facebook.
* Ability to develop and execute Content Strategy, including planning content calendars and aligning social media campaigns with business goals.
* Excellent Writing and Communication skills for crafting clear, engaging captions, responses, and brand messaging.
* Experience with basic photography and videography for social media, plus familiarity with editing tools (e.g., Canva, mobile video apps) is beneficial.
* Understanding of analytics and insights on major social platforms, with the ability to interpret data and refine content based on performance.
* Prior experience in F&B, hospitality, or lifestyle brands is an advantage, along with a genuine interest in café &
* bistro culture.
* Ability to work on-site, collaborate with a diverse team, manage multiple tasks, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant education or training in marketing, communications, media, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

**Preference: Immediate Joiners**

* Send your CVs to contact@masora.in

title: B2B Marketing Lead, India
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and versatile
**India Business Marketing Lead**
to drive OpenAI’s enterprise and B2B marketing strategy in India. This is a critical leadership role for a full-stack B2B marketer with strong India market judgment—someone who can operate across enterprise, startup, developer, and partner audiences, build foundational capabilities, and deliver high-impact programs that support revenue growth and long-term trust.
  
  
This role will be responsible for shaping and executing integrated B2B marketing initiatives that support enterprise adoption, partner-led growth, startups, and developer-adjacent business audiences in India. The ideal candidate brings deep experience working with sales-led GTM teams, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and translating global strategy into locally effective execution for India.
  
  
The preferred location for this role is
**Mumbai**
.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead the development and execution of India B2B marketing strategy, aligned with global priorities and India GTM objectives.
* Drive full-funnel B2B marketing programs across field marketing, content, customer marketing, events, executive engagement, and partner marketing.
* Partner closely with India GTM, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Comms, and Global Affairs to deliver integrated programs that support enterprise adoption and pipeline growth.
* Translate global B2B narratives and launches into India-relevant, market-specific execution across enterprise, startup, developer, and partner motions.
* Establish strong India marketing operating rhythms, including planning cycles, agency management, budget oversight, performance measurement, and reporting.
* Act as the India voice for B2B marketing, bringing market insight, customer perspective, trust signals, and local nuance into global strategy discussions.
* Build and scale foundational B2B marketing capabilities in India, with an eye toward future team growth and specialization.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in B2B or integrated marketing, ideally within technology, platforms, or high-growth environments.
* Proven track record of building and executing B2B marketing programs that support enterprise or partner-led GTM motions in India and/or similarly complex markets.
* Strong understanding of India enterprise buying dynamics, including the role of trust, regulation, partners, SI ecosystems, and local proof points.
* Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and executional levels in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
* Experience working closely with Sales, GTM, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Comms teams in a matrixed organization.
* Excellent communicator and collaborator, with strong stakeholder management and influence skills across business, policy, product, and GTM audiences.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, vendors, and regional or local partners in India preferred.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience marketing AI, developer, or highly technical products.
* Familiarity with regulated industries or trust-sensitive enterprise environments.
* Prior experience leading India, South Asia, regional, or global marketing scopes.

title: Sr. Manager - Content & Growth (B2B GTM)
description:
**About Pixelo Digital**

Pixelo Digital is a B2B growth and GTM company helping technology businesses generate pipeline, conversations and revenue. We work across outbound, ABM, intent-led campaigns, performance marketing, SEO, content and data-driven GTM. We’ve worked with 250+ brands across technology, SaaS and enterprise, and we’re building a brand around one simple idea:

* Great marketing should create business impact. Alongside our services, we’re building Prospectoo, our B2B GTM intelligence platform, to help businesses identify, engage and convert their ideal customers more effectively.

**About the Role:**

* We’re looking for a Senior Manager – Content & Growth who can bring together content strategy, organic growth and B2B demand generation to build a scalable marketing engine for Pixelo Digital and Prospectoo.
* This role goes beyond creating content or running campaigns. You’ll be responsible for turning content, SEO, thought leadership and multi-channel marketing initiatives into measurable business outcomes.

* You’ll work across the entire growth journey:

Strategy → Content → Distribution → Acquisition → Conversion → Pipeline → Revenue

* From building content that establishes authority to improving organic visibility through SEO, AEO and GEO, you’ll identify opportunities to attract the right audience, generate demand and accelerate growth.
* You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, partnerships and product teams, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution to build a stronger brand and a predictable growth engine.

What You'll Do:

**Content Strategy & Thought Leadership**

* Develop and execute a content strategy aligned with business goals, target audiences, and GTM priorities.
* Create and oversee high-impact content across blogs, case studies, landing pages, whitepapers, reports, newsletters, webinars, and product-led content.
* Build thought leadership across LinkedIn and other relevant platforms to strengthen brand authority and engage B2B decision-makers.Translate complex B2B GTM, SaaS, and technology concepts into compelling content that resonates with target buyers.
* Collaborate with internal teams and subject matter experts to develop original insights, customer stories, and industry-focused content.

**SEO, AEO & GEO:**

* Own organic growth across Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Content SEO, and Programmatic SEO.Optimise content for traditional search engines, AI-powered search, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
* Develop keyword strategies, content clusters, comparison pages, and search-led landing pages to improve visibility and qualified organic traffic.
* Monitor search performance, identify content gaps, and implement strategies to improve rankings, engagement, and conversions.

**B2B Growth & Demand Generation:**

* Develop and execute integrated GTM and demand generation campaigns across organic, paid, content, and outbound channels.
* Define ideal customer profiles (ICPs), buyer personas, target segments, and messaging to support focused marketing initiatives.
* Build campaigns that move prospects through the buyer journey, from awareness and engagement to lead generation and conversion.
* Work with SDR, sales, and partnerships teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and revenue contribution.Identify new market opportunities through competitor analysis, customer insights, and industry research.

**Performance Marketing & Campaign Optimisation:**

* Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, display advertising, remarketing, and account-based advertising.
* Manage campaign budgets, targeting, creative testing, and performance optimisation to maximise qualified demand and return on investment.
* Track key metrics such as CPL, CAC, conversion rates, ROAS, and pipeline contribution.
* Align paid campaigns with content strategy, ICPs, and broader GTM objectives to create a consistent buyer experience.

**GTM Automation & AI-Powered Marketing:**

* Leverage AI tools and marketing automation platforms to improve content production, campaign execution, personalisation, and operational efficiency.
* Build and optimise workflows for audience segmentation, lead capture, nurturing, scoring, routing, and campaign follow-ups.
* Use relevant prospecting, enrichment, and intelligence tools to support account research, campaign targeting, and audience insights.
* Identify opportunities to streamline marketing processes and scale repeatable growth initiatives through automation.

**Product Marketing & GTM Enablement:**

* Work with product, sales, and leadership teams to develop positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies for Pixelo Digital and Prospectoo.
* Translate product capabilities into clear benefits through product pages, solution pages, comparison content, sales collateral, and campaign assets.Support product launches, new service offerings, and market expansion initiatives.
* Equip sales and SDR teams with relevant content and messaging to support prospect engagement and deal progression.

**Website Optimisation & Analytics:**

* Improve website performance through conversion rate optimisation (CRO), landing page testing, user journey analysis, and content improvements.
* Build reporting frameworks and dashboards to track traffic, engagement, MQLs, SQLs, campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and revenue attribution.
* Use tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and CRM platforms to identify trends and actionable growth opportunities.
* Continuously test, analyse, and refine campaigns and content based on data and business outcomes.

**Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Own content and growth initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, measurement, and optimisation.Collaborate with sales, SDR, product, partnerships, and leadership teams to align marketing priorities with revenue goals.
* Manage external agencies, freelancers, and vendors where required.
* Mentor team members, establish scalable processes, and drive accountability across content and growth initiatives.
* Stay updated on evolving B2B marketing trends, AI-powered search, GTM strategies, martech, and demand generation practices.

**Key Tools You’ll Work With:**

* Content, SEO & Research: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, AI-powered content tools.
* Performance Marketing: Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, remarketing and analytics platforms.
* GTM, Prospecting & Intelligence: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha, Prospectoo.
* CRM & Marketing Automation: HubSpot, Salesforce, and relevant workflow automation platforms.
* AI & Productivity: Generative AI tools and automation solutions for research, content, personalisation, and campaign optimisation.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; an MBA or relevant master's degree is a plus.
* 7–10 years of experience in B2B content marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, or GTM-focused roles.
* Proven experience building content strategies that strengthen brand positioning, generate demand, and contribute to business growth.
* Strong understanding of SEO, AEO, GEO, content distribution, thought leadership, and organic growth strategies.
* Hands-on experience with paid media campaigns, including Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, along with campaign measurement and optimisation.
* Experience with B2B SaaS, technology, IT services, or other B2B business models.Understanding of ICP segmentation, buyer journeys, lead generation, marketing funnels, and account-based marketing.
* Familiarity with AI-powered tools, marketing automation, CRM systems, and data-driven campaign optimisation.
* Strong analytical, communication, writing, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate business objectives into effective marketing strategies while remaining closely involved in execution.

Contact Information: careers@pixelodigital.com

title: Head of GTM - US
description:
HEAD OF US GTM

Company: Pepper

Location / Time Zone: US Market (US time zone), Mumbai

Employment Type: Full-time

About Pepper

Pepper is building a new category of content and SEO growth platform, where strategy, content, technology, automation, and AI come together to drive measurable business outcomes.

We are now extending this foundation to build a modern enterprise growth engine, and we are looking to hire our first Head of US GTM to own and scale our go-to-market motion in the US market.

About the Role

As Head of US GTM, you will own the entire go-to-market strategy and execution for the US: pipeline, demand generation, sales alignment, positioning, and revenue growth across new business and expansion. You will define how Pepper wins in the US market and build the engine to get there.

This is both a strategic and a hands-on role. You will set the GTM strategy and operating rhythm, then roll up your sleeves to build programs, run experiments, and drive results. You will work shoulder to shoulder with sales, product, product marketing, and customer success to deliver a consistent customer journey and accountable, measurable growth. This role primarily works in the US time zone.

What You Will Do

• Own US GTM strategy and revenue. Define and execute the go-to-market plan for the US, and own pipeline and revenue targets across new business and expansion in partnership with sales and customer success leaders.

• Build the demand generation engine. Create sustained, iterative programs across demand channels: paid marketing, email, SEO, conversion rate optimization, and, over time, ABM, social, and content marketing.

• Sharpen positioning and messaging. Partner with product marketing to ensure clear, compelling positioning and a consistent experience across the full customer journey.

• Drive funnel performance. Rigorously audit the full funnel, surface data-driven insights, and make fast adjustments to accelerate growth. Work closely with the SDR function to improve lead-to-discovery conversion.

• Collaborate and prioritize. Work cross-functionally and use data to focus the team on the right initiatives in the right order.

• Present strategy and results to leadership. Articulate key initiatives and present performance reviews including financials, test results, forecasts, and metrics. Hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes.

• Stay hands-on. Contribute directly to campaign development, content, and tactical execution as needed.

What You Will Bring

• 10+ years of GTM, demand generation, and/or digital marketing experience, with B2B and enterprise software experience a strong plus

• 4+ years in a leadership role, ideally building and scaling GTM motions for a new or growing market (experience managing contractors and distributed teams is a plus)

• A proven, data-driven operator who has built multi-channel demand programs across geos and segments and delivered against aggressive growth targets

• Experience owning pipeline and revenue, and managing or working closely with the SDR function to improve conversion

• Experience launching or scaling GTM in the US market, working with US stakeholders

• Strong command of marketing automation tools, and Google Analytics

• A collaborative team player who partners effectively with marketing, sales, product, and customer success to hit business goals

• A detail-oriented operator who can cohere teams, drive efficiency, and thrive in a fast-paced organization

• A track record of setting, exceeding, tracking, and communicating meaningful goals

• A self-starter who operates with limited guidance, knows when to ask for help, and brings flexibility, adaptability, and accountability

title: StockX: Category Manager – Sneakers
description:
Full-Time
  
  

* Full-Time
* Anywhere

**Headquarters:**
Remote, USA
  
  
**Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.**
****Why You’ll Love This Role:****
StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Sneakers are foundational to StockX — not just as a category, but as a culture, an economy, and a global community.
  
  
We are expanding how sneaker culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand the sneaker market — they live inside it.
  
  
The
**Sneakers Category Manager**
is the single-threaded owner of sneaker category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on sneaker culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.
  
  
**You Will Act As:**

* The internal authority on the primary and secondary sneaker ecosystem
* The external face of StockX to sneaker sellers, creators, and community leaders
* The architect of the sneaker go-to-market / growth playbook for this new initiative

This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to sneakers within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader sneaker portfolio and team.
  
  
****What You’ll Do:****
**Own the Sneakers Category End-to-End**

* Define and execute the growth strategy for sneakers within the platform
* Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue
* Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms

**Be the Market & Culture Expert**

* Maintain deep, current knowledge of sneaker culture, including:

+ Key sellers, creators, collectors, and resellers
+ Sub-segments (hype vs. GRs, vintage, performance, regional markets, etc.)
+ Drops, releases, brand dynamics, and cultural moments
+ Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics

* Serve as the internal voice of the sneaker community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions

**Supply & Creator Acquisition**

* Build and own a pipeline of high-impact sneaker sellers, shops, influencers, and creators
* Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform
* Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce

**Commerce Strategy & Category Moments**

* Identify and orchestrate sneaker-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion
* Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations
* Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with Account & Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to sneaker sellers and buyers
* Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization

**Build the Playbook**

* Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories
* Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX
* Support hiring and onboarding as the sneaker category team grows

****About You:****

* Deeply embedded in sneaker culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem
* 5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in sneakers, streetwear, or adjacent ecosystems
* Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt
* Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, and community members
* Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives
* Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up

****Nice To Have:****

* Existing network of sneaker resellers, store owners, creators, or influencers
* Experience buying and selling sneakers or operating within resale marketplaces
* Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities
* Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams

****Why This Role Matters:****
Sneakers will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:
  
  

* The cultural bar for the platform
* The go-to-market & growth blueprint for future categories
* The credibility of StockX with the sneaker community

You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement.
  
  
*Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.*
*Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.*
****About StockX****
StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX’s powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.

description:

**Headquarters:**
Remote
  
  
****About Carrot:****
Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot’s comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.
  
  
Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company’s ‘Most Innovative Companies’ and CNBC’s ‘100 Barrier Breaking Startups’. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Carrot is seeking a Lead, Product Management to help shape and scale one of our core product areas as Carrot’s platform continues to grow. In this role, you’ll operate as a strategic driver within the Product organization — owning a significant portion of the product roadmap, setting direction for cross-functional initiatives, and raising the bar for product craft across the team.
  
  
This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who has already demonstrated strong product judgment and is ready to take on greater scope: shaping strategy, mentoring other product managers, and partnering directly with senior leadership on the initiatives that matter most to our members and business.
  
  
If you’re energized by solving ambiguous, high-stakes problems and want to help define how Carrot builds products at scale, this role is for you!
  
  
****What You’ll Own****
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a key product area, translating company priorities into a clear, prioritized plan of execution
* Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial partners around a shared vision and set of goals
* Serve as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Product Managers, helping raise the bar on product process, discovery, and craft across the team
* Make and communicate high-judgment prioritization decisions, balancing member experience, business impact, and technical feasibility
* Partner directly with senior product and cross-functional leadership to shape quarterly and annual product strategy
* Identify and address systemic gaps in process, tooling, or team practices that limit the Product team’s effectiveness
* Represent the Product team in executive and cross-functional forums, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes

****What Success Looks Like****
In your first 12–18 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered a body of work that measurably improved member outcomes, engagement, or business performance within your product area
* Built trusted, effective working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial/Customer Success
* Established yourself as a go-to product thought leader, with other PMs seeking out your input on strategy and process
* Shaped or improved a core product process (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization) that is now used more broadly across the team
* Successfully led at least one significant, ambiguous, cross-functional initiative from concept through launch

****About You****
You likely have:
  
  

* 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a fast-growing technology company; healthcare or digital health experience is a plus
* A track record of owning complex, cross-functional product initiatives from strategy through execution
* Strong product sense and the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints in your decision-making
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align both peers and senior leadership
* Experience mentoring or informally guiding less-experienced product managers

**Nice to Have**
**⭐**
While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:
  
  

* Experience in fertility, family-building, or broader digital health benefits
* Experience partnering with Clinical or Legal teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive products
* Familiarity with AI-enabled product features or workflows
* Experience operating in a fully distributed, remote-first organization

**Why This Role Matters**
As Carrot continues to scale, our Product team needs leaders who can operate with both strategic clarity and hands-on execution. This Lead, Product Management role is central to that effort — helping ensure our roadmap reflects the right priorities, our cross-functional partners are aligned, and our product practices scale sustainably as the team grows.
  
  
This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact: shaping not just a single product area, but the way Carrot’s Product organization operates as it matures.
  
  
**Interview Process**
We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.
  
  
**For This Role, Candidates Can Expect:**

* Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
* Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
* Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
* Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.
  
  
**Why Candidates Join Carrot**
Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.
  
  
**Highlights Include:**

* A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
* A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
* Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
* Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
* The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

****Compensation:****
Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $168,000-$198,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.
  
  
**Fraud and Security Notice:**
Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com
  
  
**A Note on AI**
At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.
  
  
For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we’ll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we’re looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.
  
  
**Why Carrot?**
Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.
