title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager (Performance Marketing)**

**Company:**
Precize

**Location:**
Mumbai (On-Site)

**Experience:**
2 to 5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Team:**
Leads a lean marketing pod of 3

**About Precize**

Precize is a fast-growing fintech startup that simplifies access to private companies like Zepto, NSE, Oyo Rooms, and 150+ other companies.

We envision a future where accessing private assets is as seamless as navigating the public markets: an open environment that transcends traditional investing in India.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring a Marketing Manager to own Precize’s growth engine, with paid media at its core. You’ll run Google Ads and Meta Ads hands-on, own the budget and the numbers, lead a small team, and see your work directly move acquisition, activation, retention, and referral.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct line to the founders and a clear runway into a Head of Marketing role as we scale.

**What You’ll Own**

*Paid Acquisition*

* Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube, App campaigns) and Meta Ads (app install, lead, and conversion campaigns).
* Own the monthly paid budget and its outcomes: CAC, CPA, ROAS, and cost per signup or first investment.
* Run a steady cadence of creative, audience, and landing page tests. Scale what works, and cut what doesn’t, fast.
* Optimize beyond the click, for lead quality, completed signups, KYC completion, and first investments, not just traffic.

*Measurement & Growth*

* Set and own weekly and monthly acquisition, activation, and retention targets.
* Maintain clean tracking and attribution across GA4, ad platforms, and our product analytics, so every rupee can be traced to an outcome.
* Work with funnels, cohorts, and A/B test results to decide where budget goes next.
* Use WhatsApp, email, community, and content to turn acquired users into active, repeat investors.

*Team Leadership*

* Lead and mentor the marketing team, delegate responsibilities with clarity, and review output rigorously.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance.
* Act as the bridge between Marketing, Product, and Sales to ensure alignment and effective execution.

*Content & Brand*

* Oversee ad creative and content that make private market investing simple, relevant, and accessible to retail users.
* Keep all campaigns consistent with the brand and compliant for an investment product.

**Who You Are**

* 2 to 5 years of marketing or growth experience, with hands-on paid media at the center of it, preferably in a startup.
* Have managed or mentored at least one direct report.
* Have personally built and optimized Google and Meta campaigns, not only overseen agencies.
* Understand the full funnel: acquisition → activation → retention → referral.
* Target-driven, comfortable with a lean budget, and quick to act on data.

**Must-Haves**

* Proven experience leading or managing a marketing or growth team.
* Hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads, with ownership of monthly budgets and accountability for CAC, CPA, or ROAS.
* A track record of improving paid efficiency, such as lowering CAC or CPL or raising ROAS, that you can explain with numbers.
* An analytical mindset, with the ability to work with dashboards, attribution, funnels, cohort data, and A/B testing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Startup experience, preferably at a small or mid-sized company.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience running influencer or creator campaigns measured on conversions (signups, installs, transactions), not reach.
* Experience with app install campaigns (Google App campaigns, Meta app install campaigns) and mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Branch.
* Familiarity with stock markets or alternative investment products.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Mixpanel, CleverTap, MoEngage, or HubSpot.
* An existing network of finance content creators.

**Why Precize**

* Own and shape the marketing function, with a clear path to Head of Marketing as we scale.
* Gain exposure to one of India’s most exciting and underexplored investment categories.
* Work closely with the founders and leadership team.
* Be part of a tight-knit, high-performance team that moves with genuine startup energy.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business Management, or Sales will be an advantage.
* Candidates with relevant technical qualifications and substantial oilfield industry experience may also be considered.

**4. Required Experience & Skills**

* 8–10 years of relevant experience in oil and gas, oilfield services, drilling equipment, industrial equipment, or technical B2B sales and marketing.
* Proven experience in marketing, business development, technical sales, or commercial management within the oil and gas industry.
* Strong technical understanding of oilfield products, equipment, applications, or services.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications and product documentation.
* Experience in B2B sales, customer acquisition, account management, and business development.
* Familiarity with tenders, RFQs, RFPs, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to engage with both technical professionals and senior commercial decision-makers.
* Strong market research, competitor analysis, and business planning capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM or sales pipeline management tools.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple opportunities, and deliver measurable business results.

**5. Preferred Industry Experience**

**Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred:**

* Oilfield equipment, machinery, and drilling tools.
* Well completion, intervention, and servicing products.
* Valves, pumps, fittings, flow-control equipment, and oilfield consumables.
* Upstream oil and gas exploration and production.
* Offshore and onshore oilfield operations.
* Oilfield maintenance, inspection, testing, and technical services.
* EPC projects and industrial procurement.
* Oil and gas equipment distribution and technical sales.
* Vendor registration, tender management, and institutional procurement.

**6. Key Competencies**

* **Technical Knowledge:**
  Ability to understand oilfield products, applications, and technical requirements.
* **Business Development:**
  Ability to identify opportunities, acquire customers, and generate revenue.
* **Strategic Marketing:**
  Ability to develop effective marketing plans and improve market penetration.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Understanding of pricing, margins, negotiations, and business profitability.
* **Relationship Management:**
  Ability to build lasting relationships with customers and industry stakeholders.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Ability to evaluate market trends, competition, and business performance.
* **Ownership:**
  Ability to manage opportunities from identification through proposal development and order closure.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

**The ideal candidate will combine technical oilfield expertise with strong marketing, B2B sales, and business development experience**
. They must understand the products being offered, where and how they are used, and how to communicate their technical and commercial benefits to customers.

Candidates with only general digital marketing or consumer marketing experience, without meaningful exposure to oilfield products, technical sales, or industrial B2B business development, will not be suitable.

**8. Job Location & Travel**

**Location:**
Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

The candidate should be willing to attend customer meetings, visit industrial clients, participate in industry events, and travel for business development when required.

**9. Application Requirements**

**Candidates should highlight their oil and gas industry experience, technical product knowledge, key accounts handled, business development achievements, tendering experience, and commercial contributions in their resumes.**

title: Business Manager
description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
  
  
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Manager to manage and grow the assigned technology portfolio. The role will be responsible for driving vendor relationships, business planning, product lifecycle management, demand generation, profitability, and market growth across Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge, vendor management experience, and the ability to work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Channel Partners to achieve revenue and profitability objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product & Vendor Management**

* Own and manage the complete product portfolio for Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs and technology vendors.
* Develop and execute business plans to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market penetration.
* Manage vendor programs, rebates, incentives, pricing, and business reviews.
* Drive quarterly and annual business planning with technology vendors.

**Revenue & Profitability Management**

* Achieve assigned revenue, gross margin, and market share targets.
* Monitor business performance and implement strategies to maximize profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities across existing and new customer segments.
* Work with sales teams to accelerate pipeline creation and opportunity conversion.

**Demand Planning & Inventory Management**

* Forecast demand and manage inventory levels to ensure product availability.
* Optimize working capital through effective stock planning and inventory control.
* Monitor inventory ageing and implement corrective actions.
* Coordinate with operations and procurement teams to ensure timely product availability.

**Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy**

* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches and technology solutions.
* Plan promotions, channel programs, incentives, and partner engagement activities.
* Work with marketing teams on events, webinars, campaigns, and lead-generation initiatives.
* Monitor effectiveness of marketing programs and recommend improvements.

**Channel & Sales Enablement**

* Support channel partners and internal sales teams with product positioning and competitive strategies.
* Conduct product training sessions, technical workshops, and partner enablement programs.
* Develop sales kits, presentations, solution briefs, and competitive battle cards.
* Assist sales teams in strategic opportunities and large deal closures.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis**

* Track industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
* Analyze market demand and customer requirements.
* Develop competitive positioning strategies to strengthen market presence.
* Provide insights and recommendations for portfolio expansion.

**Customer & Partner Engagement**

* Engage with key customers, system integrators, and channel partners.
* Participate in customer meetings, solution discussions, and business reviews.
* Support the development of strategic customer relationships.
* Work closely with partners to create and close business opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Vendor teams.
* Drive alignment between business objectives and execution plans.
* Prepare business reports, forecasts, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Ensure smooth execution of commercial and operational processes.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Server, Storage, Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Data Protection solutions.
* Excellent vendor and product management skills.
* Business planning and revenue management expertise.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
* Inventory planning and working capital management knowledge.
* Data-driven and analytical approach to decision-making.
* Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong communication and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Lead - Strategy
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role In a Nutshell**
Strategy team is responsible for identifying short-term & long-term opportunities across developer markets & product lines to accelerate BrowserStack’s revenue growth & to develop the vision for BrowserStack with a strong strategy plan & hypotheses backed by data. Reporting to Senior Manager, Strategy, this individual will work closely with other Product, Marketing & Sales Heads.
  
  
**Desired Experience**

* The ideal candidate will bring 4+ years experience with at least 2+ years experience in management consulting, Growth, BizOps & Strategy.
* Has superior strategic, analytic, and problem-solving skills, and is capable of clearly communicating a long-term vision across the company and clients.
* Is integrated into the developer or saas market ecosystem stays current on competitive and market trends, and brings those insights to identify strategy for cross-selling.
* Natural collaborator, with excellent communication skills and strong executive presence. Must be disciplined and comfortable with ambiguity, possessing the maturity and capability to interact and influence across multiple levels and a global matrixed organization
* Exhibit relevant and consistent leadership behaviors in team management, customer communications, and internal interactions with peers, senior management, clients, and third-party vendors.
* Ability to structure, manage, and coordinate multiple complex cross-functional projects and processes with multiple stakeholders at both senior and junior levels

**What will you do?**

* Conduct in-depth research and analysis of market trends, competitor landscape, and customer needs and formulate data-driven strategies to enhance product revenue and market share.
* Lead key select projects or major work streams related to Browsertsack’s overall Growth Drivers to ultimately drive recommendations to the Executive Committee
* Identify, prioritize, structure, and manage complex issues that drive product priorities and demonstrate bottom-line results including long-term monetization and commercialization strategies
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, to ensure seamless implementation of finalized Strategies
* Take ownership of the entire strategic initiative lifecycle, from conceptualization and formulation to execution and outcome assessment. Ensure that strategies are effectively implemented and measure success against predefined metrics, with a focus on achieving tangible dollar benefits.
* Work with limited direction, usually within a complex and often ambiguous environment, to drive rigorous, fact-based recommendations to executives, functional, or regional management

In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
  
  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual & Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life-event leaves

**About The Role**

title: Manager - Brand & Performance Marketing
description:
**Manager – Brand & Performance Marketing**

**Years of Experience:**
4-6 years

**Location:**
Mumbai (MIDC, Andheri)

We’re looking for a marketer who can think
**brand and business at the same time**
.

Someone who understands how to build a brand across traditional and new-age media, create campaigns people notice, and equally understands what happens after someone clicks an ad.

This role will work across
**brand, media, performance marketing, activations and the customer acquisition funnel**
, with accountability extending beyond leads to actual customer activation.

**What You’ll Do**

**Brand & Campaigns**

Own and execute integrated brand campaigns across digital and traditional channels.

Work closely with creative and media agencies to translate business objectives into strong campaign ideas, communication and media plans.

Have a strong understanding of
**copy, messaging and creative development**
, with the ability to recognise what makes an ad work.

Develop campaign briefs, evaluate creative routes and ensure consistency across channels and customer touchpoints.

**Media Planning & Buying**

Plan and manage campaigns across
**traditional and new-age media**
, including digital and social media, Google, YouTube, Meta, programmatic, OTT/CTV, print, radio, OOH/DOOH and emerging channels.

Work with media partners and agencies on planning, buying, optimisation, measurement and campaign effectiveness.

Understand the role different media channels play across
**awareness, consideration, acquisition and conversion**
.

**Performance Marketing**

Work closely on performance campaigns with a clear understanding of metrics such as
**CAC, CPL, CPI, CTR, conversion rate, ROAS and customer activation costs**
.

Understand audience segmentation, retargeting, creative testing, landing page optimisation and campaign optimisation.

Be comfortable analysing campaign performance and identifying where acquisition funnels are leaking.

Importantly, this person should understand that
**performance marketing does not end when a lead or app download is generated.**

**Understand the Full Acquisition Funnel**

Understand and help optimise the complete customer journey:

**Ad → Click → App Download → Account Opening → KYC Completion → Account Activation → First Trade → Active Customer**

Work with Product, Analytics, CRM, Business and Digital teams to understand conversion at every stage.

Identify funnel drop-offs and work on interventions such as communication, remarketing, nudges, product journeys and campaigns that improve conversion.

Understand cohorts and identify which campaigns, audiences and channels ultimately produce
**activated and transacting customers**
, rather than simply cheap leads or downloads.

**Activations & Experiential Marketing**

Conceptualise and execute
**brand activations, experiential campaigns, partnerships and on-ground initiatives**
.

Think beyond conventional events to create experiences that generate conversations, participation and measurable business impact.

Connect offline activations with digital journeys wherever possible so that engagement can translate into measurable acquisition.

**What We’re Looking For**

**4 to 6 years of experience**
across brand, media, digital and/or performance marketing, ideally in a consumer-facing business.

Experience working across both
**traditional and digital/new-age media**
.

Hands-on understanding of
**performance marketing and digital acquisition**
.

Experience executing
**brand activations and experiential campaigns**
.

Strong creative judgement and a good understanding of
**copy, campaign ideas and communication**
.

Strong understanding of the
**customer acquisition and conversion funnel beyond lead generation**
.

Comfort with data, dashboards and campaign analytics.

Ability to work cross-functionally with
**Product, Business, Analytics, CRM, Sales, Digital and Creative teams**
.

Agency experience combined with client-side experience would be an advantage.

Experience in
**fintech, BFSI, broking, consumer internet, e-commerce or other digital-first businesses**
would be relevant.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

We don’t want someone who thinks:

**“The campaign delivered 100,000 downloads. Job done.”**

We want someone who asks:

**How many opened an account? How many completed the journey? How many made their first trade? Which campaign brought us the highest-quality customers? Where are customers dropping off? What can marketing do to move more people through the funnel?**

At the same time, we’re not looking for a performance marketer who only sees dashboards and CAC.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable discussing a
**brand idea, a billboard, an experiential activation, a Meta campaign and an acquisition funnel.**

That’s the combination we’re looking for.

* Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Work closely with the development, UX, and content teams to ensure SEO best practices are integrated across all web projects and marketing campaigns.
* Innovative Thinking: Stay ahead of industry trends, algorithm updates, and emerging SEO technologies, continuously adapting strategies to stay competitive.
* Crisis Management: Proactively identify and resolve potential issues that may impact SEO performance, from algorithm penalties to client concerns, with swift, effective solutions.
* Project Management: Oversee multiple SEO projects concurrently, ensuring deadlines are met and deliverables are aligned with client objectives.

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* Proven SEO Expertise: 2+ years of experience in SEO, with a significant focus on enterprise and e-commerce SEO strategies, technical SEO, and content optimization.
* Client Management Experience: Extensive experience working directly with clients, understanding their goals, and translating them into effective SEO strategies with a focus on long-term partnerships.
* Leadership & Team Management: Demonstrated success in managing and mentoring teams of SEO professionals, fostering a positive, productive environment.
* Analytical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO tools, with a data-driven mindset to derive insights and form strategies.
* Project Management Skills: Ability to manage multiple SEO projects simultaneously, balancing deadlines, client needs, and team workload effectively.
* Exceptional Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of simplifying complex SEO concepts for non-technical stakeholders and delivering persuasive reports.
* Results-Driven Mindset: Proven ability to meet or exceed organic traffic, ranking, and conversion goals across large-scale SEO campaigns.

* 10 am to 7 pm

title: Sr. Business Innovation Manager (Hyderabad/Bangalore/Mumbai)
description:
**Department:**
Finance
  
  
**Location:**
APAC-India-Mumbai
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Business Innovation to join Align's New Business Models & Services team in APAC. This is neither a sales role nor a pure strategy role. It’s a “build-and-execute” position for someone who wants to create with urgency, can influence without authority, and gets things done without a detailed brief. Fintech fluency is a must.
  
  
This is a newly created role sitting in a small, high-visibility team in the CFO organization, tasked with transforming how Align goes to market through innovative business models, services and solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, New Business Models & Services APAC, this role sits as a core member of the India commercial leadership team.
  
  
You will be a key connector between the India market needs and our global Business Model Innovation strategy. Working closely with Align's local commercial leaders and building close partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal, you will diagnose growth blockers and design, test, and scale solutions that address them, translating market insight into scalable, revenue-generating programs. You will tweak and test existing solutions as well as identify and incubate new opportunities specific to India
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Embed yourself with the commercial team. Build trusted relationships. Become the person local leadership calls when they want to think about a problem differently.
* Run structured discovery to surface growth blockers.
* Understand existing innovation programs & priorities and figure out what they need to look like in India.
* Build business cases, develop business plans, and evaluate new business opportunities for investment by the organization.
* Design and run pilots. Iterate fast. Know when to kill something and when to double down.
* Execute with urgency. Turn validated ideas into live programs, working across internal teams and external partners to make sure what gets built gets adopted.
* Source, evaluate and manage third-party partners. Negotiate agreements. Own the relationships.
* Develop the internal materials (playbooks, training, commercial enablement) that will allow the local teams to adopt and deploy what’s been proven.
* Feed learnings back into the global innovation team so that what works in one market can be adapted and scaled elsewhere.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Strong business acumen, judgment, and maturity: you think naturally in terms of unit economics, incentive structures, and value exchange, not just features and benefits.
* Meaningful fintech experience: at least 3 years of hands-on experience in consumer lending, BNPL, payments, healthcare financing, or adjacent fintech domains. You understand how financing products are structured from both the provider and lender side, how to evaluate and negotiate with financial partners, and how to design solutions that work within the regulatory and consumer credit frameworks of India.
* Experience with iterative product or solution design: You know how to run a structured pilot, what good validation looks like, and how to make go/no-go decisions based on imperfect information.
* Ability to context-switch easily: One week you're deep in a fintech partnership negotiation, the next you're thinking of systems integrations or designing new revenue models.
* Soft power and collaboration skills: You have a track record of getting things done through your credibility, your relationships, and your ability to make people want to work with you.
* Comfort with ambiguity and independent working: This team is small, and the mandate is broad. You need to be able to prioritize and create structure where there isn't any.
* Affinity for AI: you use AI tools as a practical part of how you work: research, analysis, synthesis and building materials. You keep pushing the boundaries of how it can make you (and the company) more effective.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills:Ability to manage budget, resources and multiple workstreams simultaneously.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* 10+ years of commercial / product management / consulting experience, of which at least 3 years in fintech, with a track record of building or scaling something (a product, a program, a market), not just executing a playbook.
* Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA or equivalent a plus but not required if the experience speaks for itself.

***Nice to Have***

* Experience in medtech, healthtech or any other regulated industry, in particular working within or alongside a DSO or multi-site dental or healthcare group.
* SaaS, platform or API product management experience, particularly relevant for systems integration work.
* Experience working in an overlay or matrix organization where influence without authority is the primary operating model.

To succeed in this role, you should bring proven experience in trade marketing, brand marketing, or digital e-commerce activations, preferably within the FMCG, Retail or beauty sectors. A deep, practical familiarity with the quick commerce landscape is highly valued.
  
  
**You’re a great match for this role if you have:**

* Commercial & Creative Vision: You possess a powerful blend of commercial acumen and creative marketing skills to capture instant consumer attention.
* Analytical & Data Acumen: You are highly analytical, with a data-driven mindset and deep expertise in performance marketing and content-to-commerce metrics.
* Stakeholder & Project Management: You are an outstanding project manager with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders, from internal brand teams to external platform partners.
* Agile & Entrepreneurial Drive: You bring an agile, entrepreneurial attitude and thrive when making fast, impactful decisions in a high-speed environment.

**What’s In It For You**

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)

* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference

**Who We Are**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  
Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor & Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  
L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  
In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.

title: Manager – Customer Experience
description:
* Customer Experience Strategy & Economics
* Build and own the CX scorecard beyond NPS: OTIF (on-time-in-full), CPKO, resolution speed, escalation

rate, repeat-purchase behavior by customer tier — and tie every one of them to a revenue or retention
  
  
number leadership can act on.
  
  

* Quantify the cost and reorder impact of every major CX failure mode (damaged/missing items, delivery

issues, refund delays) and use it to prioritize fixes by rupee impact, not by ticket volume.
  
  

* Own resolution-policy decisions (e.g., redispatch vs. refund) with hard data on which choice actually

keeps a customer.
  
  
Data-Driven Program Management
  
  

* Be comfortable pulling and validating your own data (SQL, BigQuery or equivalent) rather than waiting

on a dashboard someone else maintains.
  
  

* Run root-cause analysis that survives scrutiny — right-sized samples, corrected logic, honest callouts

when two systems disagree, and a clear line between “verified” and “a model.”
  
  

* Segment customers by lifetime value and behavior (tiers, first-time vs. repeat, state/geography) to find

where the highest-leverage interventions are, not just the loudest complaints.
  
  

* AI &Automation
* Own the chatbot/IVR stack end to end: containment rate, cost per conversation, and — critically —

instrument what today isn't measured (does “closed” actually mean “resolved”?).
  
  

* Identify and build the next generation of AI-driven CX: proactive delivery-risk alerts, automated win-

back campaigns for lapsing customers, smarter self-serve flows — always backed by a quantified
  
  
opportunity size.
  
  

* Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (chat, IVR, call-scoring platforms) on total cost and actual

capability, not the sales deck.
  
  
Team & Operating Model
  
  

* Build and lead a small, accountable team across three areas: CX Tools & Vendor Management, CX

Metrics & Voice of Customer, and Data & Automation.
  
  

* Replace informal, single-point-of-failure ownership with clear RACI, documented processes, and a team

that can operate without you in the room.
  
  

* Run structured win-back and retention initiatives (e.g., outbound campaigns for customers who've gone

quiet at 90/180 days) with proper reason-code diagnosis, not just reminder blasts.
  
  

* Voice of the Customer
* Personally read and act on customer feedback — the good, the near-miss, and the genuinely angry.

Every customer who takes the time to write in is a free, high-signal data point; treat it that way.
  
  

* Turn qualitative complaints into structured, quantified problems the business can prioritize.

title: Senior Brand & Content Manager
description:
**About Maiva**

**Protein that tastes like a treat. We need words that do too.**

Maiva makes plant-based milks, protein powders, protein drinks and cold coffees. We make everything ourselves, from recipe to pack, and sell on Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart, our website, modern retail and cafés across India.

**The Role**

As Sr Brand & Content Manager, you will be the guardian of the Maiva brand. You'll plan our marketing campaigns, lead our social media content, write the words that sell our products, and make sure every touchpoint — a Reel, a pack, a product listing, a campaign, a brand video or static ad, a café menu card, an ad — feels unmistakably Maiva.

This is a hands-on role. You'll plan, write and brief yourself, working with designers, video editors, creators and our performance marketing team. You'll work directly with the founders.

**What You'll Own**

**Brand & Strategy**

- Own and protect the brand voice and tone of voice across all touchpoints.

- Develop comprehensive content strategies and manage the publishing calendar.

- Craft trust-building, ingredient-led, and product-focused storytelling.

- Write detailed influencer briefs ensuring strict brand alignment.

- Direct and brief video editors and graphic designers to maintain visual and narrative consistency.

**Marketing Campaigns**

- Plan and run campaigns end to end — product launches, seasonal moments, platform sale events and brand campaigns

- Build and run the monthly and quarterly marketing calendar

- Set the brief, coordinate the team, track results, and learn from every campaign

**Social Media & Content**

- Own content strategy and calendars for Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn

- Write captions, carousels, Reel scripts and community replies

- Brief designers and video editors, and review their work for quality and brand fit

- Grow engagement and community, and know what's working and why

**Performance Creative**

- Write UGC ad scripts, scroll-stopping hooks and ad copy for Meta and YouTube

- Direct UGC creators and brief paid creatives with the performance team

- Create A/B copy variations and use ad results to sharpen what we say

**Brand Communication**

- Write copy for our website, product listings, packaging, emailers and WhatsApp

- Brief and manage influencer and creator collaborations

- Keep brand communication consistent across D2C, quick commerce, marketplaces and cafés

**You're a Strong Fit If**

- You have 5–9 years in brand, content or marketing communications, with writing at the core of your work

- You've worked on consumer brands — FMCG, food, beverage, health, wellness, beauty or D2C — either brand-side or at a creative/content agency

- You write exceptionally well: sharp, clear and persuasive in English (Hindi is a plus)

- You've planned and launched real campaigns and run brand social handles, and you can show the results

- You understand both sides: content that builds a brand over six months, and content that has to work in three seconds

- You use AI tools actively in your writing and content workflow

- You're organised enough to run a content calendar with many moving parts

- You're based in Mumbai and comfortable working full-time from our Andheri West office

**Bonus Points**

- Experience with food, nutrition or plant-based brands

- You've helped build a brand from an early stage

- You can make quick edits in Canva or a basic video editor

**Why Maiva**

- Shape a brand at its most formative stage — your work will define how Maiva is known

- Work directly with the founders, with fast decisions and real ownership

- Real products, made in-house, sold across every major channel in India

Working across global business units, you will collaborate with senior executives, commercial leaders, and external partners to represent the Third Bridge brand at the highest level, while maintaining meticulous tracking to measure and communicate event impact.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* End-to-end event execution
* Plan, manage, and execute the full lifecycle of Third Bridge’s event strategy across key markets (UK, Europe, APAC, US), spanning owned events, sponsored industry conferences, virtual webinars, and hybrid experiences.
* Take full ownership of physical, hybrid, and digital event production, including on-site operations, virtual platform management, run-of-show logistics, venue sourcing, and vendor coordination to ensure seamless attendee experiences.

* Manage high-touch external relationships, including industry partners, venue teams, production agencies, and suppliers.

* Campaigns, tracking performance & ROI

* Drive robust data tracking: Own end-to-end event analytics—monitoring registration conversion, attendance rates, engagement, and sales pipeline attribution (sourced and influenced revenue).

* Proven experience: You bring 5+ years of hands-on event planning and production experience, ideally within professional services, financial services, tech, or high-touch B2B environments.
* Proactive & Resourceful: You have a "roll-up-your-sleeves" mindset. You stay composed under pressure, think fast on your feet, and naturally find solutions when unexpected challenges arise.
* Masterful communicator: You possess exceptional interpersonal skills with a natural knack for managing diverse internal and external stakeholders, from external vendors to C-suite executives.
* Data-driven & Commercial mindset: You understand that events are business-critical growth drivers. You are fluent in event metrics, lead tracking, CRM/marketing automation tools, and demonstrating tangible ROI to business leaders.
* Relentlessly organized: You have exceptional project management skills and an eagle eye for detail. You live for detailed timelines, run-of-show schedules, accurate attendee tracking, and clear action items.
* Flexibility & Global mindset: Comfortable working in a matrixed global environment; given the global reach of this role, flexible and non-standard working hours will be required to coordinate across time zones, conduct meetings, and manage live event executions.

**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.

description:
**Department:**

Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled, result-oriented
**Performance Marketing & Social Media Marketing Specialist**
with end-to-end capabilities in digital marketing strategy, paid advertising, lead generation, social media management, and brand building.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns across multiple platforms to generate quality leads, increase brand awareness, improve conversions, and support business growth.

The candidate will manage marketing initiatives across multiple business verticals, including
**Immigration & Visa Consultancy, International Travel & Tourism, Manpower Training, and Recruitment Services**
.

We need a hands-on digital marketer who understands the complete marketing funnel from audience research and campaign strategy to lead acquisition, nurturing, retargeting, conversion tracking, and performance reporting.

**Key Responsibility**

1. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising

* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant advertising platforms.
* Develop performance marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, target audiences, budgets, and lead generation goals.
* Manage Google Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types based on business requirements.
* Create and optimize lead generation, website traffic, conversion, remarketing, and brand awareness campaigns.
* Conduct audience research, keyword research, competitor analysis, and market research to identify high-potential customer segments.
* Develop audience targeting strategies based on geography, demographics, interests, search intent, professional profiles, and customer behavior.
* Optimize campaigns for cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate, and lead quality.
* Conduct A/B testing of ad creatives, headlines, copy, landing pages, audience segments, and campaign strategies.
* Manage advertising budgets efficiently and allocate spend based on campaign performance and business priorities.
* Monitor campaign performance regularly and take data-driven decisions to improve results.

2. Lead Generation & Conversion Strategy

* Develop end-to-end lead generation strategies for immigration, visa services, international travel, manpower supply, and recruitment.
* Build effective marketing funnels to attract, engage, qualify, and convert potential customers.
* Identify the most effective platforms and campaigns for generating qualified leads for each business vertical.
* Work on landing page optimization, lead forms, website conversion paths, and call-to-action strategies.
* Implement retargeting campaigns for website visitors, previous leads, social media engagers, and other eligible audience segments.
* Coordinate with sales and business development teams to improve lead quality, response rates, and conversion rates.
* Track lead sources, cost per qualified lead, sales conversion, and campaign ROI wherever data is available.
* Recommend strategies to reduce irrelevant leads, improve lead intent, and increase the overall return on marketing investment.

3. Social Media Marketing & Brand Awareness

* Develop and execute social media strategies for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Create monthly content calendars aligned with business goals, seasonal opportunities, campaigns, and audience interests.
* Plan content for brand awareness, engagement, lead generation, customer education, and trust building.
* Develop campaign concepts for reels, short-form videos, carousels, static creatives, testimonials, informative posts, and promotional content.
* Write engaging ad copy, captions, headlines, hooks, and calls to action.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, content writers, and other team members to produce high-quality marketing assets.
* Maintain brand consistency across all platforms and business verticals.
* Monitor engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, website traffic, and social media-driven leads.
* Identify relevant trends and content opportunities while ensuring all messaging remains accurate and appropriate for the respective industry.

4. Marketing Strategy for Multiple Business Verticals

The candidate should be capable of developing distinct marketing strategies for the following sectors:

**Immigration & Visa Services**

* Generate enquiries for immigration programs, visa assistance, overseas opportunities, and other relevant services.
* Target audiences based on eligible markets, destination countries, service offerings, and customer intent.
* Develop trust-building campaigns using educational content, process explainers, FAQs, and genuine client testimonials.
* Ensure advertising claims are accurate, transparent, and compliant with platform policies and applicable regulations.

**Travel & Tourism**

* Generate leads for holiday packages, international travel, customized itineraries, group tours, and other travel services.
* Plan campaigns around destinations, travel seasons, holidays, and audience interests.
* Drive enquiries, bookings, website visits, and brand awareness.

**Manpower Supply & Recruitment**

* Generate B2B leads from employers, companies, contractors, and organizations seeking manpower or recruitment solutions.
* Develop LinkedIn and Google Ads strategies for business decision-makers and relevant professional audiences.
* Create targeted campaigns for staffing, workforce supply, recruitment partnerships, and hiring requirements.
* Where required, plan candidate acquisition campaigns separately from employer-focused campaigns.

5. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting

* Set up and manage Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, conversion APIs where appropriate, and advertising conversion tracking.
* Configure conversion events for enquiries, calls, form submissions, WhatsApp clicks, bookings, and other meaningful actions.
* Track campaign performance through Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and reporting dashboards.
* Work with CRM systems and lead management tools to track lead sources, lead quality, and sales outcomes.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports covering spend, impressions, reach, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPL, qualified leads, conversions, and ROI where measurable.
* Identify underperforming campaigns, diagnose issues, and implement corrective actions.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on campaign data, audience behavior, and business outcomes.

6. Website, Landing Pages & Marketing Automation

* Collaborate on landing page creation and optimization to improve conversion rates.
* Recommend website improvements related to user experience, calls to action, page speed, and lead capture.
* Understand basic SEO, keyword intent, website traffic acquisition, and conversion rate optimization.
* Work with CRM, email marketing, WhatsApp Business, and marketing automation tools to support lead follow-up and nurturing.
* Coordinate with technical teams or vendors for tracking implementation, integrations, and campaign-related website changes.

7. Competitor Research & Growth Planning

* Conduct competitor analysis across advertising platforms, social media channels, websites, offers, and messaging.
* Identify emerging market opportunities, relevant audience segments, and new acquisition channels.
* Develop monthly and quarterly digital marketing plans with clear objectives, budgets, and performance targets.
* Recommend campaign experiments, new creative approaches, and strategies for sustainable business growth.
* Stay updated on advertising platform changes, campaign optimization techniques, industry trends, and digital marketing best practices.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in immigration, visa consultancy, travel, tourism, recruitment, staffing, or manpower services.
* Experience managing multi-location or international audience campaigns.
* Familiarity with landing page builders, WordPress, email marketing, WhatsApp integrations, and lead automation.
* Experience with Google Looker Studio, CRM attribution, offline conversion tracking, and qualified-lead optimization.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on agreed business objectives, campaign budgets, and realistic targets, including:

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Cost per lead (CPL) and cost per qualified lead.
* Lead-to-consultation, lead-to-booking, or lead-to-sale conversion rates, as applicable.
* Campaign conversion rate and cost per acquisition.
* Return on ad spend (ROAS) or marketing ROI where revenue attribution is available.
* Brand reach, impressions, engagement, and relevant audience growth.
* Website traffic and landing page conversion rate.
* Lead quality, campaign efficiency, and continuous performance improvement.
* Timely execution of marketing plans and accuracy of performance reports.

title: Social Media Lead
description:
**Social Media Lead**

**Location : Mumbai, MIDC Andheri**

**Exp: 12–14 Years**

**Finance is serious business. But does talking about it always have to be?**

We don’t think so.

At HDFC Securities, we’re building social media into a powerful engine for brand building, audience growth and customer acquisition across an entire family of investment brands and platforms.

We’re looking for someone who understands that every social platform needs a different strategy, every audience needs a different conversation, and great social media must deliver both brand impact and business outcomes.

**Not someone who simply manages social media. Someone who builds brands and drives growth through it.**

**What will you own?**

1. **Build brands, not social media pages:**
   Create distinct social identities, content properties and communities across the HDFC Securities family of investment brands.
2. **Make finance interesting. Really interesting:**
   Turn investing, markets and wealth creation into compelling, relatable conversations for diverse investor audiences.
3. **Different platforms. Different strategies:**
   Develop platform-specific strategies across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Reddit and emerging channels, tailored to their unique audiences, algorithms, content formats, consumption behaviours and distribution dynamics.
4. **Make organic social a brand-building powerhouse:**
   Drive organic reach and frequency as primary KPIs, building sustained brand visibility, audience engagement and communities through content, conversations and platform-native distribution.
5. **Make paid social work harder for the brand:**
   Lead awareness-first paid social strategies, with brand reach, frequency and visibility as core priorities, while driving measurable contributions to lead generation and customer acquisition. Think beyond traditional performance marketing.
6. **Build communities, not just followers:**
   Create original content IPs, creator collaborations, multilingual properties and culturally relevant conversations that strengthen brand affinity across India.
7. **Think like a marketer. Create like a storyteller:**
   Champion video-first content, reels, podcasts and creator-led formats that make financial brands relevant, engaging and memorable.
8. **Make AI a competitive advantage:**
   Leverage AI across content creation, creative production, social intelligence, audience insights, experimentation and workflow automation to improve speed, scale and effectiveness.
9. **Connect social to business outcomes:**
   Collaborate with internal sales, acquisition, revenue, PR, brand and content teams to integrate social into larger marketing and commercial priorities.
10. **Lead teams and reputation:**
    Build high-performing teams, manage agency partners, establish measurement frameworks and uphold brand credibility, governance and regulatory compliance.

**What will success look like?**

We believe social media should be accountable for both brand growth and business impact, with clear KPIs for each.

**Organic Social - Build Brand Presence & Audience Scale**

* **Reach:**
  Grow the number of unique audiences discovering and engaging with our brands organically.
* **Frequency:**
  Increase how consistently our brands appear in front of relevant audiences.
* **Audience & Community Growth:**
  Build engaged, relevant communities across platforms.
* **Engagement & Content Effectiveness:**
  Measure meaningful interactions, video consumption and content resonance.

**Paid Social - Amplify Awareness & Influence Acquisition**

* **Brand Reach & Frequency:**
  Maximise relevant audience exposure through awareness-led media investments.
* **Brand Awareness:**
  Strengthen brand visibility, recall and consideration across priority audience segments.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Generate qualified interest and leads through strategically amplified social campaigns.
* **Customer Acquisition Contribution:**
  Measure how paid social influences discovery, consideration and eventual acquisition, without treating it purely as a last-click performance channel.

**Who are we looking for?**

A marketer at heart. A storyteller by instinct. A strategist by experience. A leader by choice.

* **12–14 years of experience**
  , with a proven track record of building and scaling social-first brands, ideally across startups, consumer internet, fintech or digital-first businesses.
* Deep expertise in social platforms, algorithms, audience behaviour, organic distribution and paid social media strategy.
* Strong understanding of brand building, media planning, reach, frequency, awareness measurement and acquisition funnels.
* Proven experience developing differentiated channel strategies rather than replicating content across platforms.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI-powered content creation, marketing tools, social intelligence and automation.
* Strong cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to connect brand, content, sales and acquisition priorities.

**Why join HDFC Securities?**

Because this isn’t about inheriting a social media calendar.

It’s an opportunity to build the social-led brand and growth ecosystem for one of India’s leading financial services institutions and its growing family of investment platforms.

You’ll shape how millions discover, engage with and ultimately choose our brands.

All while combining the credibility of HDFC Securities with the ambition and agility of a digital-first business.

**We’re not looking for someone who knows how to post.**

**We’re looking for someone who knows how to build brands, influence audiences and move business.**

Come build the next chapter of social media at HDFC Securities.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Merchant Wealth is a financial education and mutual fund distribution business for Indian retail investors. We explain how investing works in plain language, without hype, tips or return promises, and we build long-term client relationships on that trust. Instagram and YouTube are our primary growth channels.

The Role

You will own the planning, creation and publishing of Merchant Wealth’s content on
**Instagram and YouTube**
, with one goal: grow a credible, engaged audience of retail investors who become clients.

This is not a generic social media job. Our audience reads closely and our industry is regulated. Good work here is accurate, clear and compliant, and also engaging.

Core Responsibilities

**Content planning and curation**

* Build and run a monthly content calendar for Instagram (Reels, carousels, Stories) and YouTube (long-form videos and Shorts)
* Turn market events, AMFI and SEBI updates and investor-education topics into content ideas
* Maintain a swipe file of high-performing formats and hooks in the Indian finance space

**Production and publishing**

* Write scripts, hooks, captions and on-screen text
* Edit Reels, Shorts and long-form videos (or coordinate with a freelance editor) and design carousels and thumbnails
* Publish and schedule consistently using our scheduling tools
* Keep all content on-brand in voice, visuals and tone

**Growth and community**

* Grow followers, watch time and inbound enquiries on both platforms
* Respond to comments and DMs within a defined turnaround time, and route genuine client enquiries to the founder
* Apply platform best practice: SEO for YouTube titles and descriptions, Instagram keyword and hashtag strategy, posting times and collaborations

**Analytics and reporting**

* Track reach, retention, saves, shares, profile visits and enquiries generated
* Send a short weekly and monthly performance report with what worked, what didn’t and what to change
* Run simple tests on hooks, thumbnails and formats

**Compliance (non-negotiable)**

* Follow SEBI and AMFI guidelines for distributors in every piece of content
* Include the ARN and the required disclaimers on every relevant asset
* Never publish scheme recommendations, buy/sell calls, return promises or personalised advice
* Get every post checked against our compliance checklist before it goes live

Requirements

**Must have**

* Strong written English; Hindi or Marathi is a plus
* Hands-on experience creating short-form video (Reels or Shorts) and basic video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar)
* Working knowledge of Canva & other design/AI tools
* Understanding of how the Instagram and YouTube algorithms reward retention, saves and watch time
* Attention to detail: comfortable verifying every number before it is published

Having a public portfolio or a track record of growing your own or a client’s portfolio is an added advantage, but it is not mandatory.

**Good to have**

* Interest in or knowledge of personal finance, mutual funds or the Indian markets
* Experience with a finance, fintech or education brand
* Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Instagram Insights and a scheduling tool such as Metricool
* Comfort presenting on camera

**For the intern role:**
we care more about learning ability, curiosity and a strong portfolio than formal experience. Ongoing studies in commerce, finance, media or marketing are welcome.

What Success Looks Like (first 90 days)

* A fully planned, consistent posting schedule on both platforms
* Measurable improvement in average Reel reach and YouTube watch time
* A repeatable content workflow with zero compliance misses
* Weekly reporting running smoothly
* First enquiries traceable to social content

What You Get

* Direct mentorship from the founder, an AMFI-registered distributor working in the Indian capital markets
* Real ownership of two channels, not a support role
* Practical grounding in mutual funds, investor behaviour and compliant financial marketing

title: Senior Manager - Performance Marketing

**About The Role**
As a
**Senior Manager — Performance Marketing**

We do not look for traditional executors; we seek Growth Architects — professionals who view regional business, platform operations and marketing through the lens of data and first-principles thinking.
  
  
Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* New User Acquisition, App Installs & Product Sales
* Own end-to-end acquisition strategy across Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube, App campaigns), Meta (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns), Apple Search Ads and programmatic channels.
* Drive app install volume and quality — managing CPI, install-to-purchase conversion rates and post-install engagement metrics using Branch and internal measurement for attribution.
* Scale new-to-platform customer acquisition while maintaining or improving CAC targets; continuously optimize channel mix based on cost-per-retained-customer, not just cost-per-install.
* Build and manage audience strategies — lookalike models, custom audiences, interest-based targeting and broad prospecting. With structured testing to identify high-value acquisition segments.
* Identify and eliminate fraud, low-quality installs and attribution gaming across app install channels.
* Drive product-level sales performance through paid channels. Structuring campaigns around hero SKUs, new launches, category pushes and seasonal sale events.
* Own Shopping and catalog campaign architecture,product feed optimization, Merchant Center management, product set segmentation and dynamic product ad performance.
* Plan and execute media strategy for 10–15 major sale events per year (pre-sale, during-sale, post-sale), managing traffic spikes while protecting CPA and ROAS targets.
* Build performance frameworks that connect ad spend to actual product economics — contribution margin, ROAS adjusted for returns and true cost-per-profitable-order.
* Budget Management, Performance Analytics & Platform Health
* Make weekly budget allocation decisions across channels based on performance data. Reallocate aggressively from underperforming channels to high-efficiency opportunities.
* Set and track acquisition KPIs: CAC, CPI, Cost per First Purchase, D30 Repurchase Rate by acquisition channel, ROAS, contribution margin adjusted ROAS and new customer percentage.
* Present weekly and monthly performance reviews to leadership with clear diagnosis, not just reporting explain why metrics moved and what you're doing about it.
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting and activation decisions.
* Maintain strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Supply Operations
* Partner with the creative team to build a structured testing pipeline — brief creative assets, define testing hypotheses and measure creative impact on acquisition efficiency.
* Coordinate with product and analytics teams on conversion tracking, attribution setup and measurement infrastructure — own the accuracy of the data you're optimizing against.
* Collaborate with category and supply chain teams to align campaign intensity with inventory availability avoid promoting products that are out of stock or overpromoting SKUs that create downstream inventory problems.
* Collaborate with the category team on pricing, promotions and assortment decisions that affect campaign performance ensuring marketing investments align with margin targets, not just volume goals.
* Design and execute high velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**Primary Metrics**
**What You'll Be Measured On**
Cost per First-Time Customer: What we pay to acquire a new buyer, tracked by channel
  
  
App Install Volume & Quality: Install count, install-to-purchase rate, post-install engagement
  
  
New Customer GMV Contribution:Revenue generated specifically by first-time buyers
  
  
Channel-Level ROAS: Return on ad spend adjusted for returns and product margins
  
  
D30 Repurchase Rate: Share of acquired customers who buy again within 30 days, by channel
  
  
**Secondary Metrics**
First-Order AOV by Channel: Average basket size of new customers from each acquisition source
  
  
New vs. Returning Customer Mix: Share of orders from first-timers vs. repeat buyers
  
  
Creative Testing Velocity: Number of creative hypotheses tested per week and win rate
  
  
Campaign Contribution Margin: Profit per order after ad cost, COGS and fulfillment
  
  
**What we won't measure you on:**
vanity install numbers without quality filters, platform-reported ROAS without backend validation or total order count without customer quality context.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech./B.E. from an IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institute, or an equivalent degree with a strong quantitative and analytical focus.
* MBA from a Tier-1 business school is preferred but not mandatory.

**Experience & Competencies**

* 7+ years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech or data/business analytics.
* The Engineer Mindset: Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.
* Hands-on expertise running Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax, App campaigns) and Meta Ads (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns) at meaningful budgets.
* Proven experience driving app installs at scale while maintaining install-to-purchase conversion and post-install quality metrics.
* Strong understanding of product feed management, Merchant Center and catalog ad optimization for e-commerce.
* Technical Savvy: Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.
* Cross-Functional Fluency: Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain and central product environments.
* Ownership You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.
* Track record of managing sale events and promotional campaigns with measurable GMV impact.

**Preference**

* Experience in beauty, personal care, health, or FMCG categories — understanding of repurchase cycles, seasonal patterns and how beauty consumers discover and buy products online.
* Familiarity with incrementality testing — geo-holdouts, channel-off tests, or lift studies to measure true campaign impact.
* Experience with mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust) — setting up attribution, measuring post-install events and identifying fraud.
* Experience with AI-driven campaign tools (PMax, Advantage+, AI-generated creative) and a clear point of view on where automation helps and where it doesn't.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.
* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.
* Experience with non-biddable channels — affiliate marketing, influencer performance campaigns, programmatic direct deals.
* Knowledge of CPAS (Collaborative Performance Advertising) or similar marketplace-brand collaborative ad products.
* SQL proficiency for pulling and analysing acquisition cohort data independently.
* Experience building or managing a small performance marketing team (2–5 members).

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

DGM- NPD

Partner seamlessly with Anaplan’s GTM Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain Enterprise Planning Applications into Anaplan’s GTM motion by:

Qualifications
