title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job description**
**Performance Marketing – Amplify**
Own paid growth for Amplify—from channel strategy and creative testing to media budgets, agency execution and acquisition economics.
  
  
Function
  
  
Growth / Marketing
  
  
Employment
  
  
Full-time
  
  
**About Amplify**
Amplify is a consumer-focused digital proposition designed to help people better understand credit, build financial awareness and make more informed financial decisions. As Amplify scales, performance marketing will be a critical growth engine—bringing the right users into the app efficiently, testing what drives engagement and building a repeatable acquisition model.
  
  
**Role purpose**
The Performance Marketing lead will own Amplify’s paid acquisition agenda end to end. This person will identify the right channels and audiences, translate growth objectives into campaign plans, manage agencies and media partners, shape performance-oriented content and creative, control and optimise marketing budgets, and build a strong measurement discipline around user acquisition and conversion.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Paid acquisition strategy: Develop the paid-growth strategy across relevant channels such as Google, Meta, YouTube, app-install campaigns and other digital channels; determine the appropriate channel mix by audience, objective and stage of the funnel.
* Campaign planning & execution: Translate business and growth goals into campaign calendars, media plans, audience strategies, test plans and execution briefs; ensure campaigns are launched accurately and on time.
* Media budget ownership: Build monthly/quarterly spend plans, allocate budgets across channels and campaigns, monitor pacing, forecast outcomes and recommend reallocation based on performance and marginal returns.
* Agency & partner management: Act as the day-to-day owner for performance marketing agencies, media partners and specialised vendors; set briefs, review plans, challenge recommendations, track delivery and hold partners accountable for results.
* Performance content & creative: Work with internal teams and agencies to create ad concepts, copy, videos, statics, landing-page/app-store messaging and campaign assets designed for acquisition. Build a structured creative-testing cadence rather than relying on one-off campaigns.
* Audience & funnel optimisation: Define audience segments, targeting strategies and remarketing approaches; identify drop-offs from impression to install/sign-up/activation and work with product and content teams to improve conversion.
* Measurement & attribution: Create a clear measurement framework for channel and campaign performance. Track acquisition, conversion and downstream quality using relevant analytics/attribution tools and ensure decisions are based on reliable data.
* Experimentation: Continuously test channels, audiences, bids, creatives, offers, landing experiences and campaign formats; document learnings and scale what works.
* Growth reporting: Own weekly and monthly performance reporting for stakeholders, including spend, acquisition, conversion, efficiency, trends, learnings, risks and the next set of actions.
* Compliance & brand guardrails: Ensure paid communication is accurate, customer-friendly and aligned with applicable brand, legal, privacy and financial-services communication requirements before launch.

**Key success measures**

* Paid user acquisition volume against plan and within approved budgets.
* Cost efficiency across the funnel: User acquisition metrics appropriate to the campaign objective.
* Conversion from click/install to registration to paid subscription, key onboarding milestones and meaningful in-app activation.
* Quality of acquired users, including engagement/retention indicators where sufficient data is available.
* Budget pacing, forecast accuracy and disciplined reallocation of spend toward better-performing campaigns.
* Creative testing velocity and measurable improvement from winning creatives/audiences/landing experiences.
* Channel-level return measures such as ROAS or LTV:CAC where the business model and data maturity support them.
* Agency delivery quality, turnaround time, reporting accuracy and adherence to agreed performance targets.

**Experience & Background**

* Approximately 5–9 years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing or digital acquisition, with meaningful hands-on ownership of paid media budgets.
* Experience managing campaigns across major digital advertising platforms; mobile-app acquisition experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage agencies while still being close enough to the numbers to independently assess campaign quality and performance.
* Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, audience segmentation, media buying, conversion optimisation and creative testing.
* Comfort with campaign analytics, dashboards and attribution concepts. Exposure to tools such as GA4/Firebase
* Experience in a consumer-tech, fintech, financial-services, payments, lending, insurance, e-commerce or subscription-led business is preferred, but strong D2C growth experience from other sectors is also relevant.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant post-graduate qualification is useful but not essential.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* MBA
* Graduate

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an independent, commercially minded professional to join our Portfolio team and own the identification, evaluation, and advancement of novel pharmaceutical opportunities for our APAC markets, taking each opportunity from first signal to a clear recommendation and driving the agreed next steps.

The role will focus on innovative and differentiated assets, including NCEs, 505(b)(2) products, and other value-added pharmaceutical opportunities, assessing their strategic fit, value, and timing across our key APAC markets to decide where our time and resources are best invested.

The individual will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Business Development, Finance, and other internal teams, integrating their input into a single Portfolio view of each opportunity and a clear recommendation the business can act on.

**Scope and Decision Rights**

The Head of Portfolio APAC sets strategy, priorities, and major portfolio decisions. Within that framework, this role independently drives its own analyses, opportunities, and projects, makes recommendations, and executes the agreed actions. It is expected to move work forward without step-by-step approval and to judge when to involve others:

* **Decides directly:**
  how to scope and structure an evaluation, which data and internal experts to draw on, when a first answer is sufficient, and which opportunities to screen out against agreed criteria.
* **Aligns with the Head of Portfolio APAC:**
  recommendations to advance, pause, or stop an opportunity, changes to priorities, and positions to take with potential partners.
* **Escalates:**
  matters with material financial, legal, IP, or reputational impact, and cross-functional disagreements that cannot be resolved at working level.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own an up-to-date view of the APAC opportunity pipeline across near-, mid-, and long-term horizons, flag gaps and imbalances, and recommend areas for expansion, investment, or rationalization.
* Proactively scan global markets, pipelines, and competitor activity to identify novel product opportunities relevant to APAC, and bring forward those worth pursuing with a clear rationale.
* Lead the evaluation of shortlisted opportunities end-to-end, integrating medical, clinical, IP, regulatory, development, commercial, competitive, and market-access perspectives with timing and economics, and scaling the depth of analysis to what the decision actually requires.
* Build a working understanding of treatment guidelines, clinical practice, patient pathways, unmet needs, and physician preferences in each market, and use it to judge whether an opportunity is genuinely differentiated against current and future standards of care.
* Assess competitive landscape, product differentiation, market potential, pricing, reimbursement, and positioning, distinguishing real, reachable opportunities from theoretical ones.
* Drive product evaluations to a conclusion with Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Medical, and Business Development teams, involving the right people at the right time and reconciling conflicting inputs.
* Build patient-based forecasts, sales potential, and scenario analyses, making key assumptions explicit and identifying which of them drive the decision.
* Identify relevant companies and assets for partnering and licensing opportunities, and recommend, together with Business Development, which to prioritize and how to approach them.
* Plan and follow through on partnering conferences: prioritize target companies, products, and meetings beforehand, and turn outcomes into agreed next steps afterwards.
* Own follow-through on assigned opportunities, keeping evaluation status, partner interactions, and follow-up actions current, and making sure agreed actions are delivered.
* Present assigned areas in periodic portfolio reviews with management in decision-ready form, highlighting key risks, gaps, growth opportunities, the recommended course of action, and the decisions required.

**Ways of Working**

We are looking for someone who, given an objective and the context, works out how to get there: think, decide, act, and follow through. In practice, this means:

* **Own the outcome, not just the task.**
  Start from what needs to be achieved, structure the problem, find and analyze the information needed, reach a conclusion, and follow through until the agreed actions are delivered.
* **Useful answers, fast.**
  Produce a solid first answer quickly, be explicit about what is fact and what is assumption, identify what is missing, and go deeper only where it would change the decision.
* **Always a recommendation.**
  Analysis ends with a position, not a list of findings: “Based on this, I recommend X because Y, and the next step is Z.”
* **Proactive.**
  Spot risks and opportunities before being asked (in an asset, market, patent situation, launch opportunity, competitive development, or portfolio assumption), raise them early, and propose how to address them.
* **Independent, not isolated.**
  Move work forward without needing approval for each step, and know when to bring in Portfolio, BD, Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Medical, Finance, or other functions.
* **Constructive challenge.**
  Question assumptions, analyses, and proposed approaches when there is good reason to, explain why, and bring a better alternative.
* **Clear and concise.**
  Communicate across functions and geographies in a structured, commercially relevant way: what is happening, why it matters, what you think, and what we should do.

**Preferred Profile**

* Degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field; MBA or equivalent business training is an advantage.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in New Product Planning, Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Commercial Strategy, Medical Affairs, or pharmaceutical consulting, including a track record of taking evaluations or projects through to a decision or outcome.
* Strong ability to interpret clinical data and translate it into commercial implications and portfolio recommendations.
* Strong analytical and forecasting skills, combined with the judgment to separate what matters from what does not and to know when an answer is good enough to act on.
* Intellectual curiosity about pharmaceutical innovation and emerging assets, with the commercial sense to tell an interesting asset from a real opportunity for the company.
* Working understanding of how IP, regulatory pathways (including 505(b)(2)), development, and market access shape the value and timing of an asset; deep expertise in every area is not required.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and willing to take a position, defend it with evidence, and revise it when the evidence changes.
* Clear, concise communicator, effective with colleagues and partners across functions, cultures, and geographies.

While applying, please mention the APAC countries you have handled and one novel asset you have evaluated.

title: Lead Market Access & Pricing - Mumbai
description:
**The Position**

  

Purpose of the role is to develop and implement Boehringer Ingelheim India's Human Pharma Market Access Strategies & framework. It involves promoting the range of innovative products in both Public/Reimbursed and Out of Pocket market by developing and driving better market access initiatives for the payers/patients. Developing pricing strategies for the Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio which includes new product launch pricing, existing product pricing/pricing schemes as well as maintaining pricing from the external stakeholder/Government/NPPA perspective. Identifying, developing and design suitable market access initiatives on the lines of partnership models across therapies, pricing schemes, Health Economics & Outcomes etc. which can enable maximization of opportunities and drive business growth in the public/out of pocket market in close collaboration with the Government Affairs/Healthcare Affairs/Marketing/Medical Team. Monitor, interpret and shape developments and gaps in healthcare policies and healthcare delivery for our current and future HP product portfolio.

  

**Tasks & Responsibilities**

  

  
* Developing new pricing / price change proposal/business case for the complete portfolio of Boehringer Ingelheim India in alignment with local business requirements and working closely with the Global team for getting approvals of the same. Also, taking the lead for all submissions related to global market access such as price approval process, BIP track, Global launch tracker etc.
  
* Ensuring timely and continuous submissions to notify products price to Government pricing authority (NPPA). Streamlining any gaps in data with the government and ensuring all issues are resolved with the concerned authorities
  
* Developing the Market Access Strategies, tactical and execution plan for Boehringer Ingelheim’s portfolio products. Involves identifying suitable therapy opportunities within Government health policy/NCD policy and developing strategies towards increasing advocacy for Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio through either increase in government funding or increase in government priority. Meeting & presenting to senior level external stakeholders. Also, taking the lead for all submissions related to global team such as access related advocacy plan.
  
* Ideating and executing various strategic initiatives across the value chain of Market access such as Pricing Schemes, Payer value tools such as HEOR models, information, diagnosis, affordability, adherence etc. Also aligning with internal stakeholders such as Government Affairs, Sales & Marketing, Medical teams to ensure timely and effective implementation of all tactical plans.
  
* Taking the lead to devising the market access roadmaps & strategy for existing Boehringer Ingelheim brands and new launches. Providing inputs to the Business Teams for implementation.
  
* Manages prioritized health systems engagement on prevention, diagnosis, screening, quality of life and access to care initiatives, health & wellness programs, and patient support related efforts.
  
  

  
  

**Requirements**

  

  
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience required; Preferred an MBA from a reputed institution.
  
* At least 8-10 years of relevant experience in Health policy/Market Access.
  
* Deep understanding of Indian healthcare and regulatory environment with proven expertise in access related initiatives. Strong sales/marketing acumen.
  
* Strong business acumen with the capability and vision to plan and implement strategic company level initiatives.
  
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral, as well as negotiation and presentation skills.
  
* Strong understanding of Indian Healthcare environment and relevant policies.
  
* Must have proven experience in access function by ideating/executing Access strategies, Customer focused solutions etc.
  
* Adheres to companies’ policies and guidelines.
  
* Position will be based at Mumbai.
  
  

  

**READY TO APPLY?**

  

Click the “Apply On Company website” button. Create an account or sign in and continue to register your profile, upload your resume, and apply in the company site.

  
  

For any technical issues or additional questions, contact HR Direct. (Note: resumes should not be submitted to HR Direct since job applications are not processed via email or phone call)

  
  

HR Direct contact information:

  

Phone: +91-22-7145-6700

  

Email: HRDirect.PH@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Our Company Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com. Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
### Job Description: Digital Media Strategist

Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai

Work Mode: Full-time | Work from Office

Experience: Freshers or maximum 2–3 years of experience

Joining: ImmediateQualification:  BMS /BBA or MBA in Marketing

Compensation: Up to 4.20 LPA

### About BLL

Business Leadership League (BLL) is a business leadership and growth platform connecting entrepreneurs, manufacturers, MSMEs, professionals and business leaders.

Since 2019, BLL has been building a community that helps businesses access the right people, opportunities and visibility through curated business events, leadership conversations, business storytelling, corporate partnerships and international business initiatives.

Our vision is to build BLL into a powerful platform for India's business community, bringing the stories, capabilities and ambitions of Indian businesses to a wider national and global audience.

We are looking for a Digital Media Strategist who can think like a marketer, tell stories like a creator and execute like a business owner.

### The Role

This is not a routine social media management position. You will be responsible for shaping BLL's digital identity, developing compelling content properties, growing our digital community and using digital media to support business growth.

You will work closely with the founder, leadership team, community and sales teams to transform BLL's network, events, member stories and business initiatives into a consistent stream of meaningful digital content.

### Key Responsibilities

1. Build BLL's Digital Brand

* Develop and implement a comprehensive digital media strategy aligned with BLL's vision and business objectives.
* Strengthen BLL's positioning as a platform for business leadership, entrepreneur visibility and growth.
* Create platform-specific strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook.
* Build a consistent digital presence that attracts entrepreneurs, manufacturing SMEs, business leaders, corporate partners and institutions.
* Identify emerging content formats, trends and opportunities relevant to India's business community.

2. Create Powerful Business Stories

* Identify compelling stories of entrepreneurs, founders, manufacturers and business leaders within the BLL ecosystem.
* Convert interviews, factory visits, founder journeys and event interactions into engaging digital content.
* Develop scripts and content concepts for reels, short videos, carousels, interviews and long-form videos.
* Create content that highlights the people, products, innovations and capabilities behind Indian businesses.
* Coordinate with designers, videographers and internal teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.

3. Develop BLL's Signature Content Series

Build recognisable content properties that give entrepreneurs a reason to follow, engage with and participate in BLL.

Key series include:

* Makers of India: Showcasing Indian factories, manufacturing capabilities, products and entrepreneurs to a wider audience.
* Indian Business Inspiration Stories: Sharing the journeys, challenges and achievements of Indian entrepreneurs.
* Baton Series: Exploring leadership, business succession, family businesses and lessons across generations.
* Global Trust Circle Stories: Highlighting the journeys, expertise and perspectives of members.
* Leadership & Business Insights: Turning business conversations, books, industry developments and leadership lessons into useful content.
* BLL Event Stories: Capturing insights, key moments and opportunities from roundtables, procurement meets, delegations and leadership events.

You will be expected to develop new series that are relevant to manufacturing SMEs, founders and business decision-makers.

4. Drive Digital Growth and Community Engagement

* Develop monthly content calendars and weekly execution plans.
* Increase relevant audience reach, engagement, shares, saves and meaningful conversations.
* Build relationships with entrepreneurs, industry leaders, associations and relevant digital communities.
* Encourage BLL members to participate in and amplify digital campaigns.
* Explore collaborations and cross-promotion opportunities with business leaders, institutions and industry bodies.
* Build a digital community that values BLL's content and actively participates in its initiatives.

5. Convert Digital Visibility into Business Opportunities

* Develop campaigns that support BLL memberships, events, corporate partnerships and international business delegations.
* Work with the sales and community teams to create content that generates qualified enquiries.
* Develop event promotion campaigns from announcement to registration and post-event engagement.
* Use founder stories, member achievements and event outcomes to demonstrate BLL's value.
* Track the journey from content engagement to enquiries, registrations and membership conversions.
* Identify opportunities to monetise BLL's content properties through sponsorships, brand partnerships and business showcases.

6. Measure, Analyse and Improve

* Track performance across platforms and content formats.
* Prepare monthly reports covering reach, engagement, audience growth, enquiries and conversions.
* Identify which topics, formats and campaigns are delivering results.
* Recommend improvements based on data, audience feedback and business priorities.
* Experiment with new formats and campaigns while maintaining BLL's brand identity.

### Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Freshers/maximum 2-3 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media strategy or content-led brand building.
* Understands the difference between gaining followers and building a relevant business audience.
* Has excellent storytelling, copywriting and content planning skills.
* Understands LinkedIn as a platform for business credibility and Instagram and YouTube as channels for storytelling and discovery.
* Can independently develop a campaign idea, write a brief, coordinate execution and measure results.
* Is comfortable working directly with the founder and taking ownership of important initiatives.
* Is curious about entrepreneurship, manufacturing, family businesses, leadership and the Indian business ecosystem.
* Is organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

Preferred: Experience with B2B brands, startups, business communities, media platforms, manufacturing brands or founder-led businesses.

### Tools & Technical Skills

Working knowledge of the following will be useful:

* Canva and basic creative production tools.
* Video editing and short-form content workflows.
* Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools.
* Google Analytics and social media analytics.

title: Brand & Marketing Associate
description:
Marketing Executive (Brand & Content) | The Financialist | Mumbai

About us

The Financialist is India's Digital Family Office, strategically backed by Zerodha. Our CAs, CFAs and investment bankers give unbiased advice, with no commissions and no brokerage. 700+ families trust us, and we advise on Rs 2,500+ Cr.

We are launching a new home loan brand. It sits on the buyer's side of the biggest purchase of their life.

The role

You will be part of the brand's entire zero-to-one story. You will be in the room for every brand strategy discussion, and you will own the execution that turns those decisions into work that goes live.

What you will own

• Brand strategy: Sit in every strategy discussion on brand positioning, messaging, brand voice and go-to-market. Bring consumer insights and competitor analysis to the table, and keep every piece of work on-brand.

• Content and content calendar: Own the content calendar end to end across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and the website. Plan, brief, publish and track. Build long-form, organic content (guides, explainers, blogs) that earns trust.

• Influencer campaigns: Run creator and influencer campaigns from start to finish. Shortlist creators, write briefs, manage approvals and timelines, and track reach, engagement and enquiries.

• Website and SEO: Do the keyword research, write SEO content for the website and blogs, handle on-page optimisation, and track what ranks and converts.

• Consumer understanding and experiments: Understand the home buyer: what they search, ask and worry about. Find the topics that matter to them, and test new formats, topics and channels to grow our reach and trust.

• AI-first execution: Use AI every day for research, drafts, design, repurposing and reporting. Build simple workflows, and always check the output before it ships.

Who you are

Must have

• A marketing background: a degree or specialisation in marketing (BMS, BBA, MBA or PGDM), plus 0 to 2 years of marketing execution. Internships count.

• Strong fundamentals of branding and marketing: positioning, STP, the 4Ps, brand voice and consumer behaviour. You know how to apply them, not just define them.

• You have shipped real work: a campaign, a content calendar, a social page, an influencer collaboration or a launch, and you can show it along with the numbers.

• You write well: clear, simple and persuasive English. Hindi is a plus.

• You use AI every day for real work, and you check its output before you trust it.

• You own your work: organised, on time, and you follow up without reminders.

• Comfortable working from our Mumbai office (Andheri East), 5 days a week.

Good to have

• Experience in a D2C, fintech, BFSI or real estate brand, or at a marketing or digital agency.

• Canva or Figma, and basic video editing.

• Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite or SEO tools.

• Curiosity about personal finance or real estate. We will teach you the rest.

• You are into fitness, health or sports. "How's your health journey going?" is a fixed item in our catch-ups, and you will fit right in.

What you get

• Build a brand from zero to one, with a real voice in strategy, not just execution.

• Work at a Zerodha-backed company, alongside CAs, CFAs and finance professionals.

• Ownership early. Good ideas ship, whoever they come from.

• An AI-native team that will push you to work smarter, not longer.

• Direct mentoring from the people building the brand.

The details

• Location: Mumbai, in office (Boston House, Andheri East)

• Working days: 5 days a week

• Type: Full-time

• Experience: 0 to 2 years in marketing

• Start: Immediate joining

**Brand Manager, L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty Division**
**(Mumbai)**
Hello, we’re L’Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
As an individual contributor reporting to the Brand Business Leader in Mumbai, you will orchestrate product launches and drive sustained growth for core pillar ranges across India. You will connect science, digital innovation, and consumer insights to expand our market presence.
  
  

* Orchestrate new product launches and core catalogue activations across digital, social, retail, e-commerce, and traditional channels.

* Steer advocacy and influencer programmes, managing agency relationships, content creators, and medical stakeholder engagement.

* Track performance KPIs, manage brand budgets, and leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to increase marketing effectiveness.

**We Are Looking For**
You bring collaborative agility, commercial acumen, and an entrepreneurial approach to health-led beauty innovation. You bring:
  
  

* Brand Development: Proven track record in operational marketing, product launches, and integrated campaign delivery within beauty, FMCG, or healthcare.
* Consumer & Market Insight: Ability to analyse consumer data and identify market drivers to shape effective go-to-market strategies.
* Digital & Influencer Activation: Practical experience managing owned social channels, e-commerce campaigns, and advocacy networks.
* Collaborative Leadership: Strong stakeholder management across internal multidisciplinary teams (medical, sales, supply chain) and external agencies.
* Activation Excellence: Analytical rigour to control budgets, monitor campaign ROI, and support accurate business planning.

**What’s In It For You**

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal.
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference.

**Who We Are**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  
Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor & Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  
L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  
In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  
L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Role:**

Social Media Manager

**Department:**

Creatives

**Location:**

Andheri West (100% Work from Office)

**Reports to:**

Creative Head

**About the Role**

Most "Social Media Manager" JDs describe someone who manages a page. This one's different: we're hiring someone who ideates, builds, scripts, shoots, hosts, analysis and grows it.

You'll own everything from the monthly content calendar to the camera-facing series that becomes appointment viewing, ideating, writing, shooting, presenting, and analyzing the results yourself, in-house.

**If you've grown a real page or channel from scratch, this is for you.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Content Strategy, Pillars & Calendar Ownership**

* Define and maintain content pillars (education/insight driven, aspirational/new gen, product/proof, culture/BTS, community/UGC, trends); every post maps to one.
* Own the monthly calendar across Instagram (expanding to YouTube/LinkedIn), balanced across pillars, formats, and funnel stages.
* Build recurring IPs and segments within each pillar so the calendar compounds instead of resetting monthly.
* Own copy end-to-end: captions, campaign copy, scripts, and social ad films. You ideate and execute it all, not just the on-camera pieces.
* Experiment with new formats and hooks; double down on winners, retire what doesn't work.
* Keep a constant eye on emerging trends, formats, sounds, and content styles across Instagram and YouTube, and bring the right ones into the calendar before they peak.
* Coordinate in-house shoots with the team and track platform/category trends to adapt into our voice.

**Be the Face: On-Camera & Production**

* Be the primary on-camera presence for educational and brand content: confident, camera-ready, quick on your feet.
* Build repeatable, recognizable IPs that audiences come back for, not isolated videos.
* Turn nutrition and product education into content people actually want to watch, without dumbing it down.
* Shoot in-house and on location with the team, hands-on from pre-production through edit direction.

**Data, Analytics & Competitive Intelligence**

* Track engagement, follower growth, retention, and format performance monthly at the pillar and IP level.
* Publish a monthly report: what's winning, what to retire, what to test next.
* Run a monthly competitor analysis and benchmarking against comparable D2C/wellness/nutrition brands (follower growth, engagement rate, content pillars, formats) and feed findings straight into the calendar.

**Ownership, Budget & Stakeholder Management**

* Set social media KPIs/OKRs tied to business goals and report progress to leadership monthly.
* Own the content production budget (shoots, freelance support, tools) and brief/manage in house editors, designers & copywriters as and when needed.
* Be the single point of accountability for brand voice and tone consistency across every post.
* Handle audience sentiment and reputation professionally, including negative comments or a PR moment, proactively addressing direct messages, comments, queries etc.

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 3–5 years building and growing a real Instagram/YouTube page or channel, with numbers to show for it.
* Proven end-to-end ownership: you've ideated concepts, executed them end to end and seen them perform.
* Genuinely enjoys being on camera, not just tolerates it.
* Comfortable owning the function solo, end-to-end, with minimal oversight. This is a lead role, not a support seat.

**Skills**

* A strong strategist and copywriter first: owns everything from captions and campaign copy to scripts and social ad films, ideating and executing it all.
* Can build a content pillar framework and structure a calendar around it.
* Proactively running competitor and category research and turning it into calendar decisions, repeatedly.
* Fluent reading analytics dashboards and translating numbers into monthly priorities.
* Working knowledge of shooting and editing: understands pacing, framing, what makes a cut work.
* Genuine eye on trends, the latest platform features, and content styles, and quick to pick up new tools (editing, scheduling, analytics, AI) rather than sticking to one workflow.
* Confident presenting strategy and results to founders/leadership, and briefing or directing support (editors, freelancers, junior creators).

**Personality**

* Out-of-the-box thinker with a natural knack for storytelling.
* Quirky, funny, and has an interesting personality that comes through on screen: basically main-character energy, not corporate-spokesperson energy.
* Extremely online: If your screen time is high and you know what's trending across the category, formats, news, insights, sounds, & tools before it peaks, you’d be a great fit.

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in D2C, health/nutrition, FMCG, or wellness brands.
* Basic design skills (Canva/CapCut/Premiere/Figma) for storyboarding or rough cuts.
* Comfort with AI tools for scripting, ideation, or production support.

description:

MIYO is a dessert bar built around one simple idea: your dessert, your way.

From coming up with content ideas to getting your hands dirty filming, editing and coordinating shoots, we’re looking for someone who can take ownership and make things happen.

* Plan and manage the social media content calendar across Instagram and other relevant platforms.
* Write captions, develop creative concepts and identify trends we can make our own.
* Manage DMs, comments and day-to-day community engagement.

**2. Content Creation**

**3. Campaigns, Launches & Activations**

* Help conceptualise and execute new product launches, campaigns, events and in-store activations.
* Coordinate shoots, manage timelines and ensure ideas move from concept to execution.
* Bring fresh ideas to the table to make MIYO more visible, talked about and culturally relevant.

**4. Founder Branding & Storytelling**

* Help build the founders’ personal brands through content, storytelling and social media.
* Identify opportunities to tell the story behind MIYO, our team, our products and our journey.

**5. Building the MIYO Brand**

* Help maintain a consistent verbal and visual identity across our social media, campaigns and other brand touchpoints.
* Contribute ideas for merchandise, collaborations, partnerships and community-building initiatives.
* Keep an eye on emerging brands, internet culture, trends and creative campaigns for inspiration.
* Bring your own ideas and opinions. We want someone who questions, experiments and pushes the brand forward.

**Who we are looking for:**

* Someone with
  **1–2 years of experience**
  in marketing, social media, content creation or a similar role.
* Someone who understands Instagram, internet culture, trends and what makes people stop scrolling.
* Comfortable shooting content and doing basic video editing and graphic design.
* A strong sense of aesthetics, storytelling, writing and creative direction.
* Organised enough to manage calendars, coordinate freelancers and keep projects moving.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
* Someone who can balance creative thinking with hands-on execution.
* Excited by food, lifestyle, culture, hospitality or consumer brands.

**Most importantly:**
We’re looking for someone with taste, curiosity, initiative and a genuine interest in building a brand — not just managing a social media page.

**What You Will Get:**

* The opportunity to work directly with the founders and have a real say in building the brand.

* Exposure to brand strategy, content, campaigns, launches, partnerships and founder branding.
* A fast-moving, collaborative environment where ideas can actually come to life.

**Think You are a Fit?**

Send us your CV to people@miyofoods.com with portfolio or examples of work you’ve created, along with a short note on why you’d like to be part of MIYO.

title: Marketing Manager II (Sr Product Owner)
description:
**What's the role?**
Are you passionate about making a business impact and delivering amazing digital customer experiences? Are you a strategic thinker, able to grasp and articulate the big picture whilst driving forward project execution? Do you thrive on problem-solving and cross-team collaboration?
  
  
Our Senior Product Owner is a lead role within our Web Experience team, as the primary owner of our website development strategy across a growing group of sites including HERE.com, plus our Japan and Legal sites. Within our multi-discipline team, you’ll be responsible for defining and executing our site experience roadmap that will solve our user’s needs, create a pathway to HERE platform sign-ups and deliver against our core website KPIs. You will work closely with colleagues across Infrastructure, User Experience and Content, as well as stakeholders in the Marketing, Product and Technology organizations, with a key focus on cross-functional collaboration to deliver against aligned strategic business goals.
  
  
In addition, you’ll be responsible for planning and overseeing our in-house team’s resource allocation and quality of output to ensure delivery of a a competitive and effective product as our flagship website. From research to product development, you’ll build consensus, solicit feedback, manage ticketed progress and negotiate priorities with all levels of stakeholders as you plan and execute for best practice digital experience .
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Oversee the development and delivery of our annual strategic roadmap to achieve our vision for growth as a multi-audience destination website that helps visitors understand who HERE is, the problems HERE solves and experience easy access to our GTM strategy options from sales engagement to self-service.
* Use your in-depth expertise to build improved understanding of the here.com roadmap by being the lead communicator of key delivered milestones that reflect optimized experience, and improved engagement and conversion, from multiple target audiences. This includes supporting growth in discovery, lead generation, platform sign-ups and thought leadership engagement.
* Define, prioritize, and oversee the execution of Web Experience roadmap. Manage sprint planning and ticket creation, sprint demos, BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) workflows, UAT, and releases in conjunction with internal developers using Jira and GitLab.
* Oversee sprint planning & management (including sprint demos, UAT, releases) by engaging with Web Experience colleagues before planning work in Jira and running regular check-ins.
* Identify, understand and communicate user’s pain points, translating them into roadmapped activities that improve user experience, site performance and achieve agreed here.com KPIs.
* Ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of our global website CMS, Contentful. Demonstrable in-depth experience with Contentful CMS is required to steer the ongoing development of our composable web architecture. You also need strong conceptual understanding of modern front-end frameworks (React, Next.js) and cloud deployments (Vercel, AWS).
* Deep knowledge of Agile/Scrum principles and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) is required. Expert in using JIRA and Confluence to create, manage, and triage complex backlogs.
* work with Performance and in-house development colleagues to utilize analytics, research and digital best-practice approaches to simplify core user journeys.
* work with Web Infrastructure colleagues to identify opportunities to utilize the Martech stack to improve experience and gain customer insight – i.e. website personalization, A/B testing, etc.
* direct a data-led approach (utilizing reporting and insights) to optimize user journeys and site experience by channel source (SEO, PPC, Paid Media).
* Solid understanding of enterprise MarTech stacks, specifically Adobe Analytics, Tealium Tag Management, Marketo, and enterprise search solutions (e.g., Algolia) and how they contribute to a data-driven experience.
* Solve unique problems from a web experience perspective including development, workflow and technical considerations, anchored by a thorough understanding of the broad impact on related disciplines and business performance.
* Develop com product strategy for project execution, managing notable risk and complexity with foresight and your digital expertise.
* Anticipate business, regulatory and performance issues; recommending product, process or service improvements

**Who are you?**

* Bachelor’s degree or Master's in digital-related studies preferred.
* Minimum 7 year’s experience as a website lead/product owner (highly desirable in the B2B/tech industry)
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills (fluency in English is a must). Ability to successfully influence and effectively work across diverse global functions and personalities.
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum principles and web & content development processes
* Experience using JIRA to create, manage and triage backlog.
* In-depth understanding of tech industry market conditions and trends including the impact of AI Search and chat interfaces.
* Good understanding of latest digital experience trends for web and mobile sites.
* Successful and demonstrable track record of developing web/mobile experiences to meet user needs and drive business growth.
* Ability to foster cross-functional support from internal stakeholders and partners to achieve agreed common goals
* Excellent attention to detail in organization, planning and execution
* Excellent relationship building skills across functions and responsibilities .
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to successfully influence and effectively work across functions and personalities.
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
* Creative and innovative thinker
* Analytical abilities necessary to gather and present key business and user insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities/projects in parallel .
* Flexible and able to navigate ambiguity and succeed in a rapidly changing, fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with multiple priorities.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
**Who are we?**
HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.
  
  
At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.
  
  
Within HERE's global marketing structure, the Web Experience team is a group of multi-discipline colleagues working across web content, infrastructure, product and user experience. We are responsible for the end-to-end development and maintenance of HERE.com, our flagship brand website, as well as various microsites and connected experiences. We work from four locations - Berlin, Chicago, Mumbai and London - in a constant motion of collaboration and innovation.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive
description:
**Senior Performance Marketing Executive**

Function: Marketing – Demand & Growth

Location: Andheri West, Mumbai

Employment Type: Full Time

Working Timings : Mon-Sat | 9:30 am to 6:30 pm

Pay Structure: Fixed + Variable

**About RINGS & I**

* RINGS & I is a seven-year-old made-to-order diamond jewellery brand, founded by engineers with a belief that jewellery does not need to be built around inventory.We are building a technology-led jewellery experience where customers can:Access live, dynamic pricing & personalize designs live
* Build and configure jewellery through Build Your Own experiences
* Choose across multiple materials, diamonds and specifications without being restricted by stocked inventory
* Make informed decisions with education and transparency at the centre of the buying journey

Over the last year, RINGS & I has scaled rapidly, and we have an aggressive three-year growth plan across multiple cities.

**Role Summary**

The Senior Performance Marketing Executive is a hands-on execution role responsible for running, maintaining and continuously improving the paid acquisition engine for RINGS & I.Meta will be the primary channel, with the role owning day-to-day campaign execution, optimization, creative testing, budget management and performance analysis.The role requires strong analytical judgement, disciplined execution and the ability to use data and AI effectively to continuously improve campaign performance.Working knowledge of Google Ads is a plus, along with curiosity to explore emerging performance channels as the business scales.

**Why this role exists?**

Marketing is a critical part of the demand engine supporting RINGS & I's expansion.Within Demand & Growth, Performance Marketing is responsible for generating qualified demand and driving customers into our stores.We have already built and tested our core acquisition funnel. The next phase is about:Maintain → Optimize → Scale → ReplicateThe Senior Performance Marketing Executive will execute and continuously improve this playbook and help replicate it as RINGS & I enters new cities.

**What will you do day-to-day?**

* Run and optimize Meta Ads campaigns end-to-end, including campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing, budget pacing and scaling.
* Work within a high-consideration purchase funnel where the advertisement is the beginning of the journey toward a qualified store visit.
* Track and analyse campaign and funnel-stage performance rather than relying only on platform-level metrics.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Budget Control & Efficiency (Ad Spend)
* CPM optimisation & control within set threshold
* CTR threshold
* Target Reach
* Target Impressions
* Number of qualified visits
* Cost per visit
* Cost Per Acquisition

**Overall Success Metric**

Qualified Store Visits generated through Performance MarketingPlatform metrics measure the health and efficiency of the channel. The ultimate measure of success is whether Performance Marketing consistently generates qualified customers who visit our stores.

**Growth Path**

This role offers a fast-track growth opportunity based on demonstrated capability and ownership:Senior Performance Marketing Executive → Performance Marketing Manager → Demand GrowthThe intended journey can happen over approximately three years, with progression based on performance and the ability to take on broader ownership—not tenure.

title: Brand & Marketing Lead
description:
**Company Description**

Apekani Diamonds is an upcoming premium lab-grown diamond jewelry brand created for a new generation of luxury seekers who value ambition, independence, and modern love. The brand offers exceptional brilliance and contemporary design as a refined alternative to mined diamonds, combining uncompromising quality with transparent pricing. Apekani focuses on craftsmanship and personal expression, designing bold statement pieces for urban achievers, modern couples, and individuals who choose conscious luxury. With a philosophy of “everyday luxury, boldly expressed,” the brand rejects traditional markups and legacy baggage in favor of honest value and original design.

Founded in 2025 by Apeksha Lodha and Animesh Jain, we sell at apekani.diamonds, at jewellery exhibitions and through private appointments, and we are building toward our own retail stores. Our line is
*Lead with Light*
. We don’t make catalogue copies, we don’t discount, and we don’t whisper.

The lab-grown category in India is loud, cheap and identical — fifty brands shouting “affordable” at the same customer. We are building the one that isn’t. That gap is your canvas.

**The Opportunity**

India’s lab-grown diamond category is growing fast and converging on price. Apekani Diamonds has taken a different road — design-led, certified, premium — and this role carries that position into the world. You will own the brand’s voice and presence across every channel, lead our agency partners, run our customer relationship programmes and build the measurement that shows what works. You report to the founders directly. It is a founding marketing role with real authority, at the stage where every decision shapes what the brand becomes. The role is a full-time, on-site role based in the Powai, Mumbai region, responsible for shaping and elevating Apekani Diamonds’ brand presence across all channels.

**What you Own**

* Brand Stewardship: The brand guide, design system and tone of voice, applied consistently across website, advertising, social media, email, WhatsApp, exhibitions and press. You approve what goes out.
* Messaging & Copy: Positioning, audience messaging, product copy, campaigns, email and WhatsApp communication, exhibition and print collateral.
* Agency Leadership: Briefs, content calendar, quality review, performance scorecards, monthly reviews, scope and renewals across social media, SEO and paid campaigns.
* CRM & Retention: Email flows and campaigns, WhatsApp templates and campaigns, segmentation and consent.
* Launches & Experiments: Founder-led content, collection launches, exhibition activations, collaborations and new formats — proposed with a case, funded when the case holds.
* Measurement: A single dashboard across paid, social, email, WhatsApp, website and exhibitions, with qualified consultations booked as the north-star metric.
* Media & Partnerships: Wedding and lifestyle press, exhibition organisers, brand partners.

**What Your Bring**

* 6–9 years in brand-side marketing, with a strong foundation in Brand Startegy & Management, at a premium or lifestyle consumer brand — D2C, fashion, beauty, jewellery or luxury retail — including at least two years leading the brand as a senior marketer.
* Experience managing an agency from the client side and owning brand guidelines across channels.
* Experience collaborating with Sales teams, using brand and marketing initiatives to support revenue growth and customer engagement.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Design Management, or a related field; advanced qualifications are a plus.
* Commitment to inclusive, ethical, and customer-centric brand practices aligned with conscious luxury values.
* Writing Chops: A portfolio of product copy, campaign lines and emails you wrote that performed.
* Familiarity with various Tools: Klaviyo or an equivalent CRM platform (MoEngage, WebEngage, Mailchimp); a WhatsApp marketing platform such as Interakt or WATI; Shopify; Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads reporting; GA4; Canva or Figma for quick comps. Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar a plus.
* Analytics: Fluent in CAC, ROAS, conversion rate and attribution; able to evaluate and direct agency performance.
* Design Judgement: Able to assess premium creative against a brand system and articulate exactly what works and what does not.
* An Experimenter: You have shipped ideas that carried risk, and you can speak to the ones that failed and what you learned.
* A first-principles thinker who questions the default before improving it.
* Taste, conviction and the confidence to defend a brand standard — including with founders.
* A finisher who ships calendars, runs reviews and delivers copy on time.
* Energised by a small team where results are visible and attributable.
* This role is not the right fit if your default lever is a promotion, or you need an established team around you to execute.

title: Lead - Marketing Strategist
description:
**About BrowserStack:**

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**

**Role in a Nutshell**

As a Lead / Senior Associate Marketing, you will be a core problem-solver responsible for owning the marketing pipeline and delivering on pipeline commits. Initially, you will define the strategy and own the end-to-end funnel for one of our marketing channels, outbound marketing, focusing on strategy and funnel conversion to generate tangible business value rather than requiring deep, technical platform-level expertise.

Beyond this initial focus, this role requires high flexibility and strategic agility. You will be expected to adapt and own evolving problem statements in the near future, spanning various channels and broader marketing pipeline goals. The true focus of this role is on solving complex growth problems, building scalable solutions, and aligning seamlessly with BrowserStack’s broader business goals.

**Desired Experience**

* 3–6 years of overall experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, with high adaptability to navigate evolving problem statements.
* Proven ability to solve complex channel problems, think strategically, and drive execution with strong attention to detail.
* Strong data-driven decision-making skills with deep comfort working with pipeline data.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams.

**What You Will Do**

* Define and execute the marketing strategy in alignment with broader business objectives for one or more of the marketing channels.
* Experiment continuously to optimize funnel conversion rates and rigorously analyze incremental impact.
* Identify opportunities for growth and efficiency, breaking down complex pipeline challenges into clear, actionable, and scalable solutions.
* Work seamlessly with cross-functional teams (Events, Marketing, Business Operations, and Sales) to prioritize initiatives using data and research.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to continuously sharpen the strategic growth plan.

**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for the employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual & Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life-event leaves
* Remote-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: Influencer Marketing - Regional (South)
description:
**About the Company:**

Founded in 2019, Traya is one of India's largest digital health-tech platforms for haircare and hair loss. Our mission is to use technology to scale healthcare solutions to 520M+ Indians that are suffering from hair loss with a holistic 360-degree solution, which includes clinically proven, doctor-backed medicines, access to Traya doctors, personal hair coach, customized diet plans, and more!

Founded by Saloni Anand, a techie-turned-marketeer and Altaf Saiyed, a Stanford Business School alumnus, Traya sits at the forefront of the multi-billion-dollar hair care solutions category.

Having raised institutional capital from marquee VCs like Fireside Ventures, Kae Capital, Whiteboard Capital, Traya has more than 2.5L+ customers, with a 93% success rate and 30% MoM growth over the past year.

**Brand Vision & Philosophy:**

Traya was created with a global vision to create awareness around hair loss, de-stigmatise it while empathizing with the customers that it has an emotional and psychological impact. Most importantly, to combine 3 different sciences (Ayurveda, Allopathy and Nutrition) to create the perfect holistic solution for hair loss patients.

We want to be synonymous with the term hair fall and hair care. We are building a brand that does not compromise on efficacy and is loved by customers.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a creative, data-driven, and highly organized Influencer Marketing professional to lead and execute our creator collaborations. This role will own the influencer funnel right from scouting creators to managing campaigns, negotiating deals, tracking ROI, and turning influencer content into a powerful brand engine.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1) Influencer Identification & Onboarding**

- Identify and onboard influencers across YouTube, Instagram, and other emerging platforms.

- Maintain an updated database of creators across niches like lifestyle, beauty, wellness, dermatology, and hair care.

- Pre-screen creators based on engagement, audience quality, and brand fit.

**2) Campaign Planning & Execution**

- Build monthly influencer marketing calendars aligned with brand objectives.

- Develop briefs, negotiate deliverables, and ensure timely content delivery.

- Guide creators on messaging aligned with Trayas tone of voice and medical accuracy.

- Ensure compliance with internal clinical claims, disclosures, and brand guidelines.

**3) Relationship Management**

- Build long-term relationships with high-performing influencers.

- Develop a network of agencies, talent managers, and micro/macro creators.

- Coordinate shoots, product dispatch, and content approvals.

**4) Performance Tracking & Optimization**

- Track performance of all influencer content views, engagement, conversions, CAC, and ROI.

- Conduct A/B tests on messaging, formats, and creator categories.

- Identify high-performing content to repurpose for ads and brand channels.

**5) Cross-functional Collaboration**

- Work closely with brand, content, creative, and paid marketing teams.

- Share creator insights for overall brand strategy.

- Coordinate with product and operations teams for timely product delivery.

**What we are looking for:**

- 3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator management, or social media marketing (D2C/e-commerce preferred).

- Strong understanding of the Indian influencer ecosystem.

- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations, deadlines, and stakeholders.

- Comfortable working with data, performance dashboards, and campaign metrics.

- A creative mindset with an eye for trends, content formats, and storytelling.

This is a techno-commercial leadership role that pairs full country business ownership with hands-on business development, from strategy through to closing. As ADM's senior H&W representative in the region, the leader will align local execution with regional and global strategy while tailoring it to the market. Success calls for strategic agility, commercial acumen, and the leadership to grow both a business and a team.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Read market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity to shape segmentation and go-to-market priorities.
* Drive cross-sell across ADM's active health ingredients (Probiotics, Prebiotics, Postbiotics, Vitamins, Sterols, Isoflavones, Botanicals) and enabling ingredients (Flavors, Colors, Proteins).

* Leadership & Governance

**Your Profile**
Education & Experience
  
  

* A science or pharmacy foundation (B.Pharm/M.Pharm, or M.Sc/B.Sc in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science, or Nutrition, or a Food Tech/Biotech engineering degree), postgraduate level preferred. An MBA is strongly preferred; a PhD in life sciences or a medical qualification (MBBS) is an added advantage, especially for the pharma and clinical channels.

title: Senior Brand Manager (Lips) - Faces
description:
Senior Brand Manager – Lips | Faces Canada
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
**Brand:**
Faces Canada (Purplle Group)
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai | On-site
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Associate Director – Brand Management
  
  
**Experience:**
1–2 years of post-MBA experience
  
  
**Education:**
MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 B-school preferred
  
  
**About Faces Canada**
Faces Canada is a leading colour cosmetics brand in India and part of the Purplle Group. We create high-performance, comfortable makeup products for Indian consumers, with a strong presence across e-commerce platforms, Purplle beauty stores, modern trade, and general trade.
  
  
The Lips category is one of our largest and fastest-growing portfolios, offering significant opportunities for innovation, growth, and consumer engagement.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a driven and consumer-focused Senior Brand Manager to lead the Faces Canada Lips portfolio end to end. The role involves ownership of business growth, profitability, pricing, product innovation, brand communication, and channel marketing across online and offline platforms.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with R&D, sourcing, sales, e-commerce, digital, design, and retail teams to build winning products, strengthen brand positioning, and drive sustainable category growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* 1. Business & P&L Management
* Own revenue, gross margin, and growth targets for the Lips portfolio.
* Monitor sell-in, sell-out, market share, and SKU performance to identify growth opportunities.
* Drive annual and quarterly business planning, including volume and inventory forecasting.
* 2. Pricing & Portfolio Management
* Develop pricing strategies, pack-price architecture, and promotional plans across channels.
* Track competitor pricing, shade ranges, product formats, and claims.
* Optimise the product portfolio by scaling high-performing SKUs and rationalising underperforming ones.
* 3. New Product Development (NPD)
* Identify consumer needs and market opportunities across shades, formats, finishes, and product claims.
* Develop product briefs and drive new product launches in collaboration with R&D, sourcing, packaging, and quality teams.
* Own launch timelines, costing, shade selection, and go-to-market plans.
* 4. Brand Strategy & Communication
* Develop the brand story, positioning, and campaign strategies for the Lips category.
* Brief and collaborate with creative agencies and internal teams on campaigns, packaging, content, and influencer marketing.
* Ensure consistent brand communication across all consumer touchpoints.
* 5. 360° Channel Marketing – Online & Offline
* Partner with e-commerce and performance marketing teams to improve product listings, ratings, search visibility, advertising, and platform performance across Purplle, Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, and quick-commerce platforms.
* Drive in-store visibility across Purplle stores, modern trade, and general trade through visual merchandising, gondolas, testers, sampling, and beauty advisor training.
* Plan trade schemes and consumer promotions with sales teams and evaluate marketing spend effectiveness.

Who We’re Looking For
  
  

* MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a reputed business school, preferably Tier 1 or Tier 2.
* 1–2 years of post-MBA experience in brand management, category management, or sales, preferably in beauty, cosmetics, personal care, or FMCG.
* Strong interest in makeup, particularly lip products, including formats, finishes, shade trends, and competitor offerings.
* Understanding of business fundamentals, including revenue, pricing, margins, product innovation, and brand communication.
* Exposure to both online marketplaces/D2C platforms and offline retail channels.
* Strong consumer understanding, market awareness, and the ability to translate insights into business opportunities.

Key Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong commercial acumen and understanding of P&L fundamentals.
* Analytical thinking and proficiency in Excel, sales data, and business performance dashboards.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and creative briefing skills.
* Strong understanding of beauty trends, consumer behaviour, and influencer-led marketing.
* An eye for aesthetics, packaging, colour trends, and visual merchandising.
* Ownership mindset, agility, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.

Success Metrics – First 12 Months
  
  

* Deliver revenue and gross margin targets for the Lips portfolio.
* Launch 2–3 new products on schedule, with at least one emerging as a hero SKU.
* Establish a consistent brand story across online and offline channels.
* Strengthen digital visibility, product ratings, search rankings, and in-store presence for core SKUs.
* Improve portfolio productivity through effective SKU management.

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Lead one of the most visible and high-potential categories within a growing Indian beauty brand.
* Take ownership of business outcomes and product innovation from day one.
* Work cross-functionally across product development, brand marketing, digital commerce, sales, and retail.
* Build products and brand experiences that connect with India's evolving beauty consumers.

**Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.**

title: Key Account Management
description:
**Job Description**
Role : Key Account Manager - Corporate Channel
  
  
Level : Senior Manager
  
  
Reporting to : Director - Corporate Channel
  
  
Location : Mumbai
  
  
**About The Function**
MyBiz, a corporate travel management platform by MakeMyTrip provides a customizable, real time self-booking system which seamlessly integrates into a company’s structure to deliver convenience, transparency, savings and the power of choice.
  
  
Over last 5 years, they have on-boarded 50000+ prominent corporates which are availing the benefits of our seamless platform, along with significant savings.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a KAM Lead for the MyBiz business at MakeMyTrip, this role will own and scale the corporate account management charter across the North region. The role is responsible for driving regional growth through strong client relationships, revenue expansion, and consistent delivery of business outcomes across enterprise and mid-market accounts.
  
  
This role will lead and develop a high-performing KAM team, own end-to-end regional targets, and ensure operational rigor across account management, renewals, and upsell. The focus will be on building long-term partnerships with corporates, improving client satisfaction, and driving disciplined execution while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  
  
What will you be doing
  
  

* Strategic Leadership & Growth
* Define and execute the regional corporate account strategy to deliver revenue growth, profitability, and market share across the North region.
* Translate overall business objectives into clear regional priorities, action plans, and measurable KPIs.
* Drive data-led decision-making by analysing market trends, competitive landscape, customer behaviour, and funnel performance.
* Team Leadership & Development
* Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 8 Key Account Managers (KAMs) across the region. Set clear performance expectations, targets, and incentive frameworks to drive consistent outcomes.
* Enable the team through structured training, sales playbooks, deal-closing frameworks, and forecasting discipline.
* Build a high-performance culture anchored in ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Sales Delivery & Pipeline Management
* Own the end-to-end sales cycle for mid to large enterprise accounts, from lead engagement and solutioning to closure.
* Ensure a healthy, predictable, and revenue-backed pipeline across MyBiz offerings, including the Self-Booking Tool, managed travel services, and Travel & Expense solutions.
* Identify and drive upsell, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities to maximize account value and long-term revenue.
* Client Relationship & Value Delivery
* Act as the strategic relationship owner and escalation point for key corporate clients in the region.
* Drive high customer satisfaction through strong account governance, seamless onboarding, and effective support coordination.
* Partner closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Delivery teams to ensure smooth implementation and contractual adherence.
* Market & Competitive Intelligence
* Track regional market dynamics to identify emerging sectors, solution gaps, pricing trends, and competitive moves.
* Refine the regional go-to-market strategy on an ongoing basis using insights from market data and performance metrics.
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Product and Supply teams to strengthen offerings and address evolving client needs.
* Partner with Finance to enable accurate forecasting, revenue tracking, and business optimization.
* Coordinate with Operations and Technology teams to ensure efficient onboarding, service delivery, and issue resolution.
* Engage with Legal teams to manage contract lifecycles, ensure compliance, and mitigate commercial risk

**Qualification & Experience**

* Post-graduate from a reputed institute with 8–12 years of experience in corporate sales or account management, including 2–3 years in a people leadership role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS or tech-enabled platform sales; exposure to corporate travel technology or enterprise solutions is preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of consistently exceeding targets, scaling teams, and driving regional growth.
* Strong comfort with P&L ownership, pricing levers, funnel economics, and sales forecasting

**Key Success Factors For The Role**

* Business Acumen: Strong commercial and strategic mindset with the ability to assess market dynamics, revenue opportunities, and business risk.
* Analytical Rigor: Data-driven approach to tracking pipeline health, sales efficiency, and revenue outcomes, with clear ownership of targets and productivity metrics.
* Communication & Negotiation: Clear and confident communicator with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively at senior and CXO levels.
* Execution Focus: Strong bias for action with a consistent track record of delivering revenue targets and improving sales cycle efficiency.
* Customer Orientation: Focus on long-term account growth and retention through value-led solutions and strong client partnerships.
* People Leadership: Ability to build and scale high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and stakeholder collaboration.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers.
